title: Electrical Project Manager
description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?
  
  
AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.
  
  
Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…
  
  
Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.
  
  
**Snapshot**

* Lead defined project scopes and workstreams across AirTrunk’s growing India data centre portfolio, from development and procurement through construction, commissioning and handover.
* Use strong electrical and DCS / controls capability to coordinate critical data centre systems, interfaces, testing and operational readiness.
* Work with Development, Construction, contractors and internal functions to improve safety, programme certainty, quality, cost control and customer outcomes.

Based in India, you will report to the Project Director or Senior Project Manager and work closely with Development, Construction, Design, Project Controls, Commercial, Procurement, Commissioning, Operations and external delivery partners, making your mark in a number of ways.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Project manage assigned scopes and workstreams through development, procurement, construction, commissioning, operational readiness and handover.
* Own project scope, programme, budget, risks, interfaces, actions and forecast outcomes within the authority delegated to the role.
* Coordinate with General Contractors, consultants, suppliers and internal stakeholders to achieve agreed milestones and delivery commitments.
* Review and challenge contractor programmes, progress updates, look-ahead plans, sequencing, dependencies and recovery measures.
* Coordinate electrical systems and interfaces, including high-voltage and low-voltage distribution, substations, generators, UPS, switchboards, protection, earthing and testing requirements.
* Coordinate DCS / controls interfaces, including BMS, EPMS, SCADA, PLC, instrumentation, controls networks, systems integration, testing and commissioning requirements.
* Review constructability and technical interfaces across electrical, mechanical, ICT, controls and commissioning workstreams, while maintaining clear boundaries with Design Authority responsibilities.
* Support procurement planning and tender activities, including scope of works, equipment requirements, long-lead items, bid evaluations and recommendations.
* Work with Project Controls and Commercial teams on cost reporting, cost to complete, cashflow, commitments, variations, claims, extensions of time and commercial exposure.
* Lead project coordination meetings, planning workshops, constructability reviews, programme risk reviews and recovery sessions, maintaining clear decisions and actions.
* Maintain accurate project records, reporting dashboards, risk registers, issue logs, decision registers and progress information in accordance with AirTrunk governance.
* Identify project risks early and develop practical mitigation and recovery plans with contractors, consultants and internal project teams.
* Support safe, high-quality delivery, including site inspections, quality assurance, testing, commissioning, operational readiness and handover to Operations.
* Prepare concise project health reports and executive insights covering progress, critical path, cost, risk, quality, commissioning and forecast completion.
* Travel within India and elsewhere in APAC as required for project reviews, site inspections, procurement, claims management, commissioning, close-out and handover.

**What You’ll Bring**
You will bring a practical, technically credible and delivery-focused approach, together with:
  
  

* A Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management or a related discipline.
* 8+ years’ experience in project management, construction delivery, engineering or project controls within major infrastructure, mission-critical, industrial or data centre projects.
* Demonstrated experience delivering electrical systems and coordinating DCS / controls, BMS, EPMS, SCADA, PLC or related systems interfaces.
* Experience managing project scopes and integrated delivery activities across development, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning and handover.
* Strong understanding of construction sequencing, programme logic, critical path, dependencies, project risk and contractor performance.
* Experience coordinating and constructively challenging General Contractors, specialist contractors, consultants, suppliers and internal stakeholders.
* Commercial awareness across scope, programme, cost, risk, variations, claims and contractual outcomes.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, influencing and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly.
* Experience working in India, or strong capability to operate effectively with Indian contractors, authorities, suppliers and project stakeholders.
* A proactive, flexible and forward-thinking approach, with a results-focused “get things done” mindset.
* A genuine commitment to safety, quality, integrity and AirTrunk’s values.

**The AirTrunk Culture**
Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.
  
  
The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.
  
  
Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.
  
  
Now’s your chance to Grow@Hyperscale.
  
  

* To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.\*\*

title: Projects Head/Operations Head
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION — HEAD OF PROJECTS & OPERATIONS**

**Company:**
Innovative Realest Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Mumbai

**Reporting to:**
Managing Director

**Industry:**
Real Estate Development / Residential Construction

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Head of Projects & Operations to lead the planning, execution and delivery of our residential real-estate projects. The role carries end-to-end responsibility for project timelines, construction quality, cost control, site operations and coordination across consultants, contractors and internal teams.

The candidate should combine strong technical knowledge with hands-on execution capabilities, ensuring projects progress efficiently from planning and mobilisation through construction, completion and handover.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Project Planning & Delivery**

* Prepare and manage project execution plans, construction schedules, milestones and resource requirements.
* Translate overall project objectives into monthly, weekly and daily site targets.
* Monitor progress across projects, identify delays and implement corrective action.
* Coordinate drawings, approvals, materials, manpower and contractor deployment to ensure uninterrupted execution.
* Drive timely completion, snag rectification and possession readiness.

**2. Site Operations & Team Management**

* Oversee day-to-day site operations through site engineers, project managers and site coordinators.
* Define responsibilities, reporting requirements and accountability for site teams.
* Conduct regular site inspections and progress reviews.
* Resolve execution challenges and escalate critical issues with practical recommendations.
* Establish standard operating procedures for site execution, documentation and reporting.

**3. Budgeting & Cost Control**

* Work with management and finance to prepare project budgets, execution forecasts and cash-flow requirements.
* Track actual expenditure and committed costs against approved budgets.
* Review BOQs, quantity estimates, contractor measurements, bills and variations before recommending approval.
* Control material wastage, rework, idle manpower and avoidable expenditure.
* Identify value-engineering opportunities while maintaining design intent, quality and safety.
* Ensure additional work and cost variations receive approval before execution.

**4. Contractor, Vendor & Procurement Management**

* Support contractor selection, technical evaluation, scope definition and commercial negotiations.
* Establish clear deliverables, timelines and performance standards for contractors.
* Coordinate procurement schedules for civil, finishing, MEP and other project requirements.
* Monitor vendor performance, material quality and timely delivery.
* Coordinate with accounts for bill certification, payment planning and resolution of billing discrepancies.

**5. Consultant & Design Coordination**

* Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, MEP consultants, liaison consultants and other specialists.
* Ensure approved drawings and technical specifications are available before work begins.
* Identify design conflicts and resolve technical queries promptly.
* Control drawing revisions and communicate changes clearly to execution teams.
* Ensure civil, structural, services and finishing works are properly integrated.

**6. Quality, Safety & Compliance Coordination**

* Implement quality checks, inspection procedures and material-testing requirements.
* Ensure construction follows approved drawings, specifications and applicable requirements.
* Monitor site safety, housekeeping and contractor adherence to safety procedures.
* Coordinate with relevant consultants and internal teams on permissions, inspections and completion documentation.
* Maintain project records supporting statutory submissions and RERA progress reporting.
* Track dependencies relating to completion and occupancy approvals.

**7. Management Reporting & Cross-functional Coordination**

* Present periodic dashboards covering physical progress, budget utilisation, procurement, risks and pending decisions.
* Coordinate with finance on projected funding requirements and payment priorities.
* Align execution milestones with commitments made by sales and customer-facing teams.
* Maintain risk registers, decision trackers and action plans with clear ownership.
* Provide management with early visibility of potential delays, cost overruns and quality concerns.

**8. Completion & Handover**

* Plan testing, commissioning, snag closure and final quality inspections.
* Coordinate handover documentation, warranties, as-built drawings and operating manuals.
* Ensure readiness of apartments, common areas, utilities and building services.
* Coordinate with customer relations and facility-management teams for smooth possession and handover.
* Monitor defect rectification and contractor obligations during the defect-liability period.

**Candidate Profile**

* B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering; a postgraduate qualification in Construction or Project Management is preferred.
* Typically
  **8–12 years of relevant experience**
* Proven experience delivering residential projects, preferably high-rise developments in Mumbai.
* Experience working with a real-estate developer and managing multiple contractors and consultants.
* Strong understanding of civil construction, finishing works, MEP coordination, BOQs, billing and cost control.
* Familiarity with Mumbai construction constraints, approval processes and redevelopment projects is desirable.
* Proficiency in Excel and project-planning tools such as MS Project or Primavera.
* Strong leadership, negotiation, problem-solving and communication skills.
* Willingness to travel regularly between project sites and maintain a hands-on site presence.

**Compensation:**
Commensurate with experience, technical expertise and demonstrated project-delivery capability.

title: Junior Associate Founder's Office
description:
We’re looking for a highly driven, organized, detail-oriented, creative, and execution-driven individual to join the Founder’s Office. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys moving quickly, solving problems, and taking projects from idea to execution.

Working closely with the Founders, Founder’s Office Lead as well as cross-functionally you’ll help drive key business priorities, manage our Sephora US and UK accounts, and work across projects spanning strategy, e-commerce, brand and more. You’re someone who loves getting things done, learns quickly, and thrives on variety and responsibility. You’re equally comfortable analysing data, building a deck, refining a product page, or conducting market research to uncover consumer insights.

**What You’ll Do**

**Project Management & Execution**

* Lead/support cross-functional projects from brief through execution, depending on the scope and business priority.
* Manage timelines, trackers, and deliverables, ensuring stakeholders stay aligned and deadlines are met.
* Proactively follow up on outstanding actions, anticipate roadblocks, and keep multiple workstreams moving.
* Build and maintain processes and reporting to bring structure, visibility, and accountability to projects.

**Sephora US & UK Account Management**

* Support the day-to-day management of Sephora US and UK accounts, spanning administrative requirements, operational coordination, and strategic initiatives.
* Own and coordinate PDP optimizations, ensuring product pages are accurate, compelling, on-brand, and optimized for conversion.
* Track account performance and build regular reporting on key metrics, launches, and opportunities.
* Coordinate launches, updates, assets, and deliverables across internal teams and external partners.
* Support the Brand Marketing team in executing Sephora US and UK activations, launches, and promotional initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve the customer experience and brand presence across Sephora.

**Founder Support & Special Projects**

* Work closely with the Founders and Founder’s Office Lead to support evolving business priorities.
* Step in to support business-critical initiatives and ad hoc projects as they arise, working across teams to help turn ideas into action.
* Conduct research and analysis to support decision-making and help solve business challenges.

**Tools, Creativity & Continuous Improvement**

* Use tools such as Excel, Canva, Claude, and ChatGPT to improve the quality, speed, and efficiency of day-to-day work.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, automate repetitive tasks, and reduce manual effort across the business.
* Bring creative thinking and strong aesthetic judgement to presentations, product pages, research, and brand initiatives.
* Stay curious about new tools, technologies, and ways of working, continuously looking for opportunities to help the team work smarter and more effectively.

**Who You Are**

**Attitude and ownership come first.**
We’re looking for someone who is:

* **An executor:**
  Diligent, dependable, and relentless about following through. You don't wait to be chased.
* **Meticulous:**
  Detail-oriented, accurate, and unwilling to let things slip through the cracks.
* **Proactive:**
  You anticipate next steps, solve problems independently, and flag issues early.
* **Numerically strong:**
  Comfortable with numbers, Excel/Google Sheets, and analytical problem-solving.
* **Creatively inclined:**
  Brings fresh ideas, has a good aesthetic sense, and enjoys thinking creatively about strategy.
* **A clear communicator:**
  Organised in your thinking, concise in your communication, and effective at coordinating with different teams.
* **Hungry to learn:**
  Curious, resourceful, adaptable, and willing to roll up your sleeves to do whatever it takes.
* **Trustworthy:**
  Discreet and mature when handling confidential information.
* **Comfortable with pace:**
  Able to juggle multiple priorities, handle pressure, and work flexibly across India, UK, and US time zones when needed.

**Experience & Skills**

* 2-3 years of experience in a fast-paced environment; backgrounds in startups, beauty, consumer brands, e-commerce, consulting or strategy are welcome.
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, PowerPoint/Google Slides, and Canva.
* Familiarity with Claude, ChatGPT, or other AI tools.
* A genuine interest in beauty, consumer brands, and building a global business is a plus.

**The bottom line**
: We’re looking for a starter and a finisher. Someone who combines ownership, attention to detail, and a genuine hunger to learn - and who can be trusted to take a task from idea to execution without constant supervision.

title: Project Manager: Engineering Education for Development initiative
description:
A Project Manager for an initiative connecting engineering education to regional / local development. Please see below for the project description. We need to make a quick decision please respond accordingly.

**Responsibilities:**

-Connecting with government agencies / line departments and designing projects for colleges

-Raising funds directly from projects, through engagement with other training bodies such as MSFDA, and other sources

- Publicity material creation and raising the profile of the initiative

- Working with the existing team and further extending the TCTD team to ensure that the project goals are met

**Qualifications: Educational:**
MTech with 3 - 4 years of relevant experience; PhD (Engineering BTech) with 1 -2 years of relevant experience

**Skills:**
Should know how to write reports, create and make presentations, liaison with different stakeholders

**Salary**
: 1 Lakh per month to begin, and 1.3 Lakh per month on extension to one year appointment

Duration of appointment: 89 days initial appointment, extension to 1 year depending on performance

------------------

**Project description**

This project will expand the work being done under Unnat Maharashtra Abhiyan (UMA) aligned with the development goals of the Tata Centre for Technology and Design (TCTD) at IIT Bombay. TCTD was established with the support from the Tata Trusts in 2014, and works in the areas of Agriculture and food, education, environment, health, housing, water, and waste management. It works on an innovation to deployment model.

UMA is an initiative that addresses development challenges at a local level by involving regional engineering colleges, training, and connecting them to the relevant line departments. Colleges

have contributed to projects in the areas of energy, drinking water, and roads and transport. At the same time, limited technical capacity and orientation towards project-based learning in the colleges, are creating a bottleneck in the UMA delivery model.

Current methods and curricula are leading to poor capability development for abstract thinking, ability to self-learn and of knowledge in the sector. We propose here an intervention to change teaching methods in colleges from the existing theoretical and abstract inductive approach to a deductive approach with a real-world orientation.

The proposed pedagogical change addresses employability and capability of graduates as well as developing a strong institutional base for projects and contribution to development outcomes. Digitalization is underway in India, but there is a lack of understanding of value-addition possibilities, many of which are at local points. Involvement of colleges and connection to local problems can provide a major fillip to value addition.

Outcomes: The project would lead to textbook and educational material development, faculty development and training, and be integrated with the syllabus of colleges in the state. This will result in a roadmap for pedagogical change for the country setting up students for lifelong learning. It will also lead to increased professional participation of colleges and fresh graduates in regional development.

Possible sector(s) to be targeted: Roads and Transportation; Power systems including electricity distribution, solar photovoltaics and battery storage systems; Water resources including drinking water systems, irrigation through canals, piped water distribution; Programming: Python / GIS / Databases - programming runs through all themes .These courses while inter-disciplinary are particularly relevant to Computer Science, Electrical, Mechanical, Civil Engineering

For more on TCTD see:

http://www.tatacentre.iitb.ac.in/

https://www.iitb.ac.in/academic-divisions/tata-centre-technology-and-design-tctd

For more on UMA see: https://homepages.iitb.ac.in/~umaiitbombay/

description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title: Study Manager – Upstream Facilities**
**About Technip Energies:**
**A global technology and engineering powerhouse leading in energy and decarbonization infrastructure.**
Technip Energies is a global engineering and technology leader, delivering some of the world’s largest and most complex engineering and construction projects. With strong leadership positions in LNG, hydrogen, ethylene, sustainable chemistry, and CO₂ management, we actively support the development of critical markets including energy, energy derivatives, decarbonization, and circularity. Our three complementary Business Units - Project Delivery & Services (PD&S), Technologies & Products (T&P), and Adjacent Business Models (ABM) transforming innovation into scalable, industrial solutions.
  
  
To know more, visit: Technip Energies at a glance - Technip Energies at a glance | Technip Energies
  
  
**Position Overview:**
We are currently seeking a
**Study Manager – Upstream Facilities,**
reporting directly to
*HOD – Genesis*
to join our Genesis team based in Mumbai/ Noida.
  
  
**Company information:**
Genesis is a market-leading consulting company focused on providing high-value advisory services for the energy industry. As trusted advisors committed to a sustainable future, we have extensive experience working in true partnership with our clients while providing innovative, robust and sustainable solutions for over 35 years.
  
  
Genesis is a global business unit of Technip Energies, providing impartial consulting services to its clients in traditional hydrocarbon and the energy industries. We have an unrivalled track record of bringing high-impact solutions to clients. Our mission is to be a trusted advisor on the journey to a sustainable future. We are problem solvers who are at the forefront of innovation and our world-class experience, individual expertise and collective wisdom is what differentiates Genesis in today’s market.
  
  
From Engineers and Specialists to Project Managers and Support Staff, spread across 13 countries, our people thrive in a dynamic, proactive business that is balanced with a deep sense of environmental responsibility. We see limitless possibilities for our solutions; and our knowledge sharing, collaboration and innovative thinking are just a few of the ways we fuel our energy for what we do.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
We are seeking an experienced professional to oversee and manage the responsibilities below.
  
  
The Upstream Facilities Study Manager is responsible for leading and delivering multi-disciplinary upstream facilities studies including feasibility, conceptual, pre-FEED and front-end advisory scopes. The role ensures technical excellence, safe and efficient study execution, quality delivery, Client relationship management skills and strong commercial stewardship.
  
  
The Upstream Facilities Study Manager shall work within a study team or lead smaller studies, interfacing with the wider Genesis organisation both locally and globally. They shall provide facilities technical inputs and project engineering on a variety of front end studies and bespoke operations support/troubleshooting for clients globally.
  
  
The position requires a self-starter who can flexibly manage and deliver on multiple priorities. A high level of commitment is required together with a willingness to take responsibility and take on new challenges. In return, the position will provide the opportunity to join a successful and dynamic team and extensive opportunities for professional and personal growth.
  
  
**Main Accountabilities:**

* Lead and oversee Upstream Facilities Engineering input into studies, providing technical guidance and strategic direction.
* Manage multi-disciplinary design teams to deliver early-phase studies on time, within scope, and to quality standards.
* Ensure compliance with applicable engineering standards, codes, and management of change processes throughout design and execution phases.
* Monitor project and study progress, track deliverables, and assist in preparing management reports to support decision-making.
* Collaborate closely with client personnel and Genesis engineering specialists to ensure project compliance, quality, and alignment with Genesis standards.
* Prepare clear, comprehensive study reports and presentations that effectively communicate findings and recommendations.
* Develop integrated study plans aligned with asset planning and business objectives, facilitating effective communication of facilities engineering activities both onshore and offshore.
* Lead project meetings, coordinate activities, and manage study performance to ensure objectives are met efficiently.
* Participate in design reviews, construction planning, HAZID/HAZOP sessions, and technical impact assessments to ensure safety and technical integrity.
* Develop innovative, cost-effective technical solutions using the latest industry design criteria and best practices.
* Interface with third-party engineering consultants and contractors, providing technical guidance and ensuring deliverables meet project standards.
* Collaborate with tendering teams to develop high-quality proposals and bid submissions in response to client inquiries.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by developing and implementing best practices, work processes, and tools, incorporating lessons learned to enhance project delivery.

The above is an outline of key duties and accountabilities, rather than an exclusive or exhaustive list of responsibilities. The post holder is expected to undertake any tasks which may reasonably be expected within the scope of the position.
  
  
**Required Skills and Experience:**
Languages:
*English (Fluent)*
Main skills:
  
  

* Degree qualified or with significant experience working in the oil and gas industry or similar industry
* Previous experience of working as part of and leading a multi-discipline team on facilities engineering studies / projects in the Upstream Industry
* Proven experience in developing solutions for greenfield and brownfield project environments, incorporating installation and constructability assessments
* Proven experience in brownfield modifications and debottlenecking studies
* Competence in supporting the development of cost and schedule estimates
* Exposure to and understanding of oil and gas Operator value drivers and stage gate project delivery processes
* Detailed knowledge of relevant international standards, Client and project specific standards
* Able to work independently and within integrated local and virtual teams
* Current offshore survival and medical certificates desired but not essential
* Flexibility for ad-hoc travel both within India and abroad
* Strong personal values and willing to take clear personal accountability for actions
* Demonstrated verbal and written communication and presentation skills. This requires the ability to articulate in a clear, concise and constructive manner at the appropriate level for the intended audience
* Produces work of accurate and presentable quality in the appropriate formats
* Good organizational skills, SMART working methods and can demonstrate personal effectiveness in previous roles
* Comfortable working with a variety of teams and parts of the organization
* Self-motivated and able to deliver in a goal orientated working environment
* Offshore experience preferred
* Experience in an operations or engineering project role preferred
* Experience in asset life extension projects preferred
* Experience working with FPSOs and Semi-Submersible Platforms is an advantage
* Experience developing teams and working cross boarders essential

Bachelor's or Master's (preferred) Degree in Engineering (Chemical/Petroleum/Mechanical), with 15-20 years of relevant industry experience.
  
  
Commitment to continuous professional development (Chartered Engineer preferred)

title: Program Manager I
description:
**Job Requirements**
**Role – Program Manager – Digital Banking Compliance, Risk & Governance**
**Function/Department –**
Digital Banking
  
  
**Location – BKC Mumbai**
**Job Purpose:**
**The Program Manager – Compliance, Digital Banking will drive the end-to-end regulatory, compliance, operational risk, audit and third-party governance agenda for Digital Banking. The role acts as a central coordination point across Digital Banking and key control and governance functions, ensuring regulatory commitments, audit observations, risk events, vendor assessments and governance requirements are tracked through to timely closure.**
**This is a hands-on programme governance role requiring strong understanding of banking regulations, digital banking controls, audit management, third-party risk and regulatory reporting, combined with the ability to drive multiple stakeholders to closure.**
**Primary Responsibilities:**
Regulatory & Compliance Governance
  
  

* Own and coordinate the compliance governance agenda for Digital Banking programmes.
* Ensure timely preparation and submission of monthly and quarterly RBI regulatory reporting and coordinate responses to regulatory queries.
* Track regulatory commitments and maintain supporting documentation and evidence for review.
* Coordinate closure of RBI CSITE observations relevant to Digital Banking.
* Maintain regulatory and compliance trackers with clear ownership, target dates, evidence and closure status.
* Coordinate periodic review and update of the Internet and Mobile Banking Policy, including governance required for Board approval.

Audit & Observation Management
  
  

* Coordinate and support Internal Audit, Compliance reviews and thematic audits covering Digital Banking.
* Review and coordinate responses relating to processes, policies, regulatory requirements and internal controls.
* Drive closure of audit and compliance observations with business, technology and control-function SPOCs.
* Maintain centralised tracking of observations, remediation commitments and closure evidence, with timely escalation of ageing items.

Operational Risk & KRI Management
  
  

* Coordinate timely submission of all Digital Banking Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) with ISG, BTO, RCU and relevant stakeholders.
* Coordinate with BORM for closure of risk events raised against Digital Banking.
* Gather, validate and maintain supporting evidence from business and technology SPOCs.
* Coordinate submission of Self-Testing reports to Operational Risk and track open risk items through closure.

Third-Party Risk & Vendor Governance
  
  

* Act as Vendor Relationship Manager (VRM) for regulatory and risk-governance requirements relating to Digital Banking vendors.
* Coordinate with TPRM, Procurement, ISG and business stakeholders for vendor governance and regulatory requirements.
* Drive Vendor Assessment Reviews, Materiality Assessments, RTTs, TPSA periodic assessments, remediation and closure of vendor findings.
* Maintain visibility of vendor-related compliance gaps, observations and upcoming assessments.

Business Continuity & Resilience
  
  

* Coordinate Digital Banking BCM and Business Impact Analysis (BIA) requirements.
* Ensure required evidence and artefacts are collected and submitted within agreed timelines.
* Work with technology, business and risk stakeholders to drive closure of gaps arising from BCM/BIA exercises.

SOP, Policy & Control Governance
  
  

* Facilitate periodic updates to the Optimus Programme SOP and coordinate with ORM, Compliance and RCU for submission to Operational Risk.
* Maintain documentation and evidence supporting key Digital Banking controls.
* Coordinate periodic control reviews and ensure identified gaps are tracked through closure.

Programme Governance & PMO
  
  

* Establish an integrated governance view covering regulatory requirements, audits, risk events, KRIs, policies, vendor risks and compliance observations.
* Establish clear owners, milestones, dependencies and closure evidence for governance items.
* Prepare management-level dashboards highlighting open items, upcoming commitments, ageing observations and areas requiring intervention.
* Facilitate governance forums and follow up with respective SPOCs until closure.
* Support the CBDC squad from a PMO and governance perspective.

Secondary
**Responsibilities :**

* Timely regulatory submissions and RBI responses
* Closure of RBI CSITE, Internal Audit and Compliance observations
* Monthly Digital Banking KRI submissions and timely closure of BORM risk events
* Current and approved Optimus Programme SOP and Internet & Mobile Banking Policy governance
* BCM/BIA submissions and evidence
* TPRM and TPSA assessment coordination and vendor compliance closure
* Self-Testing reporting to Operational Risk

Skills and Attributes
  
  

* Strong understanding of banking compliance and operational-risk governance.
* Understanding of RBI regulatory expectations applicable to digital banking.
* Working knowledge of audit-management and observation-closure processes.
* Knowledge of third-party/vendor risk-management principles, including TPRM/TPSA.
* Strong programme and stakeholder-management capability.
* Ability to translate regulatory/control requirements into actionable deliverables.
* Strong documentation, evidence management and executive reporting skills.
* Exposure to cybersecurity, technology-risk controls, BCM/BIA, KRIs, Internet/Mobile Banking, Payments or CBDC programmes is advantageous.

**Qualifications:**
Graduation: B.Sc., B.Tech, or B.E. Post-Graduation: MBA or PGDM
  
  
**Experience:**
4+ years of relevant experience in digital product management.
  
  
Industry : Digital Banking Business & Product
  
  

* Digital Banking Technology
* Compliance
* Operational Risk / ORM
* BORM
* RCU
* ISG
* BTO
* Internal Audit

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We encourage you to read more about our commitment to diversity and Environmental, Social & Governance (ESG) efforts.
  
  
**Lincoln International follows a hybrid work structure with an emphasis on in office collaboration.
  
  
Our employees work in our offices Monday through Thursday each week, with the option to work remotely or from the office on Fridays.**
The Senior Data Coordinator will serve as the day-to-day lead for a team of Data Specialists supporting strategic data, technology, and operational initiatives across Lincoln International's Valuations & Opinions Group. This is a hands-on working-lead role. In addition to setting daily priorities, coordinating workloads, coaching early-career team members, and reviewing work quality, this individual will be expected to perform the team’s core data and operational responsibilities as needed, particularly during periods of high volume, complex assignments, or limited team capacity.
  
  
The role will support client onboarding to Lincoln's next-generation valuation platform (Anaplan), private-market data collection and reporting, functional testing of new platform capabilities, ongoing support for valuation technology platforms, and continuous improvement initiatives, including emerging AI and data-extraction solutions.
  
  
The successful candidate will work closely with the Anaplan Technology team, Data & Analytics, the Salesforce Data team, Product teams, and valuation professionals. The role requires strong operational discipline, financial acumen, project coordination skills, and the ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders while keeping the team focused, organized, and accountable.
  
  
**Duties & Responsibilities:**
Team Leadership & Daily Operations
  
  

* Provide day-to-day direction, coaching, and support to a team of Data Specialists, serving as the primary point of coordination for daily activities.
* Set priorities, assign work, and balance team capacity across multiple onboarding, data, testing, and support workstreams.
* Review team output for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timeliness, reinforcing clear quality standards and expectations.
* Monitor productivity, turnaround times, and workflow bottlenecks; proactively adjust assignments and escalate risks when needed.
* Promote knowledge sharing, cross-training, and consistent documentation to strengthen team coverage and reduce key-person dependencies.
* Support the onboarding and development of new team members through structured guidance, feedback, and hands-on coaching.
* Remain actively involved in day-to-day execution and perform the core responsibilities of the Data Specialist team as needed, including completing complex or time-sensitive assignments, addressing capacity constraints, and modeling expected quality standards.

Client Onboarding & Project Coordination
  
  

* Coordinate the onboarding of valuation clients onto Lincoln's Anaplan platform, ensuring required data, activities, and stakeholders are aligned.
* Manage multiple concurrent onboarding, testing, and operational initiatives.
* Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, dependencies, issue logs, and status updates.
* Identify delivery risks and resource constraints early, communicate impacts clearly, and coordinate appropriate next steps.
* Facilitate cross-functional execution across Data & Analytics, the Anaplan Technology team, the Salesforce Data team, Product teams, and other Business Enablement partners.

Data Quality, Governance & Reporting
  
  

* Oversee the collection, validation, maintenance, and reporting of private-market data.
* Establish and reinforce quality-control procedures that improve data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timeliness.
* Investigate data exceptions and recurring issues, coordinate resolution, and recommend sustainable process improvements.
* Maintain clear process documentation, operating procedures, and ownership standards to support scalable execution.
* Provide stakeholders with visibility into work status, data-quality issues, and outstanding dependencies.

Product & Technology Support
  
  

* Partner with the Anaplan Technology team on new platform capabilities and enhancements, including requirements clarification, functional testing, issue documentation, and validation of fixes.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing and ensure test scenarios, results, defects, and follow-up actions are documented clearly.
* Support valuation technology platforms by triaging user questions, coordinating issue resolution, and identifying recurring support needs.
* Support the evaluation and responsible adoption of emerging AI and data-extraction solutions that improve team productivity and data-processing capabilities.

**Qualifications:**
Interested candidates should demonstrate the following experience and capabilities:
  
  
**Required Experience & Skills**

* Approximately 7-8 years of relevant experience in data operations, financial analysis, valuation, financial reporting, or a related field.
* Experience providing day-to-day leadership, coaching, or work coordination for junior or early-career team members.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong project coordination skills, including planning, milestone tracking, risk identification, issue management, and status communication.
* Analytical foundation with an understanding of financial statements and strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
* Strong working knowledge of the team’s core data, financial analysis, and operational processes, with the ability and willingness to independently complete, troubleshoot, and provide guidance on the work performed by Data Specialists.
* Experience analyzing or preparing company financials, financial models, valuation analyses, or related reporting.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with close attention to detail and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
* Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and build productive working relationships across levels and functions.
* Ability to periodically work extended hours, in the office or remotely, as required to support business deadlines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CFA designation completed or actively being pursued.
* Experience with Anaplan or another enterprise planning or workflow platform.
* Experience with SQL, Power BI, or other data and reporting tools.
* Experience supporting technology implementations, functional testing, or user acceptance testing.
* Experience in financial services, investment banking, valuation, or a related professional-services environment.

Professional & Cultural Characteristics
  
  

* High integrity and personal values consistent with Lincoln's Culture Statement: Excellence, Entrepreneurship, Integration, Collaboration, and Integrity.
* Proactive, organized, and self-motivated, with the judgment to identify priorities and move work forward with limited supervision.
* Resourceful problem solver who can identify root causes, recommend practical solutions, and follow through on execution.
* Confident and articulate communicator who provides clear direction and escalates issues constructively.
* Collaborative, team-oriented, and comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment with evolving priorities.
* Committed to developing others while remaining willing to work hands-on alongside the team.
* Curious and adaptable, with a strong interest in learning new financial concepts, technologies, and operating processes.
* Driven by high-quality outcomes and motivated by achieving both individual and team goals.

title: Assistant Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection.  Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. We hire individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and experiences and invest heavily in our teammates and their families by offering competitive benefits to support their physical, emotional, and financial well-being.
  
  
Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.
  
  
Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting & Reconciliations, Management Reporting & Analysis, Research & Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support & Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
  
  
The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications.  The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting & regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
  
  
**Job Description\***
This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1) understanding the Change, (2) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams & Users until implementation of the Change.  It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements.  The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements.  This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc.  Collaborate with the Users & procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in-house GRIFFIN & AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology & Testing Teams where relevant.

**Requirements\***
**Education\***
Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
  
  
Certifications If Any - AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
  
  
**Experience Range\***
5 to 8 years
  
  
**Foundational skills\***

* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast-paced, every-changing, highly collaborative environment.
* Strong knowledge of creating process maps
* Strong relationship management and interpersonal skills, ability to build strong rapport, respect and trust with key stakeholders and constituents.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to identify/raise questions, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, and good with numbers
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products (particularly MS Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint)

**Desired Skills**

* Exposure to projects in Financial Accounting and reporting (in Financial Control / Product Control/Treasury), and/or in Risk Regulatory reporting (Market or Counterparty risk) in financial services industry
* Expertise in Axiom Regulatory platform (if possible, AXIOM certified)
* Knowledge of Banking and Capital market products

* Knowledge/ Experience with Copilot/ Other AI tools usage in day-to-day BAU processes
* SQL, Database knowledge & ability to analyze data and related flows
* Knowledge of Agile methodology and tools (i.e., JIRA)

11:30 am to 8:30 pm

title: ERP Global Transformation Director
description:
Job Title: ERP Global Transformation Director

Location: Mumbai/ Gurgaon

**Purpose of the job:**
The ERP Global Transformation Director is accountable for the successful delivery and governance of the global ERP transformation program. This role provides strategic leadership across multiple ERP projects and workstreams, ensuring alignment with business objectives, program methodology, timelines, and organizational priorities. The incumbent partners closely with Program Delivery, TDDI (IT), Project Directors, and business stakeholders to manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive execution excellence. The role oversees program governance, roadmap management, and Control Tower operations, providing real-time visibility into program performance, deployment readiness, and business outcomes across all regions.

**Primary Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Program Governance & Delivery Excellence: Establish and maintain ERP program governance, delivery methodologies, standards, controls, and ways of working in partnership with Program Delivery and TDDI leadership. Ensure consistent application of project management disciplines, decision-making frameworks, and performance measures across the program.
* Strategic Roadmap Leadership: Own and steer the global ERP roadmap, including planning, milestone tracking, deployment sequencing, resource alignment, and execution oversight. Ensure program objectives are achieved in accordance with commitments, timelines, and business priorities
* Project Delivery Oversight:
  Provide leadership, guidance, and support to Project Directors to ensure successful delivery of ERP projects. Drive accountability for scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk management, and achievement of business outcomes.
* Cross-Functional Integration & Dependency Management: Coordinate interdependencies across projects, workstreams, business functions, and technology teams. Identify and resolve conflicts, risks, and issues that could impact program delivery, ensuring alignment across the transformation portfolio.
* Program Performance & Control Tower Management: Lead the ERP Control Tower function to provide real-time visibility into program performance. Develop and maintain executive dashboards, KPI reporting, risk monitoring, and deployment readiness metrics to support informed decision-making.
* Executive Stakeholder & Change Leadership: Partner with senior business leaders, technology teams, and external stakeholders to drive alignment, engagement, and commitment to transformation objectives. Facilitate governance forums, executive communications, and organizational readiness activities to support successful adoption.

* **Education:**
  Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. Master's degree (MBA or related discipline) considered an asset.

* **Functional Experience:**
  15+ years of progressive experience leading large-scale transformation, ERP implementation, or enterprise technology programs. Experience overseeing global, multi-country ERP deployments. Extensive experience managing complex portfolios consisting of multiple projects and workstreams.

* **Leadership, Supervisory, and/or Managerial Experience:**
  Extensive experience in leading senior project managers, program managers, and cross-functional transformation teams. Proven experience influencing and leading through matrix organizations.

* **Certification:**
  PMP, PGMP, PRINCE2, Agile, SAFe, or comparable project/program management certification preferred. ERP platform certifications (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, etc.) considered an asset.

* **Technical skills:**
  Advanced program and portfolio management expertise. Strong understanding of ERP implementation methodologies and deployment frameworks. Experience with project management tools, dashboards, KPI reporting, and business intelligence solutions. Advanced financial management, risk management, and governance reporting skills.

* **Other Minimum Qualifications:**
  Exceptional executive communication and presentation skills. Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to influence senior stakeholders across functions and geographies. Proven ability to manage ambiguity and lead through organizational change. Demonstrated experience managing large-scale business transformation initiatives.

* **Financial Scope, Managed Volume, Annual Budget managed, Budgeted Revenue:**
  Responsible for oversight of a global ERP transformation program with multi-million-dollar investment value. Accountable for monitoring program budgets, resource allocation, and delivery performance.

* **Team:**
  1 PMO. Must collaborate with Direct management of senior program resources as assigned. Significant leadership of cross-functional and matrixed teams globally.

* **Other scope-related measures not mentioned above:**
  Multiple countries, business units, and functional workstreams. Enterprise-wide ERP transformation impacting finance, supply chain, HR, operations, procurement, and technology functions. Executive-facing role with regular interaction with senior leadership and steering committees.

title: Client Servicing Executive
description:
**Client Servicing Executive**

**Location:**
Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

**Experience:**
1–3 years

**About the Company**

Bright Brain Marketing Technologies LLP is a digital marketing agency specializing in digital advertising and communication design. The company helps mid-sized and large organizations achieve marketing goals through digital media strategy, campaign management, communication design, and search engine optimization. Its campaign expertise spans brand awareness, lead generation, and sales outcomes, supported by structured execution and client-focused delivery. Bright Brain is committed to producing high-quality work that exceeds client expectations, combining strategic thinking with dependable coordination and creative problem-solving. The team includes talented professionals who are passionate about their work and focused on achieving excellence across client engagements. The organization aims to create a positive and supportive work environment where people can grow their capabilities, contribute meaningfully, and develop their careers. This role will contribute directly to client satisfaction, account continuity, and the effective delivery of digital marketing programs.

**About the Role**

As Client Servicing Executive, you will own day-to-day relationships for a portfolio of digital marketing clients and act as the primary point of contact. You will translate client requirements into clear delivery plans, coordinate internal teams, track commitments, and maintain momentum across multiple accounts. The role requires substantial client interaction, including regular meetings, presentations, performance updates, and follow-ups. You will independently manage at least four client accounts, understand performance marketing and SEO deliverables, and provide practical strategic inputs when clients raise questions or identify new needs. Success means clients receive timely, accurate communication, internal teams have clear priorities, issues are escalated early, and campaigns progress against agreed objectives. You will also maintain reliable records, meeting notes, task trackers, and reports so that account decisions and delivery status remain visible. This is an execution-focused opportunity for someone who combines organization, confidence in client conversations, and a proactive approach to solving problems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own client communication for at least four accounts, ensuring requirements, decisions, timelines, and next steps are clearly captured and converted into coordinated delivery actions.
* Present campaign updates, performance reports, recommendations, and delivery status to clients, translating digital marketing metrics into clear business-relevant insights.
* Coordinate internal media, creative, SEO, and account teams through structured follow-ups, maintaining delivery plans and reducing delays across active client workstreams.
* Monitor client satisfaction and account health by responding proactively to queries, identifying risks early, and escalating issues with context, urgency, and proposed next steps.
* Track campaign and project commitments using task trackers or project management tools, ensuring owners, deadlines, dependencies, and completion status remain accurate and visible.
* Prepare meeting agendas, detailed notes, minutes, reports, and follow-up communications that preserve accountability and enable consistent progress after every client interaction.
* Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced agency environment while protecting communication quality, delivery accuracy, and client retention across the assigned portfolio.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* 1–3 years of client servicing or account management experience, preferably within a digital marketing agency, with demonstrated ownership of multiple client accounts.
* Strong understanding of performance marketing metrics and reporting across platforms such as Meta and Google Ads, with the ability to explain results confidently.
* Working knowledge of SEO services and broader digital marketing solutions, enabling effective coordination of specialists and credible client conversations.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, interpersonal, and relationship management skills, supported by strong client-facing confidence.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office, including structured documentation, reporting, presentations, spreadsheets, and communication records.
* Familiarity with project management software, task trackers, delivery plans, and issue escalation practices for managing concurrent account requirements.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, problem-solving ability, and proactive ownership when handling queries, dependencies, and changing priorities.

**Additional Plus**

* Experience independently managing four or more client accounts and serving as the primary point of contact across ongoing agency engagements.
* Experience preparing and presenting performance updates, campaign reports, meeting minutes, and strategic recommendations directly to clients.
* Exposure to coordinating paid media, SEO, creative, communication design, or integrated digital marketing deliverables.

**What You'll Bring**

* A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or a related field, combined with 1–3 years of relevant client servicing, customer support, account management, or digital marketing agency experience.
* Evidence of meaningful client facetime, including leading discussions, presenting updates, documenting decisions, and following through on commitments without requiring constant supervision.
* The ability to independently manage at least four client accounts while balancing timelines, internal dependencies, reporting requirements, and changing client priorities.
* Clear understanding of performance marketing metrics, including the ability to discuss Meta and Google Ads results and connect campaign indicators to client objectives.
* Practical awareness of SEO and other digital marketing services, allowing you to coordinate specialists and provide informed first-level responses to client queries.
* Strong relationship management skills, with the judgment to distinguish routine requests from delivery risks and escalate issues early with useful context.
* High standards of organization and detail in task trackers, reports, meeting notes, records, and follow-up communication.
* A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and comfort working in a fast-paced agency environment where quality, responsiveness, and client retention matter.

**Why Join Us**

* Own meaningful client relationships and see your coordination directly influence campaign delivery, client satisfaction, account continuity, and measurable marketing outcomes.
* Build broad exposure across digital advertising, SEO, communication design, reporting, and integrated campaign execution while working with experienced internal specialists.
* Grow in a supportive environment that values high-quality work, professional development, proactive problem-solving, and opportunities to strengthen client-facing and strategic skills.

**What We Offer**

* Hybrid work arrangement based in Churchgate, Mumbai, with a Monday-to-Friday schedule and working hours from 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM.
* Opportunity to work across digital advertising, performance marketing, SEO, communication design, and client relationship management within a collaborative agency environment.
* A supportive workplace focused on quality delivery, continuous learning, professional growth, and meaningful ownership of client outcomes.

title: Product Project Manager
description:
**Role Overview**

We are seeking a Product Project Manager to drive end-to-end delivery of multi-product digital platforms within the capital markets ecosystem. The role spans RMS/OMS middleware, web, mobile, back-office systems, and open APIs.

The ideal candidate combines a strong understanding of trading workflows with technical systems fluency, cross-functional leadership, and disciplined delivery governance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of features across middleware, APIs, web, mobile, and back-office platforms.
* Coordinate cross-functional engineering teams across Backend (Golang), Frontend (React), Mobile (Flutter), QA, DevOps, and Infrastructure.
* Manage integrations with stock exchanges, clearing corporations, and depositories.
* Conduct impact analysis for regulatory changes and exchange-driven requirements.
* Define release strategies, dependency mapping, deployment plans, and rollback procedures.
* Ensure API versioning discipline and backward compatibility across services.
* Track delivery and reliability metrics, including defect leakage, release quality, incident management, and Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR).
* Align business priorities with engineering capacity through structured scope and change management.
* Manage delivery risks, dependencies, escalations, and stakeholder expectations.
* Ensure timely delivery of critical releases while maintaining platform stability and compliance.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* Strong understanding of capital markets workflows, including order lifecycle, margining, settlement, and Depository Participant (DP) processes.
* Technical understanding of distributed systems, APIs, database migrations, and deployment models.
* Experience managing multi-service product platforms in fintech or capital markets.
* Proven ability to manage regulatory deadlines and high-risk production releases.
* Strong stakeholder management across business, engineering, and external entities.
* Experience coordinating technical teams and driving execution beyond status reporting and Agile ceremonies.

Good to Have

* Experience with high-concurrency, high-availability systems.
* Knowledge of Kafka-based event-driven architectures.
* Familiarity with cloud-native deployments, Kubernetes, and containerized environments.
* Experience with trading platforms, brokerage systems, RMS/OMS, or exchange integrations.

Must-haves

1. **Background as a BA:**
   either a current BA who wants to move into product, or someone who moved from BA to PM.
2. **Retail capital markets experience:**
   they have worked at a broker or on a trading or broking platform.
3. **Knows at least 2–3 broking workflows hands-on:**
   KYC/onboarding, clearing and settlement, MTM, MTF (margin trading), regulatory reporting, or trading/order flow.
4. **Writes user stories:**
   has turned business requirements into user stories, BRDs or FRDs that developers worked from.

**What We Are Not Looking For**

* Purely ceremony-driven Agile coordinators without delivery ownership.
* Project Managers without fintech or capital markets platform experience.
* Candidates whose experience is limited to documentation, reporting, and status tracking.
* Non-technical project managers without an understanding of system dependencies, APIs, and production releases.

Ideal Candidate Profile

A technically strong Product Project Manager with hands-on delivery governance experience in fintech or capital markets platforms. The candidate should understand trading workflows, coordinate multiple engineering teams, manage complex integrations, and confidently own high-risk releases and regulatory-driven changes.

title: Data Center Manager, Data Center Operations
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
You will be a proven manager with experience managing teams of high performers. You will have the ability to refine and develop processes to optimize operational excellence in every area of your role. You will be able to drive performance levels to achieve the pace at which we build and operate Data Centers in India for Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”). You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors.
  
  
You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. We encounter interesting, challenging & complex problems every day, being a technical manager in ADSIPL means that you can innovate to solve these issues and help drive Operations Excellence in all areas of your role.
  
  
Your day job at ADSIPL will include (but not limited to):
  
  

* Managing and developing teams of engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance.
* Maintaining existing co-located and in-house Data Centers
* Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
* Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
* Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors
* Liaising with internal teams & management groups
* Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers
* Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
* Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc.

What are we looking for in a successful AWS Returner Data Centre Manager (DCM) candidate along with the technical knowledge and experience.
  
  
People Management.
  
  
As a successful candidate you will have managed a team of at least 5 individuals, over a period of at least 3 years. You will be able to demonstrate how you have continued to improve performance of an existing team along with displaying skills in creating or growing a team. Experience managing both high & low performing employees will be of advantage along with conflict management.
  
  
Incident Management.
  
  
You will have a lot of experience dealing with high severity situations, show a clear understanding of the wider blast implications of any issue/outage and potential consequences of differing outcome scenarios. You will also have experience in Change Management & Fault Management.
  
  
Vendor Management.
  
  
An Amazon, individual has to deal with vendors, contractors & security companies. You will be able to prove you have experience dealing with external vendors and be able to display incidents of both problem & conflict management when dealing with same.
  
  
Process Improvement.
  
  
You will be able to demonstrate an ability of taking both a good working process & a bad process and improving. You will have experience in processes mapping, implementing remediation steps and how this affected the overall business you were working in. Experience in Kaizen/Lean/Six Sigma is preferable
  
  
Health & Safety.
  
  
Health & Safety should be at the forefront of every manager's mind. Managers should be able to positively influence the Safety culture of the Data Center organization.
  
  
**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
* 4+ years of data center engineering or operations experience
* 3+ years of managing technical teams with significant personnel management experience and examples of developing engineers and building successful teams experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or above in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field, or 4+ years of network and operating system support experience
* 1+ years of Agile methods and processes experience
* Experience in capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar
* Knowledge of Lean, Kaizen, Six Sigma concepts
* Experience implementing change management successfully transitioning programs into large-scale operations

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

- ADSIPL - Maharashtra

title: Senior Remediation Engineer - ENS
description:
**Description**
The Environmental Services (ENS) team at Burns & McDonnell India (BMI) is seeking a Senior Remediation Engineer to join our growing Remediation practice. In this role, you will be a critical part of a team dedicated to solving complex environmental challenges. You will contribute to projects aimed at cleaning up and restoring the environment by ensuring the quality of field data, assessing subsurface conditions, and developing effective remediation strategies for clientele within a variety of business sectors, including electrical utility, solid waste, mining, manufacturing, oil and gas, renewable energy, and others.
  
  
The individual will have the opportunity to take on project management responsibilities, tackling the most challenging environmental issues of today, leveraging cutting-edge technology applied in the remediation industry, including 3D visualization modeling, forensic studies and investigation, high resolution site characterization (HRSC), remediation systems engineering design, etc. Additionally, the ideal candidate will help grow our remediation team in India.
  
  
This position will provide technical support to our US teams. You will manage all aspects of environmental site assessment and remediation projects for USA-based sites from initial site assessments to hydrogeologic investigations, development of conceptual site models, contaminant fate and transport, remedial action design, and implementation. Experience with emerging contaminants of concern, including PFAS and experience investigating coal combustion residuals (CCR) is strongly preferred.
  
  
The successful candidate will develop and support multiple projects from a remediation and environmental engineering perspective, as well as manage and complete independent project tasks.
  
  
**The Senior Engineer Will Perform The Following Duties**

* Experience of working in diverse global teams, functioning seamlessly with US-based project managers and regional offices.This includes a demonstrated history of collaborating with US-based project teams to complete project- and portfolio-specific tasks.
* Function as a technical lead for environmental remediation and engineering projects and lead a team of local engineers and scientists to complete complex tasks.
* Produce technical reports and design documents focused on remediation projects that are of high quality, free of errors, and fit for release to US-based clientele.
* Evaluate US regulations guiding remediation projects and developing strategic project approaches to provide cost-effective solutions to legacy contamination.
* Perform analysis and interpretation of environmental data.
* Mentoring and working closely with junior-level environmental staff.
* Assist with recruiting, development, and training of staff.
* Other duties, as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in civil, environmental, or related engineering program.
* Minimum of 9 years of relevant experience. Preferably 15 years of experience with civil and environmental-related engineering projects for a variety of clientele, including electrical utility, solid waste, manufacturing, oil and gas, mining, and public sector.
* Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of US environmental regulations (e.g., EPA, state-specific codes) and design requirements.
* Ability to work independently or as part of a team.
* Experience investigating and managing coal combustion residual (CCR) related projects for power generation clients strongly preferred.
* Strong organization and time management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects at once and meet strict project deadlines.
* Drive collaborative efforts with US-based regional offices to deliver consistent, high-quality and appropriately scoped technical work.
* Experience directing and reviewing work products prepared by junior engineering staff.
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
* Ability to clearly communicate both verbal and written technical information with project team members.
* Demonstrated knowledge of civil and environmental engineering methods, permitting process, and construction compliance.
* Ability to perform rigorous quality reviews for environmental reports and deliverables.
