You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Primary responsibilities and SME fields include, but are not limited to:
  
  
**Operations And Maintenance**

* Ownership of all Data Center changes/events/incidents/problems from beginning to end as well as overseeing the completion of post-mortems, root cause analysis and follow-up resolution actions.
* Responsible for ensuring maintenance/ repairs of site-critical facility infrastructure or a Data Center are planned and executed to the best interest of the business.
* Responsible for Asset and Inventory management.
* Develop and maintain method statements, standard operating procedures, emergency response procedures, preventive maintenance programs, and all technical documentation.
* Ensure standardization and consistency with best-in-class operating practices. (Technical Writing Skills and Automation)
* Develop a complete, deep knowledge of the design intent, operational alternatives and contingency plans related to all Data Center systems.
* Manage the engineering aspects of the Data Centers related to financial and cost control, code and regulatory compliance, personnel management, staff training and development
* Health & Safety, local statutory requirements, environmental and energy management.
* Develop and deliver the regular engineering reports and ensure adherence to contracted deliverables including SLA’s and KPI’s.
* Communicate operating philosophies, technical information, objectives and expectations to Amazon personnel and to the vendor critical facilities management teams.
* Providing hands on facility support where required (e.g. installation of new equipment, decommissioning of equipment, replacement of faulty equipment, internal audits…etc.)
* Oversee technical compliance auditing and the effective and timely close out of corrective action plans. Perform annual operational reviews with a focus on compliance with the Amazon standards and all applicable regulatory requirements. (Audits).
* Manage the development and delivery of the portfolio of Energy/Environmental Management Programs. Keep abreast of Data Center industry innovation.

**Incident And Emergency Response**

* Reviewing incident reports, documenting periodic trend summaries, and providing updates and recommended actions to management.
* Managing information flow during incidents while providing regular updates to management.
* Manage and coordinate with vendors to resolve any incidents during emergency situations. This may require to physically be dispatched on to site to investigate and resolve the issue.

Key job responsibilities
  
  
The Data Center Engineering Operation Engineer is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating within contract parameters within facilities. Often this will be including risk management and mitigation, corrective and preventative maintenance of critical infrastructure, vendor management and metric reporting.
  
  

* Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
* Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of the data center facility infrastructure operations and maintenance.
* Work with DCO managers (IT) and other business leaders and operating partners to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability, sustainability and efficiency.
* Responsible for supporting the installation of the racks and the provision of power/cooling.

A day in the life
  
  

* Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA).
* Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, and facility management.

title: Open Secret - Senior Manager Supply Chain
description:
**About Us:**

Open Secret is a fast-growing, innovation-driven food & beverage brand making snacks for new India. We are on a mission to transform the way India snacks by creating a range of "unjunked" food options that are delicious, healthier, and guilt-free. We blend food science, great taste, and transparency to create better-for-you products families love.

Our Founder and CEO, Ahana Gautam, is a graduate from IIT Bombay and Harvard Business School, and has a strong FMCG background - Procter & Gamble and General Mills.

We are backed by a stellar group of investors - including Matrix, Sixth Sense, Ananta Capital, Vijay Shekhar Sharma, and other prominent leaders.

Join us in the Unjunked Revolution.

**Location:**
Bhandup - Mumbai (in office)

**Experience Level:**
6-7 years

**About the Role:**

As a Manager (Supply Chain) at Open Secret, you will be at the heart of our logistics and distribution strategy. We currently fulfil all orders from our Mumbai warehouse, and this role will own two critical mandates: (1) build and scale a multi-city warehouse and last mile network across India, and (2) improve the current supply chain performance. You will be the link between demand signals, inventory planning, and on-ground logistics execution.

You will report to the Head of Operations and also work closely with founder and senior leadership from day one, owning metrics that directly drive revenue on India's top e-commerce and quick-commerce platforms - Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, FK, Amazon, etc.

This is not just another desk job! If you enjoy getting your hands dirty with data, vendors, and real operational challenges - this will be fun.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Own end-to-end PO lifecycle: Supply planning, PO creation, GRN tracking, and fill-rate analysis across channels.

- Drive warehouse network expansion: Analyse city-level sales and inventory data to identify and stand up new fulfilment nodes beyond Mumbai.

- Build and manage a last-mile vendor ecosystem: Onboard 3PL partners, define delivery SLAs, and track TAT performance rigorously.

- Monitor On-Shelf Availability (OSA) daily across all SKUs and cities; diagnose availability drops and trigger replenishment actions proactively.

- Build inventory health dashboards tracking Days of Inventory (DOI), frontend/backend stock levels, Daily Run Rate (DRR) trends, and expiry risk.

- Collaborate with sales and demand planning teams to align PO scheduling with platform promotional calendars.

- Root-cause fulfilment gaps: Analyse deficit quantities, diagnose PO state failures, and drive on-time delivery improvements with vendors.

- Set up SOPs for new warehouse nodes covering inbound, storage, and dispatch protocols.

- Take ownership of evolving supply chain priorities, demonstrating agility and adaptability in addressing new or ambiguous challenges with speed and impact.

**Key Metrics You Will Own:**

- OSA (On-Shelf Availability): Weighted % of SKUs in-stock across dark stores; directly drives offtake and platform ranking.

- PO Fill Rate: Units delivered (GRN) vs. units ordered; reflects fulfilment accuracy and reliability.

- Lead Time: Days from PO creation to GRN; impacts replenishment cadence and stock-out risk.

- DOI (Days of Inventory): Determines reorder frequency and working capital.

- Fulfilment Gap: Delta between ordered and received quantity, by city and SKU.

- Inventory Value: Working capital tied up in front-end and back-end inventory across the warehouse network.

**Qualifications:**

- Bachelor's in engineering or related field from a tier-1 institution - IIT or BITS.

- 6 - 7 years of total work experience.

- Prior stints at companies such as Delhivery, Ecom Express, Dunzo, Shadowfax, Loadshare, Porter, or similar q-commerce / last-mile / logistics-tech startups.

- High proficiency in MS Office/Google Suite (especially Excel).

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare concise documents.

- Fast learner, detail-oriented, and excited to work in a high-growth, dynamic startup.

- Positive attitude, strong sense of ownership, and willingness to go beyond the job description as needed.

**What's in It for You?:**

- Greenfield mandate - you design and build the supply chain network from scratch, not maintain someone else's legacy system.

- Direct exposure to q-commerce operations at scale across India's top platforms.

- Exposure to business strategy and decision-making at top leadership level.

- Chance to work across diverse functions and fast-track your learning.

- Direct mentorship from founders and senior leaders.

- Accelerated growth opportunities in a growing F&B startup.

title: Organic Growth Lead (US Market)
description:
Work Timings - 5 PM to 2 AM IST (US Eastern Time Zone)

Location - Mumbai Office (Andheri East) - In-Person Role

Pepper helps brands win
**organic search, AI search, and every organic channel that drives growth**
. We're building an AI-native customer success team, and we're looking for an
**Organic Growth Lead**
to own organic growth for a small set of our customers across search, AI engines, and channel-level distribution.

Search is changing fast. Buyers now discover brands through Google, through AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews, and through communities and creators on YouTube, LinkedIn, and Reddit. We're looking for someone who understands this new landscape deeply and can confidently build growth across all of it.

If that sounds like the work you want to be known for, this one's for you.

About the role

As an Organic Growth Lead, you'll be the growth partner for a focused set of accounts (around 5–6). You'll set the growth direction, work alongside an SEO Lead, and lead a small pod that brings the plan to life. You won't do it alone — you'll have a strong team, proven playbooks, our AI workflows, and a center of excellence behind you.

This is a role where strategy and delivery come together: you decide what will move the needle for each customer across SEO, GEO, and distribution, then make sure it actually ships.

What you'll do

* Own the growth plan for your accounts — what we focus on, the pace, and the channels that matter most for each customer
* Partner with an SEO Lead and guide a pod (content, SEO/GEO, distribution, and project management) where everyone does one job really well
* Run and refine our AI-powered content and SEO workflows (we'll train you on these)
* Keep customers close with clear communication, regular reviews, and honest reporting
* Connect the work back to outcomes that matter: organic growth that turns into pipeline

Win in AI Search and GEO

This is central to the role, not a side skill. You'll own how our customers show up in AI-driven search:

* Build a clear point of view on how AI engines — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews — retrieve, rank, and cite brands, and what it takes to be the answer they surface
* Shape content, entities, and authority signals so our customers get cited and recommended by AI engines, not just ranked on a blue-link page
* Run GEO audits and turn them into concrete fixes: structure, schema, entity coverage, citability, and brand attribution
* Stay ahead of how AI search is evolving and translate that into an advantage for every account

Own channel-level distribution

Great content only wins when it reaches the right place. You'll build distribution strategy that goes well beyond the website, with a real understanding of how each channel actually works:

* **SEO / GEO**
  — search and AI-answer visibility as the foundation
* **YouTube**
  — search and suggested-led discovery, and how video compounds organic reach
* **LinkedIn**
  — founder- and brand-led organic reach and thought leadership
* **Reddit and communities**
  — authentic presence plus the growing role of community content in both Google and AI search
* **Digital PR**
  — authority, links, and building the brand as a recognised entity

You'll decide which channels matter for each customer, why, and how they reinforce each other — then drive the pod to execute.

What you'll bring

* Strong experience in SEO, content, or organic growth, with a real understanding of how organic compounds over time
* A confident grasp of
  **GEO and AI search**
  — or a deep curiosity and the drive to become an expert fast
* An understanding of
  **channel-level distribution**
  : how YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit, and Digital PR each work, and how to use them together
* An ownership mindset: you like setting direction, not just ticking off tasks
* Comfort using AI tools to work faster and better — we'll help you level up
* Strong communication and the ability to build trust with customers
* The ability to juggle a few accounts and keep them all moving

Nice to have

* Hands-on experience improving AI-search visibility and earning AI citations
* A background in agencies, consulting, or in-house growth teams
* Proven results on a specific distribution channel (YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit, or Digital PR)
* A habit of turning wins into repeatable systems and SOPs

Why you'll love it here

* You'll be at the heart of Pepper's shift to an AI-native growth team, working on the most interesting problem in search right now
* Real support: structured onboarding, workshops (including SEO/GEO audits), playbooks, and a sharp engineering team building tools for you
* A focused book of accounts so you can go deep, not spread thin
* Plenty of room to grow as we scale this team

title: Project Manager - Civil (Hospital Background)
description:
At Turner & Townsend we’re passionate about making the difference. That means delivering better outcomes for our clients, helping our people to realize their potential, and doing our part to create a prosperous society.

Every day we help our major global clients deliver ambitious and highly technical projects, in over 110 offices worldwide.

**Job Description**

Turner & Townsend are looking for Project Manager to join our award winning, for Delhi cost centre, growing project management team working within Turner & Townsend's team.

There are long term secured frameworks with national and regional organisations within the following sectors - Retail, Commercial, Industrial, Education, etc.

The right candidate will have the opportunity to progress within our business and receive a competitive salary. There will also be the opportunity to support internal business initiatives and development, in order to offer our people an all-round exposure to the business. The successful candidate must be able to demonstrate consultancy experience.

**Role within the project:**

* To lead Project Management Commissions, taking responsibility for end to end service delivery.
* To provide support on major Project Management Commissions, taking responsibility for an aspect of service delivery.
* To ensure that client objectives are met and that projects are delivered to time and cost targets and the appropriate quality standards.

**Scope**

Project Managers handle commissions of varying sizes, depending upon the complexity of the project, etc. Typically, projects fall within the Rs5cr to Rs10cr range. When in a supporting role, the project size may be far greater.

**Responsibilities:**

* Helping to establish the overall success criteria for the project, including time, cost, technical and performance parameters
* Identifying and ensuring that the appropriate line manager is aware of quality, safety, health and environment issues
* Establishing effective project governance, processes and systems to be utilised throughout project
* Project planning, including producing the detailed project plan
* Advising upon the procurement of resources
* Leading and facilitating the overall cross-functional project team
* Monitoring and applying performance management techniques
* Managing the change control process
* Monitoring and advising upon project finances
* Managing the flow of project information between the team and the client, through regular meetings and written communications
* Preparing formal project progress and other reports
* Taking a leading role in interfacing with the client and other consultants, at all project stages

**Marketing and business development, to include:**

* Identifying opportunities to develop new business with existing clients and reporting such opportunities to the appropriate line manager
* Assisting in the production of bid documentation
* Ensuring that project case study, photograph and project CV files are kept up to date
* Identifying ways in which project management products and services can be improved and referring ideas to the appropriate line manager
* Understanding the Turner & Townsend 2+2=5 philosophy and identifying cross-divisional opportunities
* **Internal management accountabilities, to include:**
* Knowledge management – Ensuring that key information and learning generated from each project is input into the Turner & Townsend internal database
* Financial management – Ensuring prompt client invoicing and utilising TIC Sheets in order to monitor a project’s financial status
* Process improvement – Identifying ways in which internal systems and processes can be improved and referring ideas to the appropriate line manager

**Reporting**

* Depending upon context, a Project Manager is likely to report to a Senior Project Manager or Associate Director.

**Qualifications**

* Education - B.E/ B.Tech/ B.Arch – Civil
* Post Graduate Qualification in relevant field would be an added advantage.
* You should have relevant experience of working for a construction consultancy in India, be degree educated in a relevant construction subject and have good technical skills.
* 10 - 15 years of post-qualification experience in similar role.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

**Additional Information**

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/

title: Project Director/ Project Manager - Credit Risk Consulting
description:
**Highlight of the engagement opportunity**

* **Nature of role:**
  Full time
* **Number of years of experience expected:**
* **Project Manager:**
  8–13 years, including at least 5 years hands-on in credit risk modelling, credit analytics, credit policy, or regulatory capital.
* **Project Director:**
  13–20 years, including at least 7 years in the above, with proven ownership of delivery, revenue, and client relationships.
* Candidates without direct credit risk modelling / analytics experience will not be shortlisted, regardless of general risk consulting pedigree.
* **Areas of past experience preferred / mandatory:**
* **Credit risk modelling and scorecards:**
  application, behavioural, collection, and bureau scorecards; credit rating and scoring models; PD / LGD / EAD models; scorecard development lifecycle including data preparation, WOE / IV analysis, logistic regression and machine learning models, cut-off setting, calibration, validation, monitoring, and redevelopment.
* **Credit risk policy and framework:**
  credit policy, underwriting and credit appraisal, delegation of authority, credit monitoring, early warning signals (EWS), restructuring, NPA / IRAC classification, provisioning, and write-off policy.
* **Regulatory capital and Basel:**
  credit RWA computation, Standardised and IRB (F-IRB / A-IRB) approaches, capital adequacy (CRAR), capital conservation buffer, leverage ratio, ICAAP, and stress testing.
* **Portfolio analytics:**
  vintage analysis, roll-rate and migration matrix, delinquency analysis, concentration risk, portfolio ECL, collections and recovery analytics.
* **IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109:**
  impairment model design, staging and SICR logic, ECL computation, macro-economic scenario design, and disclosures.
* **Model risk management:**
  model validation, model governance, model inventory, back-testing, benchmarking, sensitivity and outcome analysis, and ongoing monitoring.
* **Regulatory frameworks:**
  RBI guidelines on credit risk, ECL, IRAC, and provisioning; Basel III / IV; Middle East regulatory context (CBUAE, SAMA, CBB, QCB, CBO, CBK / CMA Kuwait) preferred.
* Consulting or in-house risk analytics experience with banks, NBFCs, insurers, or corporates.
* **Educational qualification expected:**
  Graduate / Postgraduate
* **Additional qualifications / certifications required:**
  None
* **Preferable additional certifications:**
  CA / FRM / Actuarial / CQF / PRM / CFA
* **Preferred geography of previous work experience:**
  India / Europe / APAC / US / Middle East
* **Language requirements:**
  Ability to write and speak fluently in English
* **Application experience preferable:**
  MS Excel, VBA, Python, R, SAS, SQL

**Key responsibility areas:**

A. Engagement delivery and project leadership

* Independently lead and manage consulting engagements with leading banks, financial institutions, NBFCs, insurance companies, and corporates across credit risk modelling, credit policy, regulatory capital, IFRS 9, and model risk management.
* Own end-to-end delivery: scoping, project planning, resourcing, risk identification, mitigation, stakeholder coordination, and sign-off.
* Lead client conversations on methodology, assumptions, model design, policy interpretation, regulatory expectations, and business impact.
* Drive day-to-day execution of assigned client projects and produce regular status reporting for management on progress, challenges, and key milestones.
* Manage audit, internal review, and regulator interactions related to models, credit policy, capital computation, ECL, and provisioning.

B. Credit risk modelling and scorecards

* Lead development, review, and redevelopment of credit scorecards across the customer lifecycle: application, behavioural, collection, and bureau scorecards.
* Lead development and review of credit rating and scoring models, including PD, LGD, and EAD models for retail and wholesale portfolios.
* Own the full model development lifecycle: data preparation, treatment of missing values and outliers, WOE / IV analysis, variable selection, segmentation, model building (logistic regression, decision trees, gradient boosting, and other ML techniques), scaling, cut-off setting, and calibration.
* Define and implement model monitoring frameworks: PSI, CSI, Gini / AUC, KS, lift, vintage and stability analysis, and trigger-based redevelopment.
* Support credit strategy design, including approval / rejection / limit assignment strategies and risk-based pricing inputs.
* Produce clear, defensible model documentation and validation-ready model development reports.

C. Credit risk policy, framework, and regulatory capital

* Review, design, and draft credit risk policies covering credit appraisal, underwriting, delegation of authority, collateral management, credit monitoring, EWS, restructuring, NPA / IRAC classification, provisioning, and write-off.
* Assess policy effectiveness against regulatory requirements and internal risk appetite, and recommend enhancements.
* Lead credit RWA computation under Standardized and IRB (F-IRB / A-IRB) approaches.
* Support capital adequacy (CRAR), capital conservation buffer, leverage ratio, ICAAP, and stress testing exercises.
* Build and review stress testing and scenario analysis frameworks for credit risk, including portfolio-level impact assessment.
* Interpret and apply RBI, Basel III / IV, and Middle East regulatory expectations on credit risk, capital, and provisioning.

D. Portfolio analytics

* Lead portfolio analytics covering vintage analysis, roll-rate and migration matrix, delinquency and bucket movement, concentration risk, and portfolio ECL.
* Build collections and recovery analytics, including recovery rate modelling and prepayment behaviour analysis.
* Develop portfolio dashboards and MIS for risk committees, boards, and regulators.
* Identify emerging risk trends and recommend corrective actions at portfolio level.

E. IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 impairment

* Lead IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 impairment workstreams covering staging, SICR assessment, ECL computation, and enhancement of ECL and provisioning approaches.
* Design and review macro-economic scenario design, satellite models, and forward-looking overlay adjustments.
* Support IFRS 9 transition and implementation, including parallel run, impact assessment, and disclosure requirements.
* Align IFRS 9 ECL with credit policy, provisioning policy, and regulatory capital frameworks.

F. Model risk management

* Lead model validation and independent review: conceptual soundness, data quality, methodology review, back-testing, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, and outcome analysis.
* Design and strengthen model risk management frameworks, including model governance, model inventory, model tiering, validation standards, and ongoing monitoring.
* Define model risk appetite, model risk reporting, and escalation protocols.
* Support regulatory and audit reviews on model risk management practices.

G. Practice, people, and business (Project Director emphasis)

* Lead and be responsible for team mentoring, project management, and client delivery.
* Own project revenue, margin, and resource utilization for assigned engagements.
* Generate business from existing clients and support pre-sales, proposals, and solutioning for new clients.
* Build and scale the credit risk consulting practice, including hiring, capability building, and reusable methodologies, scorecard templates, and accelerators.
* Represent Acies in client leadership forums and industry discussions on credit risk, IFRS 9, capital, and model risk.

**Other important information:**

* **Work permit requirements:**
  Either Indian Citizen or having valid works in India
* **Period of engagement:**
  Full time
* **Probation period:**
  6 months
* **Compensation:**
  Compensation varies depending on the skill, fitment and role played by the person. Compensation discussions will take place post the selection process.
* **Performance incentives:**
  Typically, all roles at Acies have a performance incentive. Specific aspects will be discussed during the compensation discussion
* **Leave:**
  19 working days a year. Additional leaves for national holidays, sick leaves, maternity and paternity, bereavement and studies vary based on the city and country of engagement.
* **Other benefits:**
  Other employment benefits including medical insurance will be informed during the compensation discussion.
* **Career growth for full-time roles:**
  Acies believes in a transparent and data-based performance evaluation system. You are encouraged to clarify any questions you have with respect to career growth with Acies personnel you interact with during the selection process.
* **Career opportunities for part-time roles:**
  Conversion of part-time roles to full-time roles depends on both performance of the individual and business needs. You are encouraged to ask about the prospects as you interact with Acies personnel during the selection process.
* **Global mobility:**
  Acies encourages mobility across our offices. Such mobility is, however, subject to business needs and regulations governing immigration and employment in various countries.

**Selection process:**

We seek to be transparent during the selection process. While the actual process may vary from the process indicated below, the key steps involved are as follows:

1. **Technical and modelling interview:**
   Deep-dive assessment of scorecard and rating model development, PD / LGD / EAD modelling, model validation, and credit policy experience.
2. **Case study / modelling round:**
   Practical scenario covering scorecard development, staging and ECL computation, capital computation, or model validation findings.
3. **Delivery and leadership interview:**
   Project ownership, stakeholder management, team leadership, and commercial acumen.
4. **Final discussion on career and compensation:**
   Post final selection, a separate discussion will be set up to discuss compensation and career growth.

The number of interview rounds may increase depending on the criticality and seniority of the role involved.

**Preparation required:**

It is recommended that you prepare on the following aspects before the selection process:

* Understanding of products and exposures in the financial services industry (Banks / NBFC / Insurance).
* Credit risk modelling concepts: PD, LGD, EAD, ECL, default rates, credit scores, recovery rates, and prepayment behaviour.
* Scorecard development lifecycle: data preparation, WOE / IV, segmentation, model building, scaling, cut-off setting, validation, and monitoring.
* Model monitoring metrics: PSI, CSI, Gini / AUC, KS, lift, vintage and stability analysis.
* Credit risk policy and framework: underwriting, credit appraisal, delegation of authority, EWS, restructuring, NPA / IRAC classification, provisioning, and write-off.
* Regulatory capital: credit RWA, Standardised and IRB approaches, CRAR, capital conservation buffer, leverage ratio, ICAAP, and stress testing.
* IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 standard requirements, including staging, SICR assessment, forward-looking information, and disclosure requirements.
* Model validation techniques: back-testing, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, and outcome analysis.
* Model risk management frameworks, model governance, and regulatory expectations.
* Regulatory frameworks: Basel III / IV, RBI guidelines on credit risk, ECL, and provisioning; Middle East regulatory context (CBUAE, SAMA, CBB, QCB, CBO, CBK / CMA Kuwait).
* Tools: SQL, Python, R, SAS, VBA, and advanced Excel.

For any additional queries you may have, you can send a LinkedIn InMail to us, connect with us at https://www.acies.consulting/careers-apply.html or e-mail us at careers@acies.holdings.

**How to reach us:**

Should you wish to apply for this job, please reach out to us directly through LinkedIn or apply on our website career page - https://www.acies.consulting/careers-apply.html

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Manager, Tax Services –**
**Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - SAP MM/FICO/SD integration with Direct or Indirect Tax experience**
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting practice is seeking a Manager, Tax Services professional to help clients modernize and improve their tax operations. In this role, you will lead SAP tax transformation and application managed services efforts, guide teams through complex delivery requirements, and help translate tax and business needs into technology-enabled solutions. You will work across tax, process, and technology teams to support scalable, compliant, and efficient tax functions.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager, Tax Services professional on the Tax Transformation Consulting team, you will be responsible for...
  
  

* Business Development: Develop and maintain contact with top decision makers at key clients; organize and lead pursuit teams; participate and lead aspects of the proposal development process; contribute to the development of proposal pricing strategies
* Client Management: Manage the day-to-day interactions with executive clients and sponsors
* Engagement Management: Lead engagement planning and budgeting; mobilize and manage engagement teams; define deliverable structure and content; facilitate buy-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client; direct on-time, quality delivery of work products; manage engagement economics; and manage engagement risk
* AMS Delivery & Operations Management: Own end-to-end delivery of SAP FICO/MM/SD tax AMS engagements, including SLA governance, ticket triage and escalation across L1/L2/L3, incident and problem management, and driving continuous improvement in support processes and tooling
* Practice Development & Eminence: Develop practical solutions and methodologies; develop "thought-ware" and "point-of-view" documents; participate in public speaking events; get published in industry periodicals
* People Development: Perform the role of counselor and coach; provide input and guidance into the staffing process; actively participate in staff recruitment and retention activities; provide leadership and support for delivery teams and staff in local offices

**The team**
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
  
  
Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients' tax departments move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients' objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients' global strategies with the options that exist to turn strategy into an executable plan.
  
  
TTC's Enterprise Tax Transformation (ETT) professionals provide an integrated approach to process improvement that can help the tax department maximize its strategic value to the organization. Companies that have already implemented, or are considering implementing, an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function's unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology, and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.
  
  
How you’ll grow At Deloitte - We’ve invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. No two people learn in the same way. So, we provide a range of resources including live classrooms, team-based learning, and eLearning. DU: The Leadership Center in India, our state-of-the-art, world-class learning Center in the Hyderabad offices is an extension of the Deloitte University (DU) in Westlake, Texas, and represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to our people’s growth and development. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.
  
  
Deloitte supports your progression through a well-defined career path by providing challenging assignments, mentoring, and targeted trainings. Recent postgraduates begin as a consultant. The career path from there is to senior consultant, then manager, senior manager and onto a path to director or partner or principal.
  
  
Deloitte’s culture
  
  
Our positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best work every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them to be healthy, centred, confident, and aware. We offer well-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture that is inclusive, invites authenticity, leverages our diversity, and where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives. Learn more about Life at Deloitte.
  
  
Corporate citizenship
  
  
Deloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people, and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities. Learn more about Deloitte’s impact on the world.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Mumbai/Pune/Gurugram/Chennai/Kolkata
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 8 to 15+ years of total experience
* 5+ years of implementation experience in SAP ECC 6.0 & S/4HANA with a focus on Tax integration across SAP FICO/MM/SD, including Direct or Indirect Tax experience
* Experience with tax technology applications such as ONESOURCE/Global Next Integration, Vertex Accelerator and Chainflow Accelerator Integration, Avalara, and Sovos
* Expert in Direct and Indirect Tax configuration, Withholding Taxes, local country indirect tax localizations, VAT customizations, and reporting
* Experience resolving high-priority L1 tickets and supporting L2/L3 tickets, with deep root-cause analysis for recurring system failures
* Experience with SLA compliance, monitoring performance metrics to ensure target resolution times are consistently met
* Experience with User Exits, preparing functional specifications, executing test cycles, cutovers, go-live and Hypercare, and providing user training and documentation
* Expert in cross-functional integration of modules - SD-FI and MM-FI
* Strong project management and leadership abilities, with the ability to independently drive project cycles and deliverables
* Relentless focus on quality of work products while adhering to completing deliverables on time
* Effective communication and strong presentation and team-building skills; proactive, participates in firm-based activities, and owns his/her career
* Strong analytical skills in business process design and requirements preparation
* Chartered Accountant, MBA, Master of Commerce (M.Com), or comparable/equivalent postgraduate qualification, with overall experience in Finance, Accounting, Taxation, and Audit

Preferred:
  
  

* SAP MM or SD (ECC or S/4HANA) Certified
* Experience with third-party tax engines such as Vertex, ONESOURCE, or Avalara, and knowledge of SAP DRC
* Experience with New GL, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Intercompany, Materials Management, Logistics Invoice Verification, and Asset Accounting implementation
* Experience with ITSM/incident management tools such as ServiceNow, BMC Remedy, or JIRA, including SLA dashboards and incident/problem management reporting

**Our purpose**

Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. title: Sr. Product & Automation Lead
description:
**Job Title: Sr. Product & Automation Lead**

**Company:**
Scale100x.ai by Expertrons

**Location:**
Mumbai (Work from Office)

**Compensation:**
Ranging from ₹12 LPA to 20 LPA (Fixed + Variable) + ESOPs + milestone-based compensation growth

**Experience:**
5+ years

**About Scale100x.ai**

Scale100x.ai is the world's first AI-powered growth accelerator helping consumer brands scale through partner expansion. Built by the founders of Expertrons, we are serial entrepreneurs and IIT Bombay alumni who have built and exited ventures and scaled 300+ franchise networks across industries.

We partner with high-potential brands to:

* Build 100+ offline outlets/partners per year
* Use AI agents to supercharge sales and marketing execution
* Improve profitability through data-driven operations
* Support fundraising, investor relations and IPO readiness

In the last year we've driven scale for brands across EV, F&B, Salon, Retail, EdTech, Play Areas and more, including helping one brand close a $5.4M Series A. Our sales engine runs on high-volume, WhatsApp-first lead flow, and we are rebuilding it to be AI-native.

**The Role**

We are moving from LeadSquared to an AI-native CRM and want to put AI agents at the center of how we sell, follow up, onboard and report. You will own that transformation end to end: choosing the platform, migrating without losing a single lead, and building the agents and automations that run on top of it, across our different verticals.

This is a builder's role. You will work directly with the founders, and you should be as comfortable in a CRM admin panel or an n8n workflow as in a leadership review.

**What You'll Own**

**1. CRM selection and migration (LeadSquared → AI-native CRM)**

* Evaluate AI-native CRM options against our needs (cost, WhatsApp and telephony support, agent capabilities, integrations) and make a clear recommendation.
* Plan and run the migration: data cleanup and mapping, pipeline redesign, integrations, cutover and parallel run.
* Drive team adoption so that data quality and usage improve after the switch, not just the tooling.

**2. AI agents and automation across verticals**

* Map the lead-to-onboarding journey (enquiry, qualification, commercials, agreement, onboarding) and identify what agents can own and where a human must stay in the loop.
* Build and deploy agents and automations for lead qualification, follow-ups, call summaries, CRM updates, reminders and reporting.
* Adapt and reuse these workflows across verticals such as EV, F&B, Salon, Retail and EdTech, and over time package them for client brands.
* Measure every automation on time saved, response time and conversion impact.

**3. Integrations and systems**

* Connect the CRM with WhatsApp Business API, telephony/IVR, e-sign, email, finance and internal tools using APIs, webhooks and no-code/low-code platforms.
* Own reliability: monitoring, fallbacks and documentation.

**4. Analytics and ROI**

* Build dashboards for pipeline health, leakage by stage, agent performance and revenue outcomes.
* Build the business case for each initiative and report results to the founders.

**5. Ownership and execution**

* Run projects from problem definition to rollout with clear milestones and accountability.
* Work with sales, operations, product and tech teams, and flag risks and dependencies early.

**Must-Haves**

* 5+ years in CRM implementation, business systems, revenue operations, product operations or automation-led roles.
* Hands-on experience implementing or migrating a CRM (LeadSquared, HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce or similar), including at least one full data migration and cutover.
* Demonstrable experience building and deploying AI agents or LLM-based automations in production. Please share a workflow you built and its outcome.
* Fluency with APIs, webhooks and no-code/low-code tools (n8n, Make, Zapier or similar).
* Experience integrating WhatsApp Business API and telephony/IVR into a sales workflow.
* Strong analytical skills: you can define metrics, build dashboards and quantify ROI.
* Ability to work independently with founders and cross-functional teams, with clear written and verbal communication.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with AI-native CRM platforms.
* Background in high-volume, lead-driven businesses such as franchising, edtech, real estate or D2C.
* Exposure to product strategy or product operations, and to financial modelling.
* Startup, consulting or SaaS experience.

**What We Expect**

* **Ownership:**
  you drive initiatives without continuous supervision.
* **Execution:**
  you move from recommendation to live implementation.
* **Business sense:**
  you connect every system and automation to a measurable outcome.
* **Structured problem-solving:**
  you frame the problem, test quickly and iterate.

**Who Should Apply**

Builders from CRM, revenue operations, automation, product operations or business systems backgrounds who have shipped real migrations and real automations, and want to do it at the intersection of AI, growth and franchising.

title: Manager – Customer Experience
description:
* Customer Experience Strategy & Economics
* Build and own the CX scorecard beyond NPS: OTIF (on-time-in-full), CPKO, resolution speed, escalation

rate, repeat-purchase behavior by customer tier — and tie every one of them to a revenue or retention
  
  
number leadership can act on.
  
  

* Quantify the cost and reorder impact of every major CX failure mode (damaged/missing items, delivery

issues, refund delays) and use it to prioritize fixes by rupee impact, not by ticket volume.
  
  

* Own resolution-policy decisions (e.g., redispatch vs. refund) with hard data on which choice actually

keeps a customer.
  
  
Data-Driven Program Management
  
  

* Be comfortable pulling and validating your own data (SQL, BigQuery or equivalent) rather than waiting

on a dashboard someone else maintains.
  
  

* Run root-cause analysis that survives scrutiny — right-sized samples, corrected logic, honest callouts

when two systems disagree, and a clear line between “verified” and “a model.”
  
  

* Segment customers by lifetime value and behavior (tiers, first-time vs. repeat, state/geography) to find

where the highest-leverage interventions are, not just the loudest complaints.
  
  

* AI &Automation
* Own the chatbot/IVR stack end to end: containment rate, cost per conversation, and — critically —

instrument what today isn't measured (does “closed” actually mean “resolved”?).
  
  

* Identify and build the next generation of AI-driven CX: proactive delivery-risk alerts, automated win-

back campaigns for lapsing customers, smarter self-serve flows — always backed by a quantified
  
  
opportunity size.
  
  

* Evaluate build-vs-buy and vendor decisions (chat, IVR, call-scoring platforms) on total cost and actual

capability, not the sales deck.
  
  
Team & Operating Model
  
  

* Build and lead a small, accountable team across three areas: CX Tools & Vendor Management, CX

Metrics & Voice of Customer, and Data & Automation.
  
  

* Replace informal, single-point-of-failure ownership with clear RACI, documented processes, and a team

that can operate without you in the room.
  
  

* Run structured win-back and retention initiatives (e.g., outbound campaigns for customers who've gone

quiet at 90/180 days) with proper reason-code diagnosis, not just reminder blasts.
  
  

* Voice of the Customer
* Personally read and act on customer feedback — the good, the near-miss, and the genuinely angry.

Every customer who takes the time to write in is a free, high-signal data point; treat it that way.
  
  

* Turn qualitative complaints into structured, quantified problems the business can prioritize.

This role will provide strategic technical leadership, people management and client-facing governance across the complete commissioning lifecycle from L0–L6, with particular emphasis on L3 Energization, L4 Functional Performance Testing (FPT) and L5 Integrated Systems Testing (IST).

* Review and validate SLDs, protection schemes, coordination studies, load-flow/short-circuit/arc-flash studies, SOO and commissioning test scripts for technical accuracy and compliance.
* Lead and oversee FAT/SAT, primary and secondary injection testing, protection verification, load-bank testing and integrated systems testing activities.
* Validate seamless electrical integration with BMS, EPMS, mechanical and fire/life-safety systems to ensure operational coherence.
* Drive resolution of commissioning issues through rigorous RCA, maintain risk registers, manage punch lists and ensure technical close-out compliance.
* Serve as the senior technical interface with hyperscale clients, CxA teams, consultants, contractors, OEMs and utilities, ensuring clear communication and stakeholder alignment.
* Champion electrical safety culture, LOTO protocols, energization and switching procedures throughout the commissioning lifecycle.

**Requirements**

* 15+ years overall electrical engineering/commissioning experience.
* 8+ years data-center or mission-critical electrical commissioning experience.
* Proven leadership of at least 3-4 complete L3/L4/L5 commissioning cycles.
* Proven experience of leading at least 2 ISTs in hyperscale projects.
* Experience managing 15–20+ engineers/technicians.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of HV/MV/LV, protection, generators, UPS, EPMS/SCADA and integrated testing.
* Strong understanding of Uptime Institute, TIA-942, IEC, IEEE, NETA, NFPA 70/70E/110 and applicable local codes.
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent.

About Give Grants Give Grants enables large Indian corporations and foundations to deliver maximum social impact. Using a combination of consulting services, operations support and technology platforms, we work with 100+ companies and grantmakers to make their giving journey convenient, compliant and the most impactful it can be. We are a part of Give, India’s largest philanthropic platform. Find out more about us at give.do/givegrants

**About the Role**

Role: Senior Associate, CSR Consulting

The CSR Services team is the primary owner of all client relationships (companies / corporate foundations / philanthropic foundations) and is responsible for overall client delight. Our service offerings include strategy and program design, partner identification, KPI mapping, on-ground monitoring and evaluation, and overall impact portfolio management. We also support clients in effectively using our CSR management tech platform. As a Senior Associate in this team, you will be working with the clients and will be required to understand the day-to-day operational tasks pertaining to the overall deliverables for the various stakeholders. This role will also require a good understanding and appreciation of the CSR / impact ecosystem and applicable standards / laws. At Give Grants, we believe in deriving client value through data-driven insights and the CSR Services team members also require developing a fair understanding of our tech products.

Key skills:

* CSR consulting
* social impact consulting
* problem-solving
* client engagement
* data analysis
* reporting

Location:

* Mumbai/Bangalore

**Responsibilities**

* Program identification and delivery
* Understand client's CSR vision and co-develop action roadmap aligned to their CSR goals
* Deliver high-quality reports / insights / updates to clients by regularly engaging with NGO partners and internal teams at Give Grants
* Keep up with the updates in the CSR ecosystem and social development space to ably guide the clients
* Strategic Consulting
* Help clients to design / restructure programs and program indicators in line with their intent to deliver real, measurable, sustainable impact
* Analyse data from multiple sources including the technology platform and derive actionable insights for all stakeholders of the CSR programs. Share data-backed insights with the clients regarding their programs.
* Undertake secondary research of the CSR / impact landscape / peer research to provide insights and trends to the clients.
* Develop depth of knowledge and expertise within specific sub-verticals of the development landscape.
* Stakeholder Management
* Maintain close coordination with the clients and their partners for timely delivery of services as per the agreed scope of work
* Timely raising of internal requests to ensure that the overall project plan and objectives are met.
* Develop an understanding of our tech products, to provide appropriate guidance to client teams.
* Actively contribute to pre-sales efforts by supporting the development of high-quality collateral and proposals.
* Contribute to ongoing development of thought leadership content through creation of reports, articles, podcasts, and other knowledge products.



**Qualifications**

* Graduate/post-graduate from top-tier institutes with strong academic background. An academic background in economics / development studies / sociology / social work and other allied streams will be a positive but is not essential.
* Experience: 3-5 years preferably with exposure to CSR / development space or equivalent consulting experience.

**Required Skills**

* Domain knowledge of CSR rules and understanding of the CSR ecosystem in India is essential.
* Knowledge in areas of national priority such as skilling, women empowerment, MCH, climate change will be a strong positive
* Strong analytical skills, excellent communication, storytelling and presentation skills, backed by strong verbal and written communication along with keen attention to detail
* Technical Skills: Strong Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, Word. Strong data analysis capabilities. Ability to work with the Google suite of products (Slides, Sheets, Docs)
* Soft Skills: Client communication, project management, relationship building, stakeholder management and client influencing
* Proven ability to work independently and collaboratively in a dynamic environment with a strong commitment to ethical practices, social justice, and advancing positive social outcomes.
* A bias toward action, ability to manage multiple projects and priorities to deliver on tight deadlines

title: Project Manager
description:
We are seeking a Project Manager in our Mumbai office for our Retail + Restaurant studio. This role focuses on the timely and accurate production of project deliverables from design development through construction, opportunity to work on diverse retail projects across phases, contribute to high-quality documentation, and grow technical and design skills under the mentorship of the studio Principal.
  
  
**A Day In Life**

* Thoroughly understand the client's objectives & communication to pursue new opportunities.
* Set and implement project strategy, workflow, & processes
* Delegate work assignments based on project scope and team member's skill set
* Manage the production of client deliverables on time and budget: Identify extra services
* Manage revenue projections and staffing projections
* Oversight of, and adherence to, professional standards and technical procedures
* Quality assurance: Perform quality checks to ensure the deliverables are error free
* Lead and mentor junior staff and designers to achieve efficient project progress and professional development
* Assist with developing proposals and reviewing contracts
* Provide construction administration services
* Provide technical guidance and creative solutions to address complex technical and design challenges
* Direct production and maintain quality control of construction drawings

**You’re a Great Fit If**
*You’re already experienced in:*

* Retail roll out, luxury retail, and ground up retail projects
* Space planning for retail stores
* Implementation of prototypes + non prototypical work
* Custom design and detailing

**Your Soft Skills Include**

* Clear, concise, and professional communication, both verbal and written
* Ability to handle multiple projects and deadlines
* Strong leadership and relationship-management skills
* Work for a multi-office/multi-time zone company
* Supporting and sharing knowledge with the team members
* Desire to develop, acknowledge and grow junior staff while fostering a collaborative team environment
* Understand firm’s vision and actively support it’s growth locally and globally

**You Have The Following Qualifications**

* Degree in Architecture or relevant field
* 10 years of experience in Retail and roll-out segment.
* Proficient in Sketch-up, Revit, AutoCAD, Bluebeam, Photoshop, etc.

**Why Do You Want To Work With Us**

* We promote a fun & dynamic culture of teamwork and collaboration
* You’ll have access to international training opportunities designed to support your personal and professional growth
* You’ll receive a dedicated stipend for learning, plus access to high-quality resources like LinkedIn Learning and Hone
* Our hybrid work system allows for a balance between remote flexibility and in-office collaboration
* We provide company-sponsored health and medical insurance to support your physical and mental well-being
* As an equal opportunity employer, we celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive

**About MBH Architects**
MBH Architects offers the best of both worlds: the resources of a top-tier firm with the supportive culture of a close-knit team. With offices in the San Francisco Bay Area, New York, Denver, Mumbai, and Bengaluru, we provide hybrid flexibility and global reach.
  
  
Our success is built on meaningful collaboration and continuous education. Through integrated services (architecture, environmental graphics, fixture and interior design), we deliver world-class projects, including multi-family housing, labs, retail experiences for iconic brands, and many more. We believe great work happens when people feel supported and inspired.
  
  
What sets us apart? A strong sense of community, dedication to sustainability and social impact, and a culture that celebrates creativity and connection—whether through design competitions or our legendary waffle-offs.
  
  
If you are passionate about your work, and strive for excellence in everything you do, MBH Architects could be the perfect fit for you.

title: Project Manager II, Global Engineering Services
description:
**Description**
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history. Amazon Projects team need to have in-depth understanding of Project life cycle including span allocation for all the four pillars (assessment, design and detailing, Execution and Performance qualification) of any project. Some of the key aspects of the role are Site Selection along with the RE team, Project statutory and Legal compliances adherence, Project Safety both in terms of design and execution, value management for large and medium scale projects, executing various formats of technical projects-green field, brown field and Improvement projects.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
The candidate is required to lead the planning and execution of all building formats and will be for a specific region - North India. The Project Manager role will be responsible for setting up new Centers across different business formats, capacity expansion of existing facilities as well as relocation of facilities as per business requirements. Additionally, the Project Manager will also drive 1 or 2 project management initiatives viz. Standardization, Energy Conservation programs, Productivity Improvement measures etc. and Project Financial processes.
  
  
Project Manager will be responsible for the on time and safe delivery and hand over of facilities across business formats as listed above, ensuring that the project is executed with highest standards and good engineering practices. Other roles and responsibilities of the Project Manager will include
  
  

* Support RE Team in site visits and due diligence through site inspections for a feasibility assessment of setting up a facility for the given business format
* To work on finalizing the conceptual layouts and to assess the layout parameters from an operations perspective
* Preparing Developer’s Scope of Work for the site as per standards and specification
* Preparing Amazon scope of work and the cost estimate and preparation & submission of Build out Capex request for approval.
* Finalization of Project Management Consultants
* Project resource planning and management through the appointed PMC or hired resources
* Work with Procurement team to evaluate and finalize vendors for the projects
* Reviewing the material requirement with all stakeholders for setting up and Launching the facility and tracking till receipt and implementation.
* Progress monitoring and Execution management of onsite activities of Amazon scope of work
* Tracking and ensuring quality of work by the Developer
* Ensure a snag-free handover to Facilities Team
* Work with Launch team in preparation of the Launch of a site closer to completion
* Ensure budget adherence and safe execution at site - with no budget overruns and with a targeted Zero LTI
* Preparation of weekly progress reviews and reports with status updates
* Ensure timely project closure including the commercials

**Key Performance Areas**
Key Performance Indicators for the Project Manager will be
  
  

* Project Execution and OTIF Delivery to facilitate timely launch of facilities : > 95%
* Ensure budget adherence and no cost overruns for all the projects undertaken : > 95%
* Ensure Safe Execution and Zero LTIs in all the projects
* Ensure adherence to Safety and Statutory compliance in all the projects : >95%
* Ensure completion and rollout of the specific project management initiatives on time in full

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in engineering including a supervisory role managing people
* Experience in a fast-paced, automated, industrial, logistics, production or manufacturing environment
* Experience in project management

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience of automated equipment including packaging machinery, sortation and conveyor systems
* Experience in preventative maintenance systems
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, management, or technology

If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Project Manager Construction, BOM
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
The Data Center Construction Manager (CM) is responsible for managing some of the most technical, cost efficient, and fast paced construction project schedules achievable. Amazon Construction Managers are constantly challenged to drive continuous improvement and deliver the highest quality, most technically efficient data centers in the world.
  
  
As a Data Center CM you will be a part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most fascinating and challenging problems in building Amazon data facilities. Amazon CM's are always at the forefront of the construction industry in terms of innovation, and maintain a focus to deliver the most innovative products to our customers.
  
  
Our data centers are industry leading facilities in terms of energy efficiency and cost effectiveness. The Data Center CM is ultimately responsible for the day to day construction oversight and management of the contractors. The CM will also be utilized as a leader in their specific discipline (construction management, building services, architectural, electrical or mechanical engineering) and be responsible as a team member for delivering construction of some of the most sophisticated electrical and mechanical systems in the world.
  
  
At Amazon we leverage unique opportunities presented to us by owning everything from the substation, to the server, and back to the cooling towers. We are diverse, upbeat, creative, team-oriented construction professionals working on a daily basis to develop data centers that are changing the face of data facilities
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**The Data Center CM Will Be Responsible For**

* Assist in project management and oversight of construction-related activities for new builds or general capital projects in Hydrabad area, under guidance from senior team members.
* Support efforts to drive costs down and shorten schedules while maintaining quality.
* Contribute to Construction Management for specific initiatives aimed at increasing the resiliency of our data centers.
* Participate in reviews of construct-ability of electrical and mechanical systems and building designs associated with the construction of new data centers or the optimization of existing data centers.
* Assist in creating project scope and equipment requirements, help with request for proposals, and capital requests.
* Support total project quality by assisting with commissioning and integrated system testing, and helping oversee the execution of the project.
* Help manage the Request for Information process during construction and coordinate construction administration with engineers.
* Record and report key metrics to team members and management.
* Learn to manage multiple projects concurrently, including new data center building and capital improvement projects associated with existing data centers.
* Provide operational support of installed facilities, including review of procedures, best practices, and maintenance initiatives.
* Develop leadership skills within the group and in internal and external teams that support the data center.
* Travel to datacenter sites for electrical, mechanical system audits and reviews, construct-ability reviews, startup testing, and full commissioning, as required, under supervision.

A day in the life
  
  
At Amazon we are a global team responsible for the design and operation of industry leading, geographically diverse, large scale critical facilities. Each team member is a highly motivated individual with demonstrated construction management and analytical expertise in the areas of complex, mission critical facilities. Daily responsibilities will include all aspects of the entire data center lifecycle construction starting with the site feasibility, through the procurement of the design teams and design review, daily construction oversight, and commissioning of completed facilities.
  
  
**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* Experience in vendor management
* Experience in a data center or other critical environment

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of construction or project management experience
* Experience in construction or project management
* Knowledge of critical data center equipment

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Data Migration Lead
description:
**Project Role :**
Data Migration Lead
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Lead the planning and execution of data migration to ensure data is accurate, complete, and ready for use in the target system. Coordinate teams, define migration approach and controls, and manage risks to ensure a smooth and reliable transition.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Snowflake Data Warehouse
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 12 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
Summary:
  
  
As a Data Migration Lead, a typical day involves overseeing the entire data migration process from planning through execution. This role requires coordinating multiple teams to ensure that data is transferred accurately and completely to the target system. The individual manages the migration approach, implements necessary controls, and addresses any risks that may arise to guarantee a seamless and dependable transition. Throughout the day, the lead collaborates with various stakeholders to align efforts and maintain the integrity and readiness of data for operational use.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  

* Own end-to-end delivery for large-scale data modernization / migration programs (legacy to cloud, typically Snowflake-centric lakehouse or warehouse architectures)
* Lead and manage teams of data engineers, architects, and analysts (direct reports + matrixed pods) own performance, staffing, and capability development
* Run program governance: status reporting, risk/dependency management, client steering committee interaction, SOW/scope tracking
* Act as primary client-facing owner for delivery - translate business/technical asks into execution plans, defend timelines and estimates, manage escalations
* Drive technical direction on Snowflake implementations: data modeling (dimensional / Data Vault), ingestion pipeline design, performance and cost governance, security/RBAC
* Partner with architects on integration patterns (CDC tools like Debezium /Qlik Replicate, streaming via Kafka/MSK, orchestration)
* Own estimation, staffing plans, and financial tracking (fixed-fee or T&M) for the program

Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  

* Must Have Skills: Proficiency in Snowflake Data Warehouse.
* Experience in designing and managing large-scale data migration projects involving complex data sets.
* Strong knowledge of data governance, data quality standards, and best practices in data migration.
* Ability to analyze and troubleshoot data migration issues, ensuring data integrity and consistency.
* Familiarity with cloud-based data warehousing solutions and integration techniques.
* Excellent skills in coordinating cross-functional teams and managing project timelines.
* Snowflake: warehouse sizing/cost optimization, Snowpipe, RBAC/security model, query performance tuning
* Strong data engineering background with SQL
* Data modeling: dimensional modeling and/or Data Vault 2.0
* Efficient problem solving and RCA skills
* Proven people management (staffing, team management, team tracking, reporting etc.)
* Demonstrated large program delivery
* Strong client stakeholder management, comfortable owning governance and escalations independently

Additional Information
  
  

* 12+ years in data engineering / cloud data platforms, including a minimum of 4 years hands-on Snowflake (architecture, performance tuning cost/credit optimization, security model — not just SQL authoring)
* This position is based at our Mumbai office.
* A 15-year full-time education is required.

description:
