title: Senior Manager - NPI
description:
Castrol is one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company’s commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years.
  
  
Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the team**
Own the end-to-end New Product Introduction (NPI) process, from design transfer to stable commercial production. Lead cross-functional stage-gate reviews, ensuring products progress only when readiness criteria for cost, quality, supply, and operational execution are met, delivering successful launches on time and in full.
  
  
This role provides leadership and governance for the NPI portfolio, owning launch outcomes, stakeholder alignment, and stage-gate decisions. While the NPI Planner manages operational execution across materials, capacity, builds, and inventory, this role is accountable for overall NPI success and commercialization readiness.
  
  
**Key Tasks**
NPI process ownership
  
  

* Define, run and continuously improve the stage-gate NPI process (concept, design, prototype, pilot, ramp, release to mass production), including gate criteria, templates and governance.
* Run the NPI portfolio: intake, prioritization and resource allocation across concurrent projects.
* Own the handover from Technology to Operations and the transition to steady-state manufacturing.

Cross-functional evaluation and gate decisions
  
  

* Chair NPI gate reviews with R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing Engineering, Sourcing, Supply Chain, Finance and Commercial.
* Assess each product for manufacturability, test and quality readiness, supplier readiness, compliance, cost and launch risk.
* Make or escalate go / no-go / conditional-go recommendations with documented risks and mitigations.

NPI delivery
  
  

* Own schedule, budget, scope and risk for each project; maintain the master NPI plan and critical path.
* Drive risk management and resolve cross-functional conflicts quickly.
* Manage contract manufacturers and key suppliers for pilot builds and ramp, where applicable.

Cost, quality and supply readiness
  
  

* Agree target cost, yield and first-pass quality with Finance, Quality and Manufacturing; track the gap to target at every gate.
* Ensure the NPI Planner’s material, capacity and build plans support each gate date and launch volume.
* Ensure change control, BOM and documentation are complete and released before production.

Lead NPI Portfolio & Performance Management
  
  

* Maintain the consolidated NPI roadmap and publish dashboards covering project health, milestone adherence, launch readiness, action closure, and post-launch performance.

Lead Export Readiness for NPI PLanning
  
  

* Lead cross-functional alignment and close coordination with Export teams to establish inventory strategies, distribution networks, capacity plans, and market-specific supply requirements for successful export launches.
* Govern the transition of NPI projects into business-as-usual export operations, ensuring seamless handover, supply continuity, and service reliability across all destination markets.

Leadership and stakeholder management
  
  

* Lead, coach and develop the NPI team; set objectives and manage performance.
* Report on project status, risks and decisions to senior leadership and the executive team.
* Capture lessons learned after each launch and feed them back into the process.

**Experience Required**

* Graduate degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Post Graduate Degree or MBA in Supply Chain, Operations Management, or Business Management will be an added advantage
* 10-12 years of Supply Chain experience with strong exposure to NPI, Planning, Product Lifecycle Management, Project Management, or Supply Chain Transformation.
* Proven experience in leading cross-functional NPI, commercialization, innovation, or product-transition programs.
* Strong understanding of Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Management, Capacity Planning, S&OP, and phase-in/phase-out processes.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive accountability across Marketing, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics, Finance, Quality, and Regulatory teams.
* Strong project management, risk management, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent launches.

Privacy
  
  
The Castrol entity recruiting for this role is the data controller for the personal information you provide. We use it to assess your application and to manage the recruitment and onboarding process. We may share it with service providers who support our recruitment, and it may be transferred to other Castrol entities internationally under appropriate safeguards. We keep it only for as long as necessary. For details of how we use your information and your data protection rights, contact privacy.response@castrol.com.
  
  
*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, socioeconomic status, neurodiversity/neurocognitive functioning, veteran status or disability status. Individuals with an accessibility need may request an adjustment/accommodation related to Castrol recruiting process (e.g., accessing the job application, completing required assessments, participating in telephone screenings or interviews, etc.).*

title: Sr. Consultant (Oil / Petrochemical / Crude Products)
description:
Argus is where smart people belong and where they can grow. We answer the challenge of illuminating markets and shaping new futures.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**
We are seeking candidate with a minimum of 3 years of consulting experience in
**Crude, Refined Products or Petrochemicals Markets,**
demonstrating strong leadership capabilities to guide project teams. A background in Chemical or Mechanical Engineering, or an MBA qualification is highly preferred.
  
  

* Dynamic Leadership: Showcase your prowess in project management by spearheading teams of analysts through intricate bespoke projects.
* Collaborative Spirit: Thrive in a culture of teamwork as you harness resources from across the organization to achieve collective goals.
* Analytics Excellence: Ability to demonstrate proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word and adeptness to develop methodologies and carry out market research projects.
* Engaging Presentation skills: Craft engaging presentation materials and confidently presenting the findings before the client’s leadership team.

**What Will You Be Doing**

* Argus is a leading provider of insights, price indexes and consulting to the global energy industry. Companies in 140 countries as well as multilaterals like the International Energy Agency (IEA) use Argus data to index physical trade and as benchmarks in financial derivative markets as well as for analysis and planning purposes.
* We also have a burgeoning commodities markets consulting division that offers clients insights into the evolving markets and the opportunities that these changes present. This division uses industry best practices, expert knowledge and Argus’ proprietary data to provide its clients with in-depth market analysis, the development of business strategies, evaluation of capital projects and advise on operations across a wide range of commodities and geographies. The division counts the biggest names in energy, petrochemicals, fertilizers and metals as well as governments as its clients.
* Given that our consulting business has been growing significantly over the last few years and we are currently looking for a Senior Consultant to join our consulting projects team in Mumbai that would focus on a broad range of energy markets. The specifics of the job are laid out below.
* Lead and execute bespoke consulting projects for Crude, refined Products & Petrochemicals market together with consultants in a project team.
* Steer client engagements, discussions during project executions and results presentations.
* Playing pivotal role in development of proposals and marketing materials on specific consulting opportunities. Taking the accountability and working collaboratively with Argus’ sales representative to win consulting projects.
* Assist research & analytics teams in the development of in-house consulting tools, forecast modelling tools and analytics to empower projects with data driven solutions and emerging market trends.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning and growth by nurturing and developing consultants, equipping them with the product knowledge and analytics research skills needed to excel in their roles and contribute to the success of our team.

**Skills And Experience**
**Educational Background:**

* Bachelor’s degree in chemical or mechanical engineering or an MBA (preferred).

**Consulting Expertise**

* Minimum 3 years of consulting experience in Crude, Refined Products, or Petrochemicals markets.
* Proven ability to lead and execute bespoke consulting projects and manage client engagements.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Strong leadership skills to guide project teams and foster a culture of learning and growth.
* Ability to work collaboratively across global teams and engage with stakeholders at all levels.

**Analytical & Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
* Experience in developing methodologies, forecast modeling tools, and conducting market research.
* Familiarity with databases and data-driven solutions.

**Communication & Presentation**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to craft compelling presentations and confidently present findings to senior leadership.

**Industry Knowledge**

* Deep understanding of energy markets, including crude, refined products, and petrochemicals.
* Awareness of emerging market trends and ability to translate insights into actionable strategies.

**Additional Attributes**

* Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
* Ability to thrive in a multicultural, global work environment.
* High level of integrity and commitment to Argus’ core values: Excellence, Integrity, Partnership, and Inclusivity.

**Attributes**

* Ability to interact with non-technical people in plain language
* Innovative thinker with good problem-solving abilities and attention to detail
* Numerically proficient
* Self-motivated with ability to work independently, prioritising tasks to meet deadlines
* Customer service focused.

**What’s In It For You**
Our rapidly growing, award-winning business offers a dynamic environment for talented, entrepreneurial professionals to achieve results and grow their careers. Argus recognizes and rewards successful performance and as an Investor in People, we promote professional development and retain a high-performing team committed to building our success.
  
  

* Competitive salary
* Hybrid Working Policy (3 days in Mumbai office/ 2 days WFH once fully inducted)
* Group healthcare scheme
* 18 days annual leave
* 8 days of casual leave
* Extensive internal and external training

**Hours**
This is a full-time position operating under a hybrid model, with three days in the office and two days working remotely. Office hours are Monday through Friday from 09:00 to 18:00, with a one-hour lunch break.
  
  
Argus is the leading independent provider of market intelligence to the global energy and commodity markets. We offer essential price assessments, news, analytics, consulting services, data science tools and industry conferences to illuminate complex and opaque commodity markets.
  
  
Headquartered in London with 1,500 staff, Argus is an independent media organisation with 32 offices in the world’s principal commodity trading hubs.
  
  
Companies, trading firms and governments in 160 countries around the world trust Argus data to make decisions, analyse situations, manage risk, facilitate trading and for long-term planning. Argus prices are used as trusted benchmarks around the world for pricing transportation, commodities and energy.
  
  
Founded in 1970, Argus remains a privately held UK-registered company owned by employee shareholders and global growth equity firm General Atlantic.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.
  
  
**Job Description**
Reporting to VP,Learning ,as a Senior Learning Programme Manager, you will be responsible for leading, operating, and continuously improving a training and readiness programme supporting over 1,000 resources globally for our Technology client. The programme is evolving and scaling at speed, requiring strong operational leadership, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence across a highly matrixed organization. The Learning Programme Manager partners closely with a Learning Director based in South Africa but owns day-to-day programme operations independently.
  
  
***Please note this is a 9-month fixed-term contract.- Looking for Immediate Joiners***
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Owning end-to-end operational delivery of the training and readiness programme across multiple, interdependent workstreams, setting priorities and ensuring delivery against them
* Leading onboarding and readiness experiences for programme participants, keeping them consistent, high quality, and scalable as the programme grows and changes
* Leading and facilitating cross-functional meetings, including global forums and steering-style discussions, and making sure they end in clear decisions and follow-through
* Presenting regular programme updates, insights, and risks to senior stakeholders and the Learning Director, translating day-to-day detail into a clear narrative
* Running training refresh cycles, managing the knock-on effects when processes, tools, or requirements change
* Owning quarterly content governance cycles, keeping materials accurate, compliant, and aligned to evolving business needs
* Managing intake, prioritisation, tracking, and delivery of training and readiness requests, and balancing competing priorities at scale
* Maintaining and improving operational trackers, governance logs, and programme documentation as the programme evolves
* Monitoring programme health metrics and turning them into insight, spotting trends in training completion, readiness, and risk areas
* Spotting programme risks early, assessing them, and escalating with clear context and a recommendation rather than just a flag
* Acting as the point of escalation for operational issues, driving them to resolution across teams and vendors
* Managing day-to-day relationships with vendor partners and holding them to quality and delivery standards
* Partnering with the Learning Director on continuous improvement work, including AI, automation, and process optimisation pilots.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience within training operations, enablement, program operations, or operational excellence, ideally in a global or enterprise environment
* Proven ability to own a program end to end, including making and defending prioritization calls
* Comfort operating in a fast-changing, still-developing program rather than a fully settled one
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, align, and drive decisions without formal authority
* Demonstrated experience identifying, managing, and mitigating operational and program-level risks
* Demonstrated experience in operationalising processes using AI at a Claude, Copilot or GPT interface rather than bought specialist tools
* Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to manage complex, parallel workstreams with minimal oversight
* Strong analytical mindset, comfortable turning data into clear insights and narratives
* Clear, concise, and professional written and verbal communication skills in English, including with senior stakeholders
* Comfort operating in a global, matrixed environment across time zones and cultures
* A proactive, ownership-driven mindset, comfortable operating independently and navigating ambiguity

***Nice-to-haves***

* Experience with learning systems, training platforms, readiness models, or governance frameworks
* Experience with AI-enabled operations, automation, or process optimization pilots
* Background in large client environments
* Experience with vendor management
* Familiarity with vendor skilling, readiness, or enablement programmes at scale.

*Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.*
**Additional Information**
Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.
  
  
💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.
  
  
🏦 Jellyfish contributes to your retiral benefits via Provident Fund (PF) contribution
  
  
Jellyfish provides best-in-class group medical insurance & life insurance cover to employees
  
  
*Unfortunately, there has been an increase in fake recruiters impersonating Jellyfish and unlawfully using our brand name. If you are unsure if an email with a job offer you have received is genuinely from Jellyfish, or if you suspect any fraudulent activity, please report it to*
*talentacquisition@jellyfish.com*

title: Associate Technical Project Manager - Client Delivery
description:
About us:

icogz is an industry leader in enterprise-grade AI, revolutionizing business operations with its innovative Aryabot™ Neuro-Symbolic AI engine and Autonomous Intelligence Architecture (AIA™). Designed to provide real-time AI-powered insights, icogz empowers organizations to make data-driven decisions and enable intelligent automation across all departments. By democratizing access to advanced data analytics, icogz bridges the gap between complex data insights and actionable strategies, allowing every team to operate smarter and faster. With a unified view of enterprise data and over 200 proprietary algorithms, icogz is pioneering the future of business intelligence and decision-making.

Role Overview

* We are looking for a Technical Project Manager who can sit comfortably on both sides of the table — technical enough to hold their own with engineering and data teams, and polished enough to be the primary point of contact for clients through the life of a project. This is a hands-on delivery role, not a coordination-only role. You will own timelines, scope, quality, and the client relationship on the projects assigned to you. Key responsibilitiesProject deliveryOwn end-to-end delivery for assigned projects — planning, resourcing, sprint/milestone tracking, risk management, and go-live.
* Translate client requirements into clear, technically sound scope documents, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Work closely with engineering, data, design, and QA teams to sequence work, unblock dependencies, and hold delivery dates.
* Maintain project documentation: project plans, RAID logs, status trackers, change requests, and release notes.
* Track effort against estimates and flag scope creep, resourcing gaps, or timeline risks early and in writing.
* Client servicing Act as the day-to-day point of contact for clients across all assigned projects.
* Run status calls, demos, walkthroughs, and review meetings; circulate minutes and action items.
* Translate technical constraints into business language for clients, and client expectations into actionable briefs for internal teams.
* Handle escalations calmly, with a clear resolution path and appropriate internal alignment before committing to anything.
* Identify opportunities for scope extension or additional engagement and flag them to leadership.
* Process and governanceDrive adoption of consistent project management practices, templates, and reporting formats across the team.
* Maintain accurate status reporting for internal leadership — weekly dashboards, delivery health, utilisation.
* Contribute to estimation and proposal inputs for new business where technical delivery feasibility is involved.

Required skills and experience

* 4–7 years of experience in project management or technical delivery roles, ideally in a technology services, digital, analytics, or product engineering environment.
* Demonstrated technical literacy — able to read a solution architecture, understand APIs, databases, data pipelines, and web/app development cycles, and ask the right questions of an engineering team. (You do not need to code, but you must not need everything translated for you.)
* Exposure to basic scripting (Python/SQL) or hands-on experience with no-code/low-code platforms.
* Active interest in AI and emerging technology trends, with a point of view on how they apply to client problems.
* Proven client-facing experience with direct ownership of client relationships and communication.
* Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum and Waterfall approaches, and the judgment to know which fits a given engagement.
* Hands-on with project management and collaboration tools — Jira, Asana, ClickUp, Trello, MS Project, Confluence, or equivalent.
* Strong written communication: crisp emails, clear documentation, well-structured status reports.
* Comfortable managing multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities.

Good to have

* Exposure to data analytics, business intelligence, marketing technology, or AI/ML-led projects.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams across creative, media, and technology functions.
* Experience managing offshore or distributed teams.

What We Offer· Direct ownership of client relationships and delivery outcomes from day one — this is a visible role with real decision-making authority, not a layer in a reporting chain.· Exposure to AI, analytics, and emerging technology projects across a diverse client portfolio, with the scope to shape how new tools are adopted internally.· The breadth of a multi-entity group — opportunities to collaborate across technology, creative, and media teams and to grow beyond a single functional track.

To Apply: Please share your resume to hr@icogz.com

title: Senier Quality engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Liquipack/Pharmalab Private Limited is a biotechnology company with operations in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. The organization focuses on innovative solutions and technology-driven processes within the biotech sector, supporting clients with reliable products and services. Team members collaborate across functions to uphold high standards of safety, compliance, and scientific rigor. The company offers opportunities for growth in quality and technical roles, making it an attractive environment for experienced professionals seeking to advance their careers in biotechnology.
  
**Role Description**
The Senior Quality Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Gandhinagar. This position is responsible for overseeing quality engineering activities, including the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of quality systems and processes. Day-to-day tasks include monitoring product quality, conducting root cause analysis, leading corrective and preventive actions, and ensuring adherence to regulatory and internal standards. The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams such as production, R&D, and supply chain to resolve quality issues and prevent recurrence. The Senior Quality Engineer will also prepare quality documentation, support audits, mentor junior quality staff, and contribute to strategic quality initiatives to enhance overall operational performance.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Quality Engineering and Quality Management to design, implement, and optimize quality systems and processes.
* Candidates should possess solid experience in Quality Control and Product Quality to monitor, test, and validate products against internal and regulatory standards.
* Candidates should possess expertise in Quality Assurance to develop procedures, conduct audits, and ensure ongoing compliance with industry regulations and company policies.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related technical field.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, or related regulated industries, with familiarity in GMP and relevant quality standards.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional improvement initiatives.
* Effective communication and documentation skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and mentor less experienced colleagues.

title: Manager- Projects (NPD)
description:
**About Shalina Healthcare:**

Shalina Healthcare is one of the largest pharmaceutical companies in sub-Saharan Africa. For the last 40 years we have made it our mission to provide quality medicines to those who need it the most. We manufacture and distribute branded prescription and over-the-counter pharmaceutical and consumer products, across a broad range of therapeutic groups, including anti-malarial, antibiotics, anti-inflammatory and nutrition. We have a track record few can match and our brands are among the most trusted in Africa.

We are proud of our history and have big ambitions for the future. Our vision for 2030 is to be the health champion of Sub-Saharan Africa. To achieve this, we are looking for the right people to join us and create a lasting impact not just within our company but on the communities we serve.

Everyone in our company has a crucial role to play, and we are looking for people who identify with our Core Values and are as passionate about our Mission as we are.

The Global Supply Organization is a multi-continental Function that comprises of the entire Value Chain from product conceptualization to delivery to the commercial front. Within the Global Supply Organization are included, Research & Development, Project Management, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain Management and Logistics.

**Role:**
Manager – New Product Development (NPD)

**Designation**
: Manager

**Base location:**
Pawane, Navi Mumbai, India

**Reporting To:**
DGM- NPD

**Role Purpose**

1. End-to-End Project Management

* Manage end-to-end projects covering New Products (NP), Geographic Expansion (GE), and packaging changes.
* Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure timely execution of project milestones and launch plans.
* Track individual product timelines, identify delays, resolve dependencies, and provide weekly project updates.
* Ensure adherence to defined processes, timelines, and project compliance requirements.

2. Product Feasibility & Portfolio Development

* Evaluate project feasibility based on Cost of Goods Sold (COGS), Gross Profit (GP%), and commercial viability.
* Prepare New Item Forms (NIFs) to initiate sourcing of new products in coordination with Operating Units (OUs).
* Collect and consolidate product information, assess data availability from sourcing teams, and support preparation of product proposals.
* Identify new product and value-improvement opportunities for the Medium-Term Plan (MTP) using EXIM and Sani Sphere data.
* Track the Consumer Products portfolio and support portfolio expansion initiatives.

3. New Product Launches & Market Coordination

* Coordinate with OUs and internal stakeholders to ensure timely delivery and launch of new products across markets.
* Track product launch readiness, dispatches, and supply status, and communicate updates to respective markets on time.
* Coordinate with Supply Chain for purchase requisition (PR) and purchase order (PO) releases to vendors and production teams.
* Follow up on launch-related dependencies to ensure products are available as per planned timelines.
* Coordinate medical content and French/Portuguese leaflet translations with relevant stakeholders.

4. Regulatory, Quality & Documentation

* Coordinate legal, technical, regulatory, and quality activities related to product development and launches.
* Initiate and follow up on Change Control Forms (CCFs) with Quality Assurance (QA), ensuring approvals and implementation within agreed timelines.
* Coordinate Finished Goods (FG) code creation by collecting relevant information from departments and initiating requests through SAP and EDUCE.
* Ensure required product documentation and administrative requirements, including Shalina Artwork Text (SAT) forms, are completed accurately and on time.
* Maintain project records and ensure documentation compliance throughout the product development lifecycle.

5. Packaging & Artwork Management

* Coordinate with the Artwork team for internal packaging and artwork development.
* Collect vendor specifications and obtain approvals from relevant departments for artwork and packaging implementation.
* Track packaging changes and ensure alignment between artwork, regulatory requirements, product specifications, and launch timelines.

6. MIS, Reporting & Performance Tracking

* Prepare monthly updates for the CEO report and track NPD sales performance using Qlik data.
* Maintain project trackers, launch reports, and other MIS within defined timelines.
* Provide regular visibility on project progress, pending actions, launch readiness, and potential delays.
* Track product dispatches and communicate shipment status to respective markets.
* Maintain accurate and updated tracking reports to support management reviews and decision-making.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Graduate/Postgraduate in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Engineering, Management, or a related discipline.
* Relevant experience in New Product Development, project management, product launches, or portfolio management, preferably in the pharmaceutical industry.
* Experience coordinating with Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Artwork, and international Operating Units.
* Working knowledge of SAP, EDUCE, Qlik, MS Excel, and project tracking tools will be preferred.
* Exposure to geographic expansion, packaging changes, and consumer product portfolios will be an advantage.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* New Product Development & Launch Management
* Cross-Functional Project Coordination
* Project Planning and Timeline Management
* Product Feasibility, COGS & GP Analysis
* Regulatory and Quality Documentation
* Artwork and Packaging Change Management
* SAP, EDUCE & Qlik Reporting
* MIS Preparation and Data Analysis
* Stakeholder Management
* Problem-Solving and Execution Excellence

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely completion of NPD, geographic expansion, and packaging change projects.
* Adherence to planned product launch timelines.
* Accuracy and timeliness of project trackers and management MIS.
* Timely completion of regulatory, quality, artwork, and documentation activities.
* Product feasibility and profitability assessment.
* Timely FG code creation and PR/PO coordination.
* Timely communication of product dispatches and launch status to markets.
* Effective tracking of NPD sales and the Consumer Products portfolio.

title: Project Manager
description:
**About Us**
Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
  
  
**The Role**
***As a Project Manager with Worley***
, you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
  
  
**Technical Expertise And Thought Leadership**

* To plan, co-ordinate and manage the design, procurement, construction, and commissioning of medium/large projects by directing a project manager or team of project managers/area managers depending upon scope and competency.
* To ensure clear agreement of client objectives and that these are met or exceeded.
* To achieve or better the budgeted gross margin.

**Specific Accountability**

* Direct the Integration of a Medium/Large Project.
* Direct the implementation of all functions of project management.
* Direct the internal company environment to meet the needs of a Medium/large project.
* Direct the project through its development stages.

**Client Relationships**

* Identify, document, and communicate the client requirements.
* Effective management of multiple stakeholders.
* Maintain and build healthy client relationships throughout the project and post completion.
* Proactively resolve performance, scope, cost, and schedule issues with the Client as they arise, in conjunction with the Project Manager(s).

**Commercial Management**

* Effective management of Worley/Client contract, including delivery of the budget gross margin.

**Scope Management**

* Effective handover from Business Development Group.
* Clear definition of scope.
* Compliance with requirements of the contract.
* Effective change control process application.
* Manage and monitor project performance on an ongoing basis to identify issues and opportunities early and take pre-emptive action.
* Effectively manages project interfaces, in conjunction with the Project Manager(s), including the use of High Value Engineering centres.

**Time Management**

* Direct the planning of all scope elements of the project, with the support of the Project Manager(s).
* Develop resource & financial requirements from the project plan.
* Direct the management of the design, procurement, and construction activities to meet the project schedule.
* Ownership of the project schedule.
* Routine monitoring of the key reports and development of corrective action plans.
* Timely and effective documentation turnover and project close-out.

**Cost Control**

* Direct the planning and preparation of accurate project estimates.
* Establish cost report for control of projects.
* Monitoring and control of all cost aspects of the project to forecast costs, obtain approvals, identify trends, and take action to avoid cost overruns and take advantage of opportunities
* Assess performance of cost control system & personnel.

**Team Collaboration And Supervision**

* Provide clear and focused leadership for the project team to create a vision for project success and a strategy to fit that vision.
* Define roles and responsibilities, in particular the respective roles of the Project Director vis a vis the Project Manager(s).
* Focus team on achievement of milestones and other key project objectives.
* Listen to the team, discuss the issues, resolve problems, and direct activities to remove roadblocks and achieve objectives.
* Participate in staff performance evaluations.
* Identify and implement training requirements.

**Project Execution And Quality Assurance**

* Define the project quality requirements.
* Ensure the right systems are in place and that these are applied on the project.
* Development of a project schedule which allows work to be executed in a logical sequence.
* Compliance with Worley policies and procedures.
* Implement lessons learned system.

**Documentation And Communication**

* Effective communications with the project team.
* Documented communication requirements.
* Accurate, timely & effective progress reporting to the Client and internally to Worley management.
* Ongoing monitoring of the communication network between project staff, the client and third parties and introduction of changes where required.

**Specifications And Bid Activities**

* Ensure that clear objectives set for the design team.
* Assess the design activities and ensure a 'fit for purpose' design of the plant.
* Monitor design activities, interdisciplinary data flow and communications.

**Constructability, Operability, And Maintainability**

* Ensure that clear objectives set for the procurement and subcontracts team.
* Assess procurement process throughout the project to ensure goods meet specification, are delivered on time and are within budget.
* Set clear objectives for the Construction team.
* Monitor the Construction Management function to ensure safe delivery of the project within cost and schedule objectives.

**About You**
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
  
  
**Qualifications / Skill Set**

* Relevant degree or equivalent qualification (Chartered Engineer preferable).
* Proven track record of working as a in the capacity of senior project manager for medium/large scale project (TIC 25 Min US$ and above).

**Professional Experience**

* Minimum of 15 years + industry experience.
* Ability to direct a project, with the direct supervision and coordination provided by the Project Manager(s).
* Demonstrable commitment to HSE Management in a project environment.
* Excellent leadership and communication skills.
* High level of customer focus.
* Previous experience as a Senior project manager / project manager on medium/large projects more than US$25m total value.

**Leadership And Project Management**

* Possesses leadership experience, having worked in project leadership roles, emphasizing the ability to drive successful project outcomes.
* Skilled in estimating project costs and writing proposal content, contributing to Worley's goals to be a leader in sustainability solutions.

**Health, Safety, And Environmental (HSE) Commitment**

* Work with project manager(s) to ensure that HSE requirements are documented and understood by all project participants.
* Compliance with HSE procedures.
* Maintain HSE focus for project duration.

**Results-Oriented And Accountability**

* Achieves results set by self and others, meeting timelines, and pushing for stretch goals, reflecting Worley's commitment to delivering value over the life of assets.
* Demonstrates accountability for work produced, ensuring it is "right the first time," in line with Worley's promise to be the industry's straight-talking partner.

**Moving forward together**
We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
  
  
And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
  
  
And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Project Management Officer
description:
**Designation:**
Project Management Officer

**Experience:**
5 - 7 years

**Location:**
Mira Road

**Working Hours**
: 10:00 AM 6:00 PM

**Working Days**
: Mon - Sat

**Website**
:
www.asmitagroup.com

**Job Purpose**

To support the planning, monitoring, coordination, and control of real estate construction projects by ensuring timely execution, effective resource utilization, cost monitoring, and adherence to project schedules, quality standards, and management directives.

The PMO will act as a central coordination point between project sites, project heads, contractors, consultants, procurement, billing, and senior management to ensure smooth project execution and timely reporting.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Project Planning & Monitoring**

* Develop, review, and monitor project schedules, milestones, and execution plans.
* Track progress across multiple construction projects against approved timelines and budgets.
* Identify delays, bottlenecks, and critical activities, and coordinate with project teams to resolve issues.
* Maintain project trackers, dashboards, and progress reports for management review.
* Monitor key milestones such as approvals, excavation, RCC structure, Mivan cycle, masonry, finishing, and project completion.

**2. Management Reporting & MIS**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly project progress reports for senior management.
* Consolidate updates from site teams and highlight planned versus actual progress.
* Prepare dashboards covering project timelines, cost, manpower, material requirements, pending decisions, and critical issues.
* Track action points from management meetings and ensure timely closure by the concerned teams.
* Escalate project risks, deviations, and unresolved issues to management.

**3. Interdepartmental Coordination**

* Coordinate with Project Heads, Site Engineers, Planning Engineers, QS and Billing, Procurement, Stores, Consultants, Architects, and Liaisoning teams.
* Follow up on pending drawings, approvals, material procurement, contractor deployment, and other project dependencies.
* Ensure timely communication between site teams and the corporate office.
* Monitor interdepartmental deliverables that may affect project schedules.

**4. Cost & Resource Monitoring**

* Track project budgets, expenditure, and cost variations in coordination with the Finance and QS teams.
* Monitor contractor progress, billing milestones, material consumption, and resource utilization.
* Highlight budget deviations, cost overruns, and potential savings to management.
* Assist in forecasting resource requirements and identifying execution inefficiencies.

**5. Risk Management & Problem Resolution**

* Identify potential risks relating to timelines, costs, resources, approvals, and construction progress.
* Maintain a risk and issue register with clear ownership and target resolution dates.
* Follow up on corrective and preventive actions with the concerned departments.
* Ensure timely escalation of critical project issues.

**6. Documentation & Process Compliance**

* Maintain project schedules, meeting minutes, progress reports, trackers, and management review records.
* Establish standardized reporting formats and project monitoring procedures.
* Ensure project documentation is updated and accessible to authorized stakeholders.
* Monitor compliance with internal project management processes and reporting timelines.

**7. Site Visits & Performance Review**

* Conduct periodic site visits to validate reported progress and identify execution challenges.
* Review site performance against agreed project milestones.
* Coordinate project review meetings with Project Heads and other stakeholders.
* Track the closure of observations and commitments made during site reviews.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* A Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering and a postgraduate qualification in Construction Management or Project Management are both mandatory.
* 5 to 7 years of experience in project planning, project controls, PMO, or project coordination within real estate or construction.
* Experience monitoring high-rise residential or commercial construction projects is preferred.
* Working knowledge of construction schedules, project milestones, cost tracking, and progress monitoring.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and project reporting tools. Knowledge of MS Project, Primavera P6, or ERP systems will be an advantage.
* Strong analytical, coordination, documentation, and reporting skills.

You’ll lead the planning and delivery of a safe, well-run and engaging KPL tournament, bringing together cricket competition, participant logistics, venues, staffing and event operations.

Your responsibility starts well before tournament week: building the team, securing resources, managing the budget and ensuring everything is ready before participants arrive. You’ll lead live delivery through to safe departures and post-event review.

The tournament is being planned for up to 12 franchises, each with 15 selected players—180 players at full scale—alongside coaches, support staff and other attendees.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Plan and prepare the tournament:**
  Develop the timetable, budget, staffing model and operating plan. Appoint delivery partners, agree responsibilities and lead readiness reviews and rehearsals.
* **Ensure child safety and welfare:**
  Work with safeguarding specialists to establish qualified safeguarding, welfare and medical provision, appropriate staffing checks, supervision, consent and emergency procedures across all tournament activities.
* **Coordinate participant logistics:**
  Manage agreed travel arrangements, transfers, accommodation where required, meals, hydration and equipment movements. Ensure clear communication and safe participant handovers.
* **Deliver the cricket competition:**
  Work with cricket leadership to coordinate fixtures, venues, pitches, practice facilities, officials, scoring, equipment and coach availability.
* **Manage event operations:**
  Coordinate accreditation, security, spectators, accessibility, facilities, ceremonies and agreed guest and sponsor commitments. Work with specialists on permissions, insurance and supplier requirements.
* **Plan promotion and production:**
  Develop costed proposals for photography, filming, streaming or broadcasting. Deliver the approved scope with Marketing and production partners, ensuring appropriate permissions, child-image consent and content handling.
* **Lead live delivery:**
  Run daily briefings, event communications and operational decisions. Maintain contingency plans for weather, transport disruption, medical incidents and other delivery issues.
* **Control budgets and suppliers:**
  Track costs with Finance, manage changes and hold partners accountable for agreed deliverables.
* **Complete the handover and close-out:**
  Agree squad-information and readiness requirements with franchise teams, oversee safe departures, reconcile supplier costs and complete incident follow-up and the post-event review.

**What you'll bring**

* Proven experience leading complex, multi-day sporting events or tournaments.
* Experience building and managing multidisciplinary teams, agencies and suppliers.
* Strong operational planning skills across venues, transport, accommodation and participant logistics.
* Practical experience implementing safeguarding and welfare arrangements for children and young people.
* Confidence managing budgets, supplier commitments and changes to scope.
* Calm judgement under pressure, with the ability to resolve issues and escalate decisions appropriately.
* Clear communication with delivery teams, franchise representatives, families and senior stakeholders.

Experience in cricket tournaments and coordinating event filming, streaming or broadcast production would be an advantage.

**What success looks like**

* Teams, venues, suppliers and safety arrangements ready before participants arrive.
* Children safely supervised and supported throughout their tournament experience.
* Reliable transport, logistics and daily operations.
* Fixtures and agreed event activities delivered successfully.
* Positive feedback from players, families and franchise teams.
* Delivery within the approved budget, with complete records and actions followed through.

* Help build internal efficiencies and accelerators for the proposition

**Required-**

* Proficient in Oracle Fusion (experience of 4-7 years in Fusion & eBS combined) and/ or Oracle eBusiness Suite for Tax
* Experience in project implementation lifecycle (requirements gathering, design, build, test, go-live and support) with at least 2-3 end-to-end implementations of Oracle ERP for tax

title: Manager- Curriculum and Program Design
description:
**Manager – Curriculum & Program Design**

**Work Location: Mumbai**

**About the role**

We are looking for someone who is deeply curious about how young people learn, how careers are changing, and what it takes to build meaningful pathways from school to work in India.

At Antarang, Curriculum and Program Design sits at the intersection of education, pedagogy, career guidance, Future of Work, government education systems, social justice practices and young people’s transition from school to work. The work requires you to go deep into unfamiliar subjects, ask difficult questions, find credible answers and navigate complexity — whether researching an emerging sector, understanding a career pathway or policy, or translating complex ideas into meaningful learning experiences.

You will also lead the curriculum team. This means the role is as much about developing people and building a high-performing team as it is about the quality of the work. You will need to balance empathy with high expectations, give thoughtful feedback, create space for creativity, and hold a strong bar for rigour, quality and timelines.

We are looking for a strong thinker and builder who challenges assumptions, spots what’s missing, and brings depth, rigour and creativity to the work. If you enjoy going deep, asking difficult questions and continuously making things better, and care deeply about the quality of what reaches young people, this could be a great fit.

**What you will do**

**Design and build high-quality program solutions**

* Lead the design, development and refinement of
  **program interventions**

  — taking complex questions such as
  *How should we support students through transition? What should gender-responsive career guidance look like? How do we strengthen parent, industry and school engagement? What should our digital learning ecosystem look like?*

  and turning them into
  **clear frameworks, approaches, tools and program resources**

  .
* Translate evidence, field insights, stakeholder needs and emerging opportunities into practical, high-quality solutions that can work at scale.
* Set a high bar for depth, rigour, relevance and usability, asking not just whether something works on paper, but whether it will meaningfully improve outcomes for young people and those implementing our programs.
* Bring creativity, structured thinking and strong judgement to solving complex program challenges — balancing what is desirable with what is feasible, scalable and sustainable.

**Bring depth, research and sector expertise**

* Develop deep expertise across career education, pedagogy, the Indian education system, Future of Work, emerging careers, labour markets and education-to-employment pathways.
* Lead desk and field research to investigate questions, test assumptions and build the evidence base for curriculum and program decisions.
* Synthesise research, data, stakeholder perspectives and field insights into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Stay curious about what is changing across education, technology, industries and the world of work, and bring those insights into our programs.

**Design from the reality of students and classrooms**

* Stay close to implementation through classroom visits, student and teacher feedback, and analysis of learning and implementation data.
* Use evidence from the field to understand what is working, what isn't, and why — and continuously support states in delivering a high quality career program.
* Ensure there is a strong connection between what looks good on paper and what actually works in a classroom.

**Lead the Curriculum Team and Enable Organisational Collaboration**

* Lead and develop a team of curriculum professionals, setting clear expectations for quality, ownership, rigour and timelines.
* Coach team members to think critically, research independently, make strong decisions and continuously strengthen their work.
* Ensure state teams have timely, responsive curriculum support, adapting quickly to emerging needs and different implementation contexts.
* Partner with other verticals on cross-functional priorities, bringing curriculum and program expertise to shared projects and organisational goals.

**Turn ideas into high-quality delivery**

* Own
  **project plans, timelines, dependencies and milestones**

  across multiple curriculum projects.
* Prioritise effectively, anticipate risks and unblock the team early.
* Coordinate across Curriculum, Training, State teams, MEL and other functions to ensure work moves smoothly.
* Hold yourself and the team accountable for delivering
  **high-quality work, on time**

  , bringing structure to complexity without limiting creativity.

**What we're looking for**

* 7+ years of relevant experience in education, curriculum, learning design, career guidance, education research or a closely related field,
  **with experience leading a curriculum or program development project from conception to delivery.**
* Strong understanding of pedagogy, student learning, curriculum design and career education, including the school-to-work transition.
* Knowledge of India’s education ecosystem, particularly government schools, alongside curiosity about the country’s labour market, emerging sectors, Future of Work, careers and skills.
* Excellent research, analytical and content judgement — you enjoy getting to the bottom of a question, interrogating evidence and conducting deep, rigorous reviews.
* Ability to translate complex ideas, research and field insights into clear, engaging and meaningful program or curriculum design.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, timelines and dependencies while maintaining quality.
* Experience managing, mentoring or coaching a team, with a genuine interest in developing people.
* Ability to work effectively with different stakeholders and across verticals, including government representatives, parents and school leaders.
* Experience with physical and digital learning formats is a plus.
* Willingness to travel regularly to schools, government offices and program locations.
* Proficiency in English and at least one of Hindi, Marathi or Urdu, including reading, writing and speaking.

title: MEP Manager
description:
**Job Description**
MEP Manager is required to manage the complete governance, planning, execution, and commissioning of all Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) systems across the entire High Rise Residential Project.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Project Planning & Strategy**

* Develop and own the comprehensive MEP execution plan aligned with the overall project master schedule.
* Establish MEP milestones, resource histograms, procurement schedules, and inspection test plans (ITPs).
* Lead MEP constructability reviews at design, procurement, and pre-construction stages.
* Define the MEP phasing strategy to align with the project's luxury delivery standards and client expectations.
* Conduct risk assessments for MEP scope and implement mitigation measures proactively.

**Design Management & Technical Leadership**

* Review, evaluate, and approve MEP design drawings, specifications, and BOQs prepared by consultants.
* Manage design coordination between MEP disciplines and other trades (civil, structural, architecture).
* Lead BIM/3D coordination processes to resolve inter-discipline clashes prior to construction.
* Provide technical guidance on selection of MEP systems appropriate for luxury high-rise standards (HVAC, BMS, ELV, firefighting, plumbing, electrical, lifts, etc.).
* Review and approve method statements, material submittals, and shop drawings from subcontractors.
* Advise on value engineering opportunities without compromising system performance or luxury quality.

**Procurement & Subcontract Management**

* Develop MEP procurement strategy in coordination with the procurement department.
* Evaluate technical bids, prepare technical bid analysis, and recommend award of MEP packages.
* Review and finalize MEP subcontract scopes of work (SOW), terms, and technical annexures.
* Manage subcontractor performance, adherence to scope, quality, schedule, and budget.
* Negotiate and approve variations with MEP subcontractors in coordination with commercial team.

**Construction Supervision & Quality Control**

* Oversee day-to-day installation activities of all MEP trades on site across all floors and zones.
* Ensure MEP installations comply with approved drawings, specifications, and applicable codes (IBC, NFPA, ASHRAE, IEC, local authority standards).
* Implement and enforce the project's quality management system (QMS) across all MEP activities.
* Conduct and chair regular MEP site inspections, audits, and walk-downs.
* Review and certify MEP progress for interim payment applications (IPAs) from subcontractors.
* Ensure MEP works are executed in sequence to support luxury interior finishing requirements.

**Scheduling & Progress Monitoring**

* Monitor MEP progress against the baseline schedule; identify delays and drive recovery plans.
* Prepare and present weekly and monthly MEP progress reports to senior management and client.
* Coordinate MEP programme with the project planning team (Primavera P6 / MS Project).
* Track manpower deployment, productivity benchmarks, and material deliveries against plan.
* Coordinate early MEP works (sleeves, conduits, embedded items) with civil/structural activities.

**HSE & Regulatory Compliance**

* Champion a strong safety culture across all MEP works in line with the project HSE plan.
* Ensure MEP-related Method Statements & Risk Assessments (MSRA) are in place and toolbox talks conducted.
* Liaise with local authorities and utilities (DEWA, SEWA, Civil Defense, TRA, etc.) for approvals, inspections, and connections.
* Manage all MEP NOC and permit submissions to statutory authorities.
* Ensure compliance with environmental regulations during MEP installation and commissioning.

**Testing, Commissioning & Handover**

* Develop and manage the MEP commissioning plan and schedule in coordination with the project commissioning manager.
* Oversee pre-commissioning, commissioning, integrated testing, and system performance validation.
* Manage HVAC balancing, fire alarm testing, CCTV, access control, BMS integration, and utility connections.
* Ensure preparation of O&M manuals, as-built drawings, warranties, and training documentation.
* Support the handover of MEP systems to the facility management (FM) team and client.
* Manage the MEP defects liability period (DLP) and coordinate timely close-out of snag lists.

**Cost Management & Budget Control**

* Monitor MEP expenditure against the approved budget and forecast to complete (FTC).
* Review and approve MEP variation orders in line with contractual and commercial procedures.
* Support quantity surveyors in MEP re-measurement, certification, and final account settlement.
* Identify and implement cost-saving measures without compromising quality or luxury standards.

**Stakeholder & Client Management**

* Act as the primary MEP interface with the client, employer's agent (EA), and consultant team.
* Present MEP progress, risks, and mitigation strategies to the client and steering committee.
* Coordinate MEP requirements with interior designers for luxury finishes and concealed installations.
* Manage relationships with authorities, utility providers, and third-party inspectors.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a multi-disciplinary MEP engineering team of engineers, coordinators, and supervisors.
* Set performance objectives, conduct appraisals, and identify training needs for MEP team members.
* Foster a collaborative, high-performance culture within the MEP division.
* Coordinate closely with project management, commercial, procurement, and QA/QC departments.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical / Electrical Engineering.
* Minimum overall 12+ years experience.
* Minimum 8-10 years experience with High Rise/ Residential projects.

**Professional Certifications (Preferred / Advantageous)**
  
  

* PMP – Project Management Professional (PMI)
* LEED AP BD+C or BREEAM Accreditation
* ASHRAE Membership / Certification (for Mechanical background)
* Chartered Engineer (CEng) – IET, CIBSE, IMechE, or equivalent
* OSHA / NEBOSH Safety Certification
* BIM Certification (Level 2 or above)
* Excellent communication skills

**About Us**
Hill International, with more than 4,400+ professionals in over 100 offices worldwide, provides program management, project management, construction management, project management oversight, advisory, facilities management, and other consulting services to clients in a variety of market sectors. Engineering News-Record magazine recently ranked Hill as one of the largest program management firms in the world. For more information on Hill, please visit our website at www.hillintl.com .
  
  
Hill is exclusively a program, project, and construction management provider, meaning we have one focus as a company: protecting client interests. Free of any potential conflicts, our entire business is geared towards helping clients achieve their desired outcomes. We are dedicated to exceeding expectations throughout the entire construction project lifecycle and adapt to the needs of each assignment to develop tailored approaches and solutions to meet those needs.
  
  
Hill is a GISI Consulting Group company, part of the Global Infrastructure Solutions, Inc. (GISI) family of companies. Learn more about GISI Consulting Group at www.gisiconsulting.com .
  
  
**Hill International is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Veteran/Disabled**

title: Video Platform Launch & Implementation Strategist
company: Sanjeev Tanna Education PVT Ltd.(STEPL) |NGN Learning| My Feeling Studio|
description:
**About the opportunity**

We are preparing to launch an educational video learning platform across schools in India. We seek a highly experienced, independent and execution-focused professional to evaluate launch readiness, anticipate obstacles, devise practical solutions, build a phased roadmap and guide teams through implementation and scale-up.

This is not a presentation-only advisory position. The consultant must challenge assumptions, separate launch blockers from desirable improvements, guide decisions and stay actively involved in execution.

**1. Product and platform readiness**

Independently assess platform features, architecture, reliability, usability, accessibility and overall maturity.

Test video playback, navigation, audio, synchronization and device performance on intended Windows and Android tablets.

Review online/offline functionality where applicable, poor connectivity, content delivery, storage, updates, licensing and access control.

Evaluate the experience from student, teacher, school administrator and technical support perspectives.

Identify missing capabilities, technical bottlenecks, critical defects and practical remedial actions.

**Expected deliverable:**
Product Readiness Audit with severity-ranked gaps and launch-readiness recommendations.

**2. School deployment feasibility**

Assess infrastructure across metropolitan, urban, semi-urban and rural schools, including connectivity, electricity and IT support.

Review device specifications, classroom displays, speakers, shared-device setups, maintenance and daily setup requirements.

Evaluate curriculum/timetable fit, teacher digital confidence and regional/language requirements.

Compare private, government, aided and school-chain deployment conditions and recommend appropriate models.

**Expected deliverable:**
School Deployment Feasibility Report with school segmentation, prerequisites and deployment models.

**3. Proactive risk and roadblock forecasting**

Identify technical failures: crashes, playback issues, device incompatibility, outages, update failures, security and hardware issues.

Identify operational failure points: logistics delays, training gaps, weak support, unclear ownership and multisite coordination.

Identify adoption risks: teacher resistance, low classroom use, weak engagement and gaps between procurement and actual use.

Identify business risks: pricing, sales cycles, acquisition and servicing costs, renewals and unsustainable scale economics.

Review applicable student privacy, child safety, intellectual property, contracts and education-sector compliance requirements.

For every material risk document likelihood, impact, early-warning signs, mitigation, contingency plan, owner and escalation trigger.

**Expected deliverable:**
Prioritized Risk Register, Early-Warning Dashboard, Mitigation Plan and Contingency Playbook.

**4. Launch strategy and rollout roadmap**

Phase 1: establish baseline readiness, critical corrections and validation standards.

Phase 2: select pilot schools, define success metrics, prepare devices, onboard staff and monitor field usage.

Phase 3: resolve pilot findings, refine training/support procedures and validate improvements.

Phase 4: prioritize regions and school segments, deploy regional resources and monitor operations.

Phase 5: expand to PAN India only when pilot and regional go/no-go thresholds are met.

Specify milestone dates, budget ranges, dependencies, staffing, accountable owners and decision gates.

**Expected deliverable:**
Phased Launch Roadmap, Resource Plan, Milestone Tracker and Go/No-Go Criteria.

**5. Technical testing and quality assurance**

Set the end-to-end QA approach for video quality, audio clarity, lip sync, navigation, device compatibility and reliability.

Define field scenarios for intermittent internet, shared devices, school hardware and concurrent usage where relevant.

Coordinate defect triage, developer fixes, retesting, release acceptance and escalation of unresolved blockers.

Create clear release-readiness checklists with pass/fail criteria and named sign-off owners.

**Expected deliverable:**
QA Framework, Defect Prioritization Process and Release Readiness Checklist.

**6. School onboarding, adoption and support**

Design school onboarding, teacher training, reference material and administrator enablement.

Define school coordinator responsibilities, helpdesk procedures, ticket escalation and service expectations.

Measure actual classroom usage, teacher readiness, satisfaction and ongoing adoption.

Use feedback from students, teachers and school management to refine deployment workflows.

**Expected deliverable:**
School Onboarding and Adoption Framework with Training and Support SOPs.

**7. Commercial and operational scalability**

Evaluate direct versus partner-led school acquisition, distribution, pricing, packaging and licensing models.

Estimate one-time and recurring costs per school, including devices, field deployment, support, training and maintenance.

Develop staffing and operational models for hundreds and thousands of schools.

Define unit economics, capacity constraints, renewal drivers and key management metrics.

**Expected deliverable:**
Commercial Feasibility and Scalability Assessment with scenario-based costs.

**8. Vendors, partners and team capability**

Identify and assess technology, implementation, logistics, training and service partners as needed.

Recommend outsourcing versus in-house responsibilities and vendor selection criteria.

Review scopes of work, service levels, ownership, fallback partners and critical dependencies.

Assess internal skills and capacity gaps that could delay deployment.

**Expected deliverable:**
Partner and Resource Strategy, Team Responsibility Matrix and Vendor Evaluation Criteria.

**9. Hands-on execution leadership**

Work with management, product, content, development, operations and field teams to convert plans into concrete actions.

Run structured implementation reviews, unblock dependencies and recommend practical alternatives when plans fail.

Track issue owners, due dates, completion evidence and decisions requiring leadership input.

Escalate emerging risks before they compromise launch dates, costs or school experience.

**Expected deliverable:**
Master Execution Tracker, Weekly Reviews and Decision/Escalation Log.

**10. Reporting and project governance**

Maintain milestone dashboards, risk and issue registers, quality metrics, budgets and resource utilization.

Report completed items, pending tasks, forecast problems, next decisions and recommended corrective actions.

Make readiness and rollout decisions traceable with written criteria and accountable sign-offs.

**Expected deliverable:**
Weekly Leadership Report and Stage-Gate Decision Pack.

**Required qualifications and experience**

8–15+ years in EdTech, educational technology deployment, product launch or large-scale implementation preferred.

Documented experience deploying technology solutions in Indian schools, ideally across multiple states or school networks.

Strong knowledge of Indian school operations, institutional procurement, classroom realities and digital adoption.

Working technical understanding of learning platforms, video delivery, tablets, QA and school IT constraints.

Demonstrated strength in risk management, project governance, operating budgets and cross-functional execution.

Ability to communicate difficult findings clearly and provide actionable solutions rather than generic advice.

**Strongly preferred experience**

Personally led or meaningfully owned deployment across 100+ schools or multiple states.

Worked with school groups, education departments or institutional school customers.

Launched video-based learning, digital classrooms, learning management systems or tablet-enabled programs.

Built repeatable pilot-to-rollout processes including teacher training, SOPs and field support.

Operated in low-connectivity environments and anticipated significant issues before launch.

**Success will be measured by**

Completeness and independence of product and school-readiness assessments.

Early discovery and prevention of launch-blocking technical, adoption and operational risks.

A realistic, costed roadmap with specific owners, dependencies and measurable milestones.

Validated pilot outcomes, issue resolution, teacher adoption and platform usage.

Repeatable, supportable deployment economics and evidence-based readiness for regional and national expansion.

**Application requirements**

Applicants should submit their professional profile, relevant deployments and measurable outcomes, school/state coverage, an example of a major anticipated or resolved rollout problem, an outline of their approach to this assignment, availability and expected fees or compensation.

**Application subject:**
Video Platform Launch & Implementation Strategist | PAN India

**Suggested engagement structure (for hiring team)**

**Weeks 1–3 | Independent audit:**
Product and operational assessment; critical risks; readiness baseline.

**Weeks 4–6 | Roadmap and pilot design:**
Prioritized fixes; pilot school criteria; budget; project governance and go/no-go gates.

**Weeks 7–12 | Pilot execution:**
Field testing; teacher onboarding; evidence collection; issue resolution and pilot evaluation.

**Post-pilot | Controlled expansion:**
Regional expansion with validated operating model; nationwide scale only after approval.

Planning windows are illustrative and must be validated after the initial audit.

title: Brand Solutions Executive
description:
**Company:**
**Skadoosh Media**
Skadoosh is an independent agency established in Mumbai, 2016. Fueled by creativity with a penchant for innovation, we deliver service excellence across Digital Marketing, Creatives, Branding, Content Production & Websites.
  
  
With our creative-first philosophy to marketing, we specialise in creating distinct visual style coupled with strategic execution for our partners. Our approach ensures that a brand’s unique language remains consistent and impactful.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a
**Brand Solutions Executive**
, you will be responsible for the day-to-day management and execution of client accounts. You will work closely with Brand Managers and cross-functional teams to ensure projects move seamlessly from planning to delivery while maintaining exceptional client service.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who is organised, detail-oriented, proactive and eager to build a career in brand management and client servicing.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities
  
  
Client Servicing**

* Be the primary day-to-day point of contact for assigned clients.
* Manage client communication, follow-ups, approvals and feedback.
* Build strong client relationships through proactive, timely and professional communication.
* Understand client objectives and ensure expectations are managed effectively throughout every project.

**Project & Timeline Management**

* Coordinate with the Creative, Copy, Video, and Performance Marketing teams to ensure seamless execution.
* Manage project timelines, deliverables and internal workflows across multiple brands.
* Ensure all deliverables are completed on schedule and meet Skadoosh's quality standards.
* Proactively identify risks, resolve bottlenecks and escalate issues where required.

**Content & Social Media Management**

* Develop and manage monthly content calendars aligned with client objectives and brand strategy.
* Review all deliverables for quality, accuracy and brand consistency before sharing them with clients.
* Manage assigned social media portfolios, including content publishing coordination, community management and Online Reputation Management (ORM), where applicable.
* Stay updated on platform trends and recommend relevant content opportunities for clients.

**Campaign Execution**

* Execute social media campaigns, launches and integrated marketing initiatives across assigned brands.
* Coordinate with the Paid Media team for Meta, Google and LinkedIn advertising campaigns to ensure smooth execution.
* Understand campaign objectives, target audiences, budgets and timelines to facilitate effective coordination between clients and internal teams.
* Present campaign updates and performance insights to clients in collaboration with the relevant internal teams.
* Ensure campaigns are executed as planned while maintaining quality and timelines.

**Reporting & Documentation**

* Maintain project trackers, meeting notes and client documentation.
* Prepare monthly performance reports with key insights and recommendations.
* Ensure all client communication, approvals and project records are organised and documented.
* Monitor project progress and proactively follow up on pending deliverables.

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong organisational and project management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple brands and deadlines simultaneously.
* High attention to detail with a strong sense of ownership.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced agency environment and adapt to changing priorities.
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with the ability to anticipate challenges before they arise.

**Preferred**

* Experience working on Hospitality, Realty and/or Alco-Bev brands.
* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude to improve productivity and workflows.
* Working knowledge of project management tools such as ClickUp, Asana, Notion or Trello.

title: Job Delivery Lead
description:
The Job Delivery Lead is responsible for directing the field employee in safe, reliable, and efficient product and service delivery. The Job Delivery Lead is also responsible for driving customer satisfaction and service quality while ensuring an efficient cost structure, and drives field employee progression through competency development and performance evaluation. This person collaborates with the OU PSD or PSD Manager for job life cycle support including technical and incident management, and ensures systematic usage of standard work and risk management throughout the service delivery process. * Conduct pre- and postjob briefs for every job. Discuss and communicate risks and controls to field personnel.
* Manage incident life cycle for medium- and low-severity incidents, escalating as needed, and conduct incident response and recovery.
* Assist PSD Manager in incident investigation, validation of results, and reviews.
* Manage service delivery process to exceed customer expectations.
* Manage all job incidents and job changes, in the form of exemptions and MOCs.
* Manage quality control of all field deliverables.
* Ensure customer acceptance of service delivery.
* Ensure support to other functional processes with proper handoffs at key interfaces.
* Performs field operations as required.

10-12 years

Change Management Consultant (VP)

: Compliance Hub (India CoE)
  
  
**About Business line/Function:**
Compliance Hub - India CoE is dedicated to safeguarding the Group's reputation and mitigating risk across its global businesses by supporting a broad range of Compliance functions. The Hub serves as a strategic global partner to Compliance teams worldwide, delivering expertise in Financial Security (KYC, Sanctions, and AML), controls framework, conduct and professional ethics, data analytics and governance, and transformation initiatives including AI adoption. The Hub teams collaborate closely with Compliance and business stakeholders across the Group to drive efficiency, strengthen controls, and enhance operational resilience.
  
  
**Position Purpose:**
Lead business transformation and operational excellence initiatives across Compliance by applying process reengineering, lean, and structured change management methodologies. The role will partner with the Compliance domain managers, business, operations, technology and support functions to simplify and standardize processes, improve efficiency and control effectiveness, and ensure sustainable adoption of change. The individual will report directly to the Operational Excellence & Change Management Team Lead.
