title: APAC Project Manager
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
**About QAD Redzone**
Redzone helps manufacturers make more stuff for less while greatly improving the employee experience. While there is a lot of hype around digital transformation, the factory of the future, and Industry 4.0, the focus has been on the equipment and technology – not the people. At Redzone, we are all about the people, what we call “the connected worker.” We make frontline teams more engaged and more productive so their lives improve while contributing to positive business outcomes. We do this by combining exceptional software and world class coaching, giving our customers an average productivity increase of 22% in 90 days. Redzone brings together Production, Maintenance and Quality teams, improving the communications between those teams to resolve issues and increase output. Decision making happens on the shop floor by the people doing the work, in real time, for immediate impact and a better overall employee experience.
  
  
With over 1000 customers, 1200 plants and 325,000 users, Redzone is changing the way people work – one plant at a time.
  
  
Founded in 2013 with a bold vision to transform manufacturing performance, while bringing dignity back to the frontline worker. Redzone provides the tools that enable the self-organizing adaptive behavior of the front-line manufacturing team to win the productivity game, avoiding downtime, or quality losses.
  
  
**Job Description**
Under the leadership of Coaching Director, the Project Manager is responsible for management and oversight of Redzone’s project implementation.
  
  
This position is Full Time, Remote and required to travel 40% of the time.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Facilitate and lead the customer journey for 6-12 weeks after each new customer is added until we go onsite to coach.
* Participate in onsite Success Plan to focus the customer on the priority activities that need completion.
* Ensure signals are connected and tested prior to onsite coaching.
* Support the infrastructure and installation for Visual Factory.
* Guide the customer and provide support configuration to map Redzone to the customer’s site.
* Highlight any risks and address them with the customer team, Coaching Director, and Platform Leadership.
* Responsible for overseeing the deployment of Redzone software for multiple concurrent clients- manage the process from the handover from the sales team through providing onsite coaching services.
* Configure and setup Redzone software that matches the production process at the client’s manufacturing plant. This process must include manufacturing data such as product and equipment information and product run rates.
* Ensure automation signals from the plant (such as photo eyes or machine cycles) come back to the software and provide accurate and real time data to Redzone for the shop floor team.
* Ensure the contractor work with the hardware and automation happens quickly and efficiently while maintaining the project schedule and cost plan.
* Perform regular weekly status calls with active project teams across multiple clients in order to ensure project stays on track and all milestones are achieved.
* Responsible for the success of the software and coaching a “Green Go Live” based on project management leading up to that point.

title: Project Manager-Clinical data Management (FSP)
description:
Tech Observer is a Global Clinical Research Organization (CRO) & FSP Provider headquartered in Paramus, NJ, with a presence in Singapore, India, the UK, Denmark, and over 20 other countries. (www.tech-observer.com).

We are looking for Data Operation Project Manger for one of the sponsor in Mumbai ( 3 days WFO in a week).

**Primary Job Function**

- For clinical studies, data integration and data utilization, to manage as liaison person between the client and the CRO; or within the client organization as a process lead, the process for collecting data and data-related documents; to make the data available within the Patient Data Center (PDC) for the Clinical Teams and Brand Teams for further exploration to increase compound knowledge, for timely submission of up-to-standard data for registration dossiers for drugs within the client's organization or for prompt responding to internal and external (Regulatory Authorities) requests for information.

Core Job Responsibilities

* At study start-up, creates study settings in PDC, coordinates the review within the client organization of selected study documents, timely approves/co-approves essential clinical study documents in order to achieve study milestones within the planned timeline. Loads the study deliverables into PDC, guarantees that global client standards/requirements are met and that waivers are requested if needed.
* During study conduction and closeout, ensures the timely delivery and storage of up-to-standard datasets with supportive documentation from the CRO, as well as reviews and co-approves selected clinical study documents in order to enable access for the study team to agreed interim or final deliverables. Works as custodian for essential study data and documents that meet expected quality for subsequent Data Utilization projects and/or reproduction of the statistical output as included in the clinical study report.
* Safeguards data standardization across studies within the program/project, maintains oversight of standardization if studies of the same program/project are under different Data Operations Project Managers (DOPMs). Participates in submissions to facilitate data integration, secures uniform data management input for studies within a single program/project, and ensures the submission dossier is appropriately built up with data and related documentation.
* Reviews and provides input into critical documents for Data Integration and supports the actual Data Integration within DWS to guarantee an appropriate and complete description of available data and the production of high-quality integrated datasets/database and its proper storage in PDC.
* Ensures the delivery of high-quality Data Utilization deliverables and supporting documentation from the CRO or internal sources to properly store all related data, documentation, and statistical programs used in the Data Utilization project, as well as to facilitate rerunning the statistical programs used to produce the statistical output included in the Data Utilization report.
* May perform other duties as assigned.

**Position Accountability/Scope**

* Acts as a liaison between cross-functional areas and with CROs.
* Plans and prioritizes workload.
* Establishes and maintains effective relationships with team members, clients, and vendors; represents Data Operations at clinical project-related meetings and negotiates timelines.
* Approves study-related documents.
* Is accountable for high-quality, accurate clinical data made available on an ongoing, as-needed basis following the conduct of a clinical study or data utilization project. Failure to produce high-quality data could impact product registrations.

**Minimum Education**

- Academic degree or higher non-academic qualification in a technical or life sciences discipline.

Minimum Experience/Training Required

* At least five years of experience in Data Management or Data Processing within drug development.
* Responds appropriately to customer needs, focuses on team goals, and detects and addresses emerging problems.

* Several years of demonstrated experience in end-to-end vendor management and oversight across a broad range of vendor types

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
**Introduction**
Our goal at Pivotree is to help accelerate the future of frictionless commerce. We will help lead this change over the next decade because we believe a future where technology is embedded intimately into all aspects of our everyday lives can benefit everyone and will shape the interactions with the brands we love. We will help shape the future of frictionless commerce by working together with some of the best brands in the world and some of the best people in the industry to leverage converging technologies that will make it possible to accelerate frictionless commerce faster than ever.
  
  
Pivotree provides services focused on the design, implementation, management, and maintenance of complex ecommerce solutions for large enterprises. We provide the technical skills necessary to enable the effective use of technologies combined with the business context to leverage a solution to solve our clients' business challenges. We strive to fill the gaps in available technology with our own IP to reduce the barriers to adoption.
  
  
We enable inclusive, immersive and highly personalized experiences for our clients and their customers. We build our products with a view to productizing and scaling technology to lower the costs and reduce the risks of implementing and managing our integrated solutions. Each of our solutions starts with reliable and reputable e-commerce and MDM platforms, which run on enterprise grade infrastructure that are customized to meet a variety of client needs, situations, and budgets. Over the next 10 years we will add new categories and capabilities that will define frictionless commerce ecosystems.
  
  
This is a journey of technology acceleration combined with consumer readiness and adoption. We are looking for people capable of adapting relentlessly to the rapidly evolving world around us.
  
  
**About**
Pivotree is an AI-first company using cutting edge models from Gemini, Claude, CoWork and others. We use AI to automate and augment our workflows, develop new products, and find new ways of doing business. All employees use AI every day in their work and as part of teams continuously improving how we deliver.
  
  
As Senior Project Manager at Pivotree, you own end-to-end delivery for complex client engagements, managing scope, schedule, budget, and quality with independence. You lead Lead Project Managers assigned to individual workstreams. You bring strong stakeholder management and risk discipline to every project, and you use AI-assisted tools to accelerate status reporting and risk analysis while maintaining the judgment that keeps projects genuinely on track.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Own end-to-end delivery for assigned client projects: scope, schedule, budget, resourcing, and quality.
  
  
Lead Project Managers assigned to individual workstreams; ensure alignment and consistent governance.
  
  
Define and maintain project plans, RAID logs, and governance structures appropriate to project complexity.
  
  
Apply AI-assisted analytics to track schedule variance and resourcing risk; validate all AI-generated risk flags with project management judgment before acting.
  
  
Lead project status meetings and steering committee updates; communicate progress, risks, and decisions clearly to stakeholders.
  
  
Use AI writing assistance to accelerate status reports and steering committee materials; review and validate all AI-generated content before distribution.
  
  
Manage project financials: budget tracking, forecasting, and margin performance for assigned engagements.
  
  
Own risk and issue management: proactively identify risks and drive mitigation before they impact delivery.
  
  
Partner with Business Analysts, Architects, and engineering teams to ensure delivery stays aligned to scope and quality standards.
  
  
Manage client relationships day-to-day, building trust through transparent communication and consistent delivery.
  
  
Mentor Portfolio Coordinators and Project Managers on delivery discipline and AI tool usage.
  
  
**What Good Looks Like**
Analysis: Identifies project risks and interdependencies before they become delivery issues. Uses AI-assisted analytics to accelerate risk identification, but applies project judgment before acting.
  
  
Customer Orientation: Manages the project around the client's real business outcomes, not just the contracted scope.
  
  
Decisiveness: Makes clear decisions on scope trade-offs and resourcing without unnecessary delay.
  
  
Organizing Work: Governs a project with clear milestones, dependencies, and reporting cadences.
  
  
Working with Others: Builds trust with client stakeholders and cross-functional delivery teams.
  
  
Developing Others: Mentors Portfolio Coordinators and Project Managers on delivery discipline and AI tool usage.
  
  
Initiative: Identifies project risks and process improvements proactively; brings proposals to delivery leadership.
  
  
AI-First Mindset: Uses AI tools to accelerate risk analysis, status reporting, and steering committee materials. Validates every AI-generated artefact with project management judgment before it reaches clients.
  
  
**Skills And Competencies**
7 to 10 years of project management experience delivering complex technology engagements.
  
  
Deep expertise in project governance, risk management, and stakeholder communication.
  
  
Strong financial acumen; experienced managing project budgets and margin outcomes.
  
  
Uses AI-assisted analytics and writing tools to accelerate reporting; validates all AI-generated content before client delivery.
  
  
**Technical Skills**
Project management tools: expert in Jira, MS Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent.
  
  
AI-assisted project analytics: uses AI tools for risk pattern detection and schedule variance identification; validates all outputs before acting.
  
  
PMI-CAPM or PMO-PMP or Prince 2 Certification, PMO-ACP or CSM or SAFE certification and any AI related certifications will be of added advantage
  
  
Financial management: proficient in project budget tracking and margin analysis.
  
  
Executive communication: skilled in producing steering committee materials and status reports.
  
  
Pivotree is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace.

title: Security Program Manager, Infrastructure Physical Security
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
The Amazon Data Services (India) Pvt. Ltd. (ADSIPL) Data Center Security Group is seeking a highly talented and motivated Security Systems Project Manager to join our team. The team is responsible for the design, installation and integration of security systems equipment including, but not limited to, Access Control/Intrusion Detection and CCTV Surveillance systems.
  
  
You will also be responsible for the continuous review of existing standards and to stay abreast of developments in new technology that will enhance the physical security of ADSIPL data centers and co-locations. You will work directly with the Cluster Security Manager, the Infrastructure Operations and Construction teams, and other customers, both internal and external, to integrate the business' requirements into physical security systems design and implementation. Your work will include supporting the construction and deployment of physical security packages for all ADSIPL data centers and co-locations in the cluster. You will also work closely with contractors and vendors to ensure compliance with all security standards during the construction, testing and acceptance phases of the projects.
  
  
The ideal candidate for the role will have demonstrated the ability to work in all disciplines, at all levels; from technology research to system design and layout, oversight of construction and implementation, as well as maintenance and upgrades over the life of the system. You will have an in-depth knowledge of security technology, be innovative, highly organized, and will have demonstrated the ability to deliver results on time and within budget.
  
  
Key job responsibilities

title: Site Supervisor for Commercial Interiors
description:
**Company Description**
Interex Arch Designs Pvt. Ltd. is an ISO 9002 certified interior contracting firm operating across thirteen states in India. The company has delivered domestic and commercial interior projects for over a decade, focusing on comprehensive post-design solutions under one roof. Interex specializes in commercial complexes, financial institutions, hotels and restaurants, call centers, retail stores, and corporate offices. A multidisciplinary in-house team manages services such as gypsum work, partitions, carpentry, plumbing, electrical, air conditioning, painting, polishing, and civil work. The firm is known for its strong client relationships with leading brands like Future Group, Reliance, Kotak Mahindra Bank, and Mahindra Retail, emphasizing quality workmanship, competitive pricing, and timely delivery.

**Role Description**
The Site Supervisor for Commercial Interiors will oversee day-to-day site activities for interior projects, ensuring work is executed according to design specifications, quality standards, and safety guidelines. Responsibilities include coordinating with project managers, designers, contractors, and vendors, supervising site teams across trades such as carpentry, electrical, plumbing, and civil work, and monitoring progress against project timelines. The role involves conducting regular site inspections, managing material deliveries, resolving on-site issues, and maintaining clear documentation and reporting. The Site Supervisor will also ensure compliance with company policies, client requirements, and regulatory norms. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Mumbai.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in supervising commercial interior projects, including offices, retail stores, hospitality, and other corporate spaces.
* Strong knowledge of interior fit-out processes, including carpentry, gypsum and partition work, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, painting, and basic civil work.
* Ability to read and interpret architectural and MEP drawings, layouts, and technical specifications.
* Proficient in site coordination, vendor and contractor management, and daily work scheduling.
* Understanding of quality control standards, safety practices, and compliance with local building regulations.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills for collaborating with clients, consultants, and internal teams.
* Good problem-solving and decision-making abilities to address site challenges and maintain project timelines.
* Experience using basic project documentation tools (site reports, checklists, progress trackers); familiarity with MS Office is preferred.
* Diploma or degree in Civil Engineering, Interior Design, or a related field is preferred; relevant work experience in commercial interiors is essential.
* Willingness to work on-site in Mumbai and manage multiple projects or sites as required.

title: Drydock Manager
description:
Seaspan employees are goal-driven and thrive in a high-performance culture. Our integrated business model, with over 25 years of fleet life-cycle management expertise, provides the world’s major shipping companies with long-term leases on large, modern and technologically advanced vessels, combined with industry-leading ship management services. As owner and operator of the vessels, we provide skilled officers and crews dedicated to the safe, reliable, and economical operation of our fleet. Seaspan's fleet has evolved over time to meet the varying needs of our customer base. We own vessels in a wide range of sizes, from 2,500 TEU to 24,000 TEU. Our main operating offices are located in Singapore, Vancouver, Hong Kong, and Mumbai.
  
  
**Position Description:**
This position is responsible for the end-to-end planning, execution, and financial oversight of vessel drydocking and major repairs including unplanned and retrofits across a global fleet. The position serves as the primary technical link between the company, shipyards, and classification societies to ensure the dry-dock projects are delivered safely and on schedule.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities:**
  
  

* Is familiar with the Health, Safety, Environmental Protection and Quality Policy (PL-005), and understands the responsibilities under the Environmental Management System (EMS). In keeping with this and other compliance policies, they understand their duty to report any environmental noncompliance and/or concern to their manager or members of the senior management team (including the highest level of management) either directly or through the open reporting system as per Management System guidelines.
* Project Planning & Preparation: Lead the pre-planning phase, including pre-docking inspections, developing detailed technical specifications (standard and non-standard), and coordinating with vessels and vessel managers to identify specific repair needs. Making sure Seaspan vessels are docked at the most suitable and economical shipyard, at the most appropriate time and in the most cost-effective manner. Liaising with the vessel to order spares and stores prior docking in a timely manner. Liaising with the procurement team and local agency to ensure timely and cost-effective delivery of spares required for project execution.
* Shipyard & Vendor Management: Review shipyard quotations for accuracy & include missing items in the bid sheet, conduct cost/availability comparisons, and provide recommendations. Manage relationships with paint suppliers, subcontractors, and service providers.
* On-site Supervision: With the support of Vessel Managers, oversee all stages of drydock execution at the shipyard to ensure high-quality workmanship, adherence to timelines & budgets, and compliance with safety and environmental standards (QSHE). Assist Vessel manager in resolving operational issues to minimize downtime and delays
* Financial Control: Along with the Vessel Manager, manage the overall repair budget, monitor project expenses in real-time, and lead final invoice negotiations with the shipyard to identify cost-optimization opportunities. Variations in docking scope to be documented and approvals sought from relevant stakeholders. Ensure Maximum value from allocated Dry-dock budgets and costs saving potentials are harvested. Preparing 5-year CAPEX rolling budget forecast for the fleet with Vessel Managers. Analyze docking costs and invoices to identify cost optimization opportunities. Follow up with service vendors for any variation in repair cost.
* Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all work meets the requirements of classification societies, flag states, and international maritime regulations.
* Process Improvement: Improve and maintain standardized drydock procedures, software, and databases to track historical costs and performance metrics in line with industry-wide best practices.
* Documentation & Reporting:

+ Maintain dry-dock records, inspection reports, and repair logs
+ Ensure document control and compliance with audit requirements

**Requirements:**

* Education: Degree in Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, or a related discipline.
* Professional Experience:

+ Minimum 5–8 years of experience in ship management, superintendency, or shipyard project management.
+ Proven track record of managing large-scale drydocking projects and retrofits
+ Sailing experience as a Senior Engineer (e.g., 2nd Engineer or higher) is preferred.
+ Technical Skills:

  
  

+ Proficiency in drydock management software, ERP systems, and project management tools. Technologically driven, comfortable working in a digital environment, logical process development.
+ Leveraging data and system functionality to improve decision-making and operational performance.
+ Focus on standardization, continuous improvement, and workflow optimization across technical and operational activities.

**Core Competencies:**

* Project Management: Ability to manage complex, multi-million-dollar projects under tight deadlines.
* Negotiation: Assertive skills for handling shipyard contracts and final settlements.
* Communication: Strong interpersonal skills to coordinate with cross-functional teams, including fleet operations, marine assurance, procurement, and accounts.
* Mobility: Readiness for frequent international travel on short notice and ability to conduct physical vessel inspections.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

* Drydocking Planning Performance: Percentage deviation from planned costs and duration.
* Budget Alignment: Preparing competitive budget. Total project spend versus allocated budget.
* Vessel Turnaround Time: Minimizing downtime and ensuring on-time or before-time delivery from the yard.
* Safety & Quality: Number of health, safety, and environment (HSE) incidents or quality findings during the project.
* Corrective Actions & Continuous Improvement: Demonstrates management commitment to continual improvement

We are looking for someone who can build a network, mobilise people, and deliver measurable growth—not simply coordinate activities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Campus Network Development
  
  
- Identify and establish connections with colleges, universities, and student communities.
  
- Build relationships with student leaders, cultural societies, theatre groups, dance and music clubs, fashion societies, and college event organisers.
  
- Identify campuses with strong communities of aspiring artists, performers, models, and content creators.
  
- Develop a structured plan to expand SNC's reach across multiple colleges.
  
  
2. Campus Ambassador Recruitment & Management
  
  
- Recruit and onboard campus ambassadors across colleges and universities.
  
- Build and manage an active network of student representatives.
  
- Establish clear expectations, performance indicators, and engagement plans for ambassadors.
  
- Motivate ambassadors to promote the platform and generate relevant registrations and subscriptions.
  
- Monitor ambassador performance and identify opportunities to improve results.
  
  
3. Subscriber Acquisition & Platform Growth
  
  
- Develop campus-level strategies to generate artist registrations and paid subscriptions.
  
- Coordinate targeted promotional campaigns to introduce students and emerging artists to Stars N Celebs.
  
- Help prospective subscribers understand the platform's benefits, features, and subscription options.
  
- Identify effective ways to convert interested prospects into registered users and paying subscribers.
  
- Track the source of registrations and subscriptions to measure campaign effectiveness.
  
  
4. Campus Promotions & Partnerships
  
  
- Explore promotional opportunities through college festivals, talent showcases, cultural events, workshops, and student communities.
  
- Develop collaborations with college societies and relevant student organisations.
  
- Coordinate digital and on-campus promotional initiatives.
  
- Identify cost-effective opportunities to increase awareness and acquire subscribers.
  
  
5. Performance Tracking & Reporting
  
  
- Establish measurable targets for ambassador recruitment, active campus participation, registrations, and paid subscriptions.
  
- Track campaign performance and subscription conversions.
  
- Maintain regular communication with ambassadors and review their progress.
  
- Recommend improvements based on results and feedback.
  
- Provide periodic reports on programme performance and growth.
  
  
Who Should Apply?
  
  
We are particularly interested in candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas:
  
  
- Campus ambassador programmes.
  
- College outreach and student community management.
  
- Sales, business development, or customer acquisition.
  
- Influencer marketing and community building.
  
- Partnerships, event management, or field marketing.
  
- Digital marketing and growth initiatives.
  
  
Candidates with an existing network of colleges, student leaders, cultural societies, or campus representatives will have an advantage.
  
  
Desired Skills
  
  
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
  
- Networking, negotiation, and persuasion.
  
- Team coordination and leadership.
  
- Sales orientation and an understanding of conversion-driven activities.
  
- Planning, execution, and problem-solving.
  
- Familiarity with social media and digital promotion.
  
- Ability to work independently and take ownership of results.
  
  
What We Offer
  
  
- An opportunity to build and lead a campus growth initiative from the ground up.
  
- Experience in business development, community building, and subscriber acquisition.
  
- Exposure to India's entertainment and creator ecosystem.
  
- The opportunity to develop a network of campus ambassadors across colleges.
  
- A performance-oriented environment where ideas and results matter.
  
  
Engagement Details
  
  
- Organisation: Stars N Celebs
  
- Position: Campus Ambassador Program Manager
  
- Function: Growth, Partnerships & Subscriber Acquisition
  
- Work arrangement: To be discussed.
  
- Engagement model and compensation: To be discussed based on the agreed scope, responsibilities, and experience.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Interested candidates should apply through LinkedIn with their résumé and a brief note addressing the following:
  
  
1. What experience do you have in campus outreach, sales, business development, or community building?
  
2. Do you have existing connections with colleges, student communities, or campus ambassador networks?
  
3. How would you recruit campus ambassadors and drive paid subscriptions for Stars N Celebs?
  
  
We are looking for someone who can turn campus connections into meaningful platform growth.
  
  
Stars N Celebs — Talent is everywhere. Visibility is not.

title: SAP PM CS
description:
Job Description: SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly experienced and results-driven
**SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant**
with
**5 to 12 years**
of expertise across SAP Customer Service (CS), Service Management (SM), and S/4HANA Service.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for designing, configuring, and implementing end-to-end Service Management processes in an
**SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition (PCE) / RISE with SAP**
environment. You will bridge business requirements and functional architecture, manage cloud service governance, enable AI-driven service insights, and drive continuous optimization across the full service lifecycle.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Solution Design & Implementation
* Design, configure, and deploy S/4HANA Service Management processes across the entire service lifecycle: Engage, Sell, Contract, Plan, Schedule, Execute, Invoice, and Analyze.
* Map end-to-end business requirements to standard S/4HANA Service capabilities, including service quotations, service orders, service contracts, spare parts logistics, resource planning, billing, and analytics.
* Drive adoption of the latest S/4HANA PCE release innovations (e.g., service team determination, advanced execution processes, Fiori applications, and AI-powered service intelligence).
* S/4HANA Private Edition (PCE) Governance
* Operate effectively within the SAP S/4HANA PCE Shared Responsibility Model between the client and SAP Enterprise Cloud Services (ECS).
* Liaise with SAP for system-level operational tasks (e.g., infrastructure management, backups, maintenance, and upgrade administration).
* Lead client-side functional responsibilities, including business process configuration, functional validation, regression testing, and process governance based on SAP’s PCE Roles and Responsibilities framework.
* Service Order & Contract Management
* Configure and maintain service contract structures, recurring service billing plans, and auto-renewal mechanisms.
* Enable flexible billing scenarios, including Resource-Related Billing (RRB), Time & Material (T&M), and Fixed-Price billing models.
* Leverage modern platform features such as service contract template cloning and mass contract change capabilities.
* Service Planning, Execution & Logistics Integration
* Set up and optimize workforce planning, resource allocation, dispatching, and field service workflows.
* Configure plant and storage location parameters within service transactions to support multi-plant and multi-location service execution.
* Direct cross-module functional integration between service transactions and procurement (MM), inventory management, shipping, plant maintenance (PM), and follow-on financial postings.
* Data Migration, Testing & Integration
* Oversee data preparation, cleansing, transformation, and validation for service master data, active service contracts, and open service orders.
* Utilize the SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit and standard transition tools tailored for service artifacts.
* Coordinate functional and technical integrations across CRM, SAP Field Service Management (FSM), SAP CS, core logistics, and Finance (FI/CO).
* AI, Analytics & Continuous Process Improvement
* Implement embedded AI capabilities (e.g., Joule-assisted summaries, intelligent confirmations, and predictive service insights).
* Design custom Fiori dashboards, operational reports, and KPIs to monitor service performance and profitability.
* Guide business stakeholders through continuous improvement initiatives and the adoption of periodic SAP release features.
* Stakeholder Management & Documentation
* Facilitate requirements-gathering workshops, author detailed functional specifications (FS), and map target-state business process flows.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams spanning Logistics, Procurement, Finance, and Sales.
* Create training collateral, deliver end-user training, and lead hypercare support during deployment phases.

**Required Skills & Technical Expertise**

* Experience: 5–12 years of hands-on experience in SAP CS / SM / S/4HANA Service functional consulting.
* Core Module Competency: Comprehensive knowledge of S/4HANA Service (PCE) core functionality (Service Orders, Service Contracts, Resource-Related Billing, Invoicing, and Execution Logistics).
* Cloud Architecture: Clear operational understanding of the SAP PCE operating model, RISE with SAP frameworks, and cloud service boundary matrices.
* User Experience & Extensibility: Proficiency with modern SAP Fiori apps, standard OData APIs, and functional extensibility options.
* Integration Touchpoints: Strong cross-functional integration experience with PM, SD, MM, FI/CO, and SAP FSM.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Practical project experience with RISE with SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition implementations or migrations.
* Hands-on knowledge of SAP upgrade governance and release management protocols in PCE environments.
* Official SAP Certification in S/4HANA Service or related SAP functional modules.

**Soft Skills**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong consulting mindset with a proven ability to translate business strategy into technical solution designs.
* Proactive problem-solving capabilities and experience leading cross-functional delivery teams.

* Lead and execute power system planning and analysis projects, ensuring that deadlines and quality standards are met.
* Provide technical direction to other team members, including training and development of junior engineers.

**Data & Process Automation**

* Develop and implement automation tools using Python and other software to streamline repetitive tasks involved in power system analysis and reporting.
* Continuously improve modeling and data analysis processes by integrating new techniques and tools.

**Client & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as a point of contact for clients, engaging them to understand their technical requirements and ensuring effective delivery of solutions.

**Project Management**

**Innovation & Continuous Improvement**

* Stay updated with the latest technologies, trends, research, paper, policies and innovations in the energy and power systems sector.

**International Collaboration & Travel**

* Collaborate with international teams and clients, with the flexibility to work across multiple time zones.

title: Director, Travel & Expense Management
description:
We're seeking someone to join our team as a Travel & Expense Program Insights Lead to establish and continuously improve an integrated management information framework across Travel, Ground Transport, and Expense, delivering accurate, actionable insights for governance, operational oversight, vendor performance, compliance, and leadership decision-making.
  
  
In the Corporate Services division, we empower our businesses by creating collaborative workplace solutions and commercial services that enhance the employee and client experience, while optimizing the value of our sourcing and third-party lifecycle to enable the Firm to do-and-win business. This is a Director level position within the Travel & Expense Management team.
  
  
Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.
  
  
**What You'll Do In The Role**

* Design and maintain a standardized management information framework across Travel, Ground Transport, and Expense, including reporting cadence, data ownership, validation checkpoints, escalation protocols, and consistent KPI definitions.
* Consolidate, validate, reconcile, and analyze data from internal systems, vendor reports, billing files, expense data, and operational trackers, maintaining a reliable single source of truth.
* Develop monthly and quarterly executive dashboards covering volumes, cost, utilization, compliance, service quality, safety, vendor performance, exceptions, ageing items, root causes, and required decisions.
* Deliver actionable program insights across air, hotel, visa and travel support; GT route and fleet performance, billing and operational escalations; and expense ageing, rejected claims, policy exceptions, outliers, and audit observations.
* Identify and implement automation and process-improvement opportunities that strengthen data quality, visualization, analytical depth, reporting reliability, and turnaround time.
* Partner with Travel, Ground Transport, Expense, Finance, Sourcing, Compliance, technology, and vendor teams; support business, vendor, audit, and leadership reviews; and maintain action, follow-up, and closure reporting.

**What You'll Bring To The Role**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field; a postgraduate qualification or relevant certification is preferred.
* At least seven years of experience in management information, business analytics, reporting governance, or operational and financial controls, ideally within a global financial institution or shared-services environment.
* Demonstrated experience designing enterprise MIS frameworks, executive dashboards, KPIs, SLAs, reconciliations, data controls, exception management, and multi-source reporting.
* Advanced Excel and business-intelligence capability, with experience in data visualization, workflow automation, AI-enabled reporting, trend analysis, and root-cause analysis.
* Strong commercial and analytical judgment, with the ability to translate cost, volume, utilization, billing, compliance, safety, and vendor-performance data into clear recommendations.
* Executive-level communication, presentation, stakeholder-influencing, planning, prioritization, and team-leadership skills; relevant exposure to travel, ground transport, expense, vendor billing, audit, or financial governance is preferred.

**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
  
  
To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.
  
  
Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.
  
  
Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.
  
  
For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/eeo.

title: Senior Project Engineer
description: ETAP empowers customers to make informed decisions throughout the life cycle of their projects with innovative software solutions for electrical systems. By applying ETAP solutions, customers experience continuous intelligence during design and engineering and into operations and maintenance using a unified electrical digital twin platform. ETAP supports customers in their digital transformation and sustainable energy transitions for a green and smart future, helping them to prioritize safety, maximize reliability, and stay resilient.Our employees' passion for excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction is our most-prized resource. If you share that passion — and want to be part of a company that leads the energy transition towards a cleaner and more resilient world for future generations — we invite you to join us!ETAP is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.Job Title: Senior Project EngineerLocation: MumbaiEmployment Type: full-timeThe job In this role, you will be responsible for power system modeling, engineering analysis, real-time power system applications, ADMS/OMS, power automation, project engineering, testing, and commissioning. You will develop and validate electrical network models, perform static and dynamic power system studies, configure real-time applications using field data, and support integration with SCADA, DCS, IEDs, gateways, and external systems.The role also involves preparing technical and project documentation, coordinating with customers and multidisciplinary teams, leading or supporting FAT and SAT activities, troubleshooting system and communication issues, demonstrating application functionalities, and conducting customer training.Key ResponsibilitiesDevelop, validate, maintain, and update electrical network models and digital twins using ETAP or equivalent power system analysis platforms. Perform power system studies including Load Flow, Short-Circuit, Protection/Relay Coordination, Harmonic Analysis, Transient Stability, Motor Acceleration, Voltage Stability, Arc Flash, and related studies. Review SLDs, equipment data, protection settings, network parameters, and operating philosophies; analyze study results and prepare engineering reports with recommendations. Configure and commission real-time power system applications using live field measurements, equipment status, and operational data. Configure and validate State & Load Estimation (SLE), network topology processing, observability, bad-data handling, and online power system analysis. Map and validate analog, digital, status, command, and calculated signals from SCADA/DCS/IED/gateway systems and troubleshoot model/data mismatches. Model and analyze distribution networks and configure ADMS functions including distribution load flow, state estimation, FLISR, switching analysis, Voltage/VAR Optimization (VVO), and network reconfiguration. Support Outage Management System (OMS) configuration, network tracing, outage identification, restoration workflows, and integration with SCADA, GIS, and enterprise systems. Engineer and configure power automation and SCADA interfaces, including points/tags, alarms, events, trends, measurements, statuses, commands, and HMI functions. Configure and troubleshoot communication using protocols such as IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3, Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC UA/DA, and ICCP/TASE.2. Support integration of IEDs, RTUs, PLCs, gateways, managed switches, and control-center interfaces. Perform basic IT/OT system and network configuration, including servers/workstations, IP addressing, managed switches, VLANs, remote access, redundancy, and connectivity troubleshooting. Prepare FAT/SAT procedures and lead or participate in internal testing, FAT, integration testing, site commissioning, SAT, and functional demonstrations. Investigate technical issues, perform root-cause analysis, close test observations and punch points, and support customer acceptance. Plan and monitor project engineering activities, schedules, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and technical interfaces. Prepare and review FDS, architecture documents, signal lists, interface documents, study reports, test procedures, commissioning records, user manuals, and as-built documentation. Coordinate with project management, engineering teams, software teams, vendors, EPC contractors, consultants, and customers. Prepare and deliver customer training covering system architecture, power system applications, operational workflows, troubleshooting, and routine system operation. Support technical knowledge transfer and mentor junior engineers where required.Essential RequirementsBachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related discipline. Minimum 5–6 years of relevant experience in power system studies, real-time power system applications, ADMS/SCADA, power automation, or related project engineering. Hands-on experience in electrical network modeling and power system analysis. Working knowledge of real-time power system applications, SCADA, communication protocols, and IT/OT environments. Experience in FAT, SAT, testing, commissioning, technical documentation, and customer interaction. Industry exposure in Oil & Gas, Industrial, Utilities / Transmission & Distribution, or Power Generation; Renewable/BESS experience is an advantage. Professional written and spoken English. Willingness to travel and mobilize to project sites within the GCC, including onshore/offshore locations and extended site stays when required.Desired SkillsPower System Modeling & Digital Twin Development Load Flow, Short-Circuit & Relay Coordination Harmonic & Transient Stability Analysis Motor Acceleration & Voltage Stability Studies ETAP Power System Analysis Real-Time Power System Analysis & SLE ADMS / OMS / FLISR / VVO SCADA Configuration & Integration IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3, Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC UA/DA & ICCP/TASE.2 Industrial Communication & IT/OT Networking FAT, SAT & Site Commissioning Technical Documentation & Report Preparation Project Engineering & Coordination Troubleshooting & Root-Cause Analysis Customer Training & Technical Demonstration Leadership, Communication & Stakeholder Management Knowledge of PSS®E, DIgSILENT PowerFactory, PSCAD, CYME, ASPEN OneLiner, Hitachi Energy/ABB Network Manager, or equivalent platforms is advantageous.ETAP requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.ETAP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business.Come and join ETAP to create the transformative technology that enables our customers to engineer a better world.

title: ROV Supervisor
description:
****Job Description****
**Who we are**
Do you want to join our Geo-data revolution? Fugro’s global reach and unique know-how will put the world at your fingertips. Our love of exploration and technical expertise help us to provide our clients with invaluable insights. We source and make sense of the most relevant Geo-data for their needs, so they can design, build and operate their assets more safely, sustainably and efficiently. But we’re always looking for new talent to take the next step with us. For bright minds who enjoy meaningful work and want to push our pioneering spirit further. For individuals who can take the initiative, but work well within a team.
  
  
****Job Purpose****
Oversees remotely operated vehicle operations at the worksite, ensuring safety, efficiency and precision. Leads the offshore ROV team through planning, execution and close-out of subsea projects, drives proactive maintenance and system administration, resolves technical issues and builds collaborative relationships with the client, vessel and onshore teams to deliver seamless project execution. Is accountable for compliance with IMCA R 004 minimum shift manning and for initiating a management of change and task risk assessment whenever manning or method deviates from the approved standard Aligns daily with the party chief, project managers, survey and engineering teams and safety officers to integrate operational goals with project timelines and safety protocols.
  
  
Liaises closely with the vessel Master, particularly on DP vessels, recognising the Master's legal responsibility for overall vessel safety. Interfaces with the client representative onboard, promoting Fugro capability and flagging operational or commercial opportunities to the onshore project manager. Coordinates with technical support and procurement on spares, defects and system readiness.
  
  
****Job Description****
**Operational Oversight and Worksite Focal Point**

* Direct and supervise ROV operations to ensure adherence to project goals, work scope and safety protocols.
* Prepare for each dive with accurate knowledge of forecast weather, concurrent vessel/diving/technical operations and data acquisition requirements.
* Conduct crew pre-dive briefings covering HSE rules, risk assessment, methodology, ROV route, data protocols, contingency actions and task assignment.
* Notify the OIM, vessel Master, superintendent, party chief, diving supervisor, deck foreman and client representative before operations commence.
* Take effective control of emergency situations, managing personnel and equipment towards a satisfactory outcome.
* Provide clear, complete shift handovers and keep onshore management updated on ongoing and future developments.

**HSE Leadership**

* Organize and manage the safety of the ROV team through safety briefings, risk assessments, toolbox talks, drills, hazard and incident reporting and permit-to-work compliance.
* Drive Fugro's no-blame culture and reinforce Stop Work Authority for every crew member and third party involved.
* Verify that personnel supervised are competent for the work required and that equipment is adequate, safe, properly certified and maintained, with checks documented.
* Engage with Fugro's quarterly safety focus and ensure the crew understand the standards expected.
* Investigate and report near misses and incidents in line with the company management system.

**Team leading and mentoring**

* Manage, motivate and mentor the ROV team to optimize performance, delegating within competence while allowing development.
* Train and formally assess ROV Senior Pilot Technicians and Pilot Technicians, collecting and judging evidence fairly against agreed criteria.
* Recognize crew strengths and weaknesses, set development goals and submit accurate, detailed appraisals and end-of-trip reports.
* Maintain an open-door policy and manage conflict to mutually acceptable outcomes.
* Lead multinational crews effectively, adapting communication style across nationalities, languages, and client cultures.
* Monitor fatigue and working hours, applying the contractual shift cap and recording daily fatigue checks.

**Technical Expertise**

* Act as subject matter expert on assigned ROV technologies, providing technical guidance to internal teams and stakeholders.
* Apply in-depth knowledge of ROV mechanical, electrical and hydraulic systems to troubleshooting and maintenance direction.
* Ensure the planned maintenance system is executed on schedule, that deferrals are logged and reported, and that technical bulletins are implemented.
* Propose improvements to maintenance practice and support evaluation of emerging technologies.

**Quality assurance and compliance**

* Ensure regulatory compliance and adherence to the company integrated/business management system throughout all operations. Maintain quality standards through inspections and audits, identifying and closing out deficiencies.
* Ensure the minimum documentation set is prepared, maintained and returned daily and weekly progress reports, PMS records, dive logs with pre/post-dive checklists, communication logs, risk assessments and toolbox talks, incident reports, mob/demob reports, appraisals, requisitions and the ROV daily logbook.
* Use standardised Fugro forms only; raise gaps with QHSSE rather than creating new forms.

**Client Interface and Commercial Awareness**

* Promote Fugro capability and identify client needs that Fugro engineering expertise can meet.
* Develop a thorough understanding of the project and the duties and obligations of all parties involved.
* Advise the onshore project manager of financial or operational opportunities arising from client discussions.
* Manage the contractual recording of downtime, maintenance periods, waiting on weather and equipment or vessel failure.

**Material and Resource Management**

* Complete inventory checks to identify shortfalls and liaise with procurement.
* Raise material requisitions for approval by the ROV Project Manager / Technical Manager and follow up on status and delivery.
* Plan and manage mobilisation and demobilisation, including lifting plans, load test verification, permits and third-party coordination.

****Skills And Qualifications****

* Bachelor's in Electrical, electronic, mechanical, hydraulic, or mechatronics engineering
* 5+ years of experience with work-class ROV
* Experience in offshore
* Team-leading experience is a must
* Qualified to train and formally assess ROV Senior Pilot Technicians and Pilot Technicians

****What We Offer****
Fugro provides a positive work environment as well as projects that will satisfy the most curious minds. We also offer great opportunities to stretch and develop yourself. By giving you the freedom to grow faster, we think you’ll be able to do what you do best, better. This should help us to find fresh ways to get to know the earth better. We encourage you to be yourself at Fugro. So bring your energy and enthusiasm, your keen eye and can-do attitude. But bring your questions and opinions too. Because to be the world’s leading Geo-data specialist, we need the strength in depth that comes from a diverse, driven team.
  
  
****Our View On Diversity, Equity And Inclusion****
At Fugro, our people are our superpower. Their variety of viewpoints, experiences, knowledge and talents give us collective strength. Distinctive beliefs and diverse backgrounds are therefore welcome, but discrimination, harassment, inappropriate behavior and unfair treatment are not. Everybody is to be well-supported and treated fairly. And everyone must be valued and have their voice heard. Crucially, we believe that getting this right brings a sense of belonging, of safety and acceptance, that makes us feel more connected to Fugro’s purpose ‘together create a safe and livable world’ – and to each other.
  
  
****HSE Responsibilities****
Responsible for ensuring safety of self and others at site. Prevent damage of equipment and assets Responsible for following all safety signs/procedures/ safe working practices Responsible for using appropriate PPE’s Responsible for participating in mock drills. Entitled to refuse any to undertake any activity considered unsafe. Responsible for filling up of hazard observation card, wherever hazard has been noticed at site. Responsible for safe housekeeping of his work place. To stop any operation that is deemed unsafe To be able to operate fire extinguisher in case of fire To report an incident as soon as possible to immediate supervisor and HSE manager To complete HSE trainings as instructed to do so.
  
  
****Disclaimer For Recruitment Agencies****
**Fugro does not accept any unsolicited applications from recruitment agencies. Acquisition to Fugro Recruitment or any Fugro employee is not appreciated**
**.**

title: Assistant Plant Manager
description:
**Company Description:**
Bhavi Plast Pvt Ltd is a long-established manufacturer of corrosion-resistant equipment for process plants across India and abroad. The company designs, builds, and commissions wet scrubbing systems, dust collection systems, high-efficiency blowers, and emission control ducting under a single accountable contract. It also provides FRP and dual-laminate chemical storage tanks, reactors, pressure vessels, and process tanks engineered to international standards and tested in-house at its plant in Mankoli, Bhiwandi. Registered and vetted by major engineering consultants, Bhavi Plast’s equipment operates in plants across India and in more than ten countries. The team frequently customizes solutions based on client process data, offering sized proposals and performance curves for specialized duties.

**Role Description:**
We are looking for an Assistant Manager – Plant Operations to run the Mankoli plant day to day and take ownership of what leaves it. You will be accountable for production, quality, maintenance, inventory, dispatch, safety and manpower: delivering every order on time, to specification and within cost. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who is comfortable on the shop floor, reads drawings with confidence, and can hold a team to a standard without needing

constant direction from management.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Plan and execute daily and weekly production schedules, allocating manpower, machines and materials across multiple concurrent jobs

- Track progress against delivery commitments, flag delays early and recover schedules proactively

- Supervise fabrication and assembly as per approved drawings, specifications and codes

**Attributes we care about most:**

- Ability to work independently: doesn't need constant direction, and can be handed a problem and trusted to solve it end to end

- Strong leadership and discipline: earns respect on the shop floor and sets and holds a standard

- Decisive under pressure: takes timely decisions and facilitates productivity to comply with deadlines or priorities clash

- Proactive, not reactive: spots delays, quality risks and cost leaks before they become problems

- Clear communicator: able to coordinate with Design, Purchase, Sales and management, and explain plant constraints plainly

- Integrity and trustworthiness: handles materials, costs and people matters honestly in a closely run, family-owned business

- Hands-on and process-minded: comfortable on the floor and equally comfortable with plans, data and MIS.

**What We Oﬀer:**

Day shift: 9:15 AM to 6:30 PM

Monday to Saturday

Occasional extended hours during project deadlines

title: Senior Project Manager (Salesforce Exp Mandatory)
description:

You will be directly accountable for delivery excellence across highly visible global accounts, program-level financial performance, strategic governance, and C-suite stakeholder alignment, operating with a mature business-owner, consultative, and customer-first mindset.
  
  
This role requires advanced strategic thinking, exceptional executive presence, and a proven track record of hands-on delivery leadership to turn around complex Salesforce programs, maximise project margins, mitigate systemic risks, and scale best-in-class delivery practices across the organisation.
  
  
**What We Expect**

* AI-First Delivery & Agentic Productivity Strategy: Champion and strategically scale the adoption of authorized AI technologies and prompt engineering across your delivery teams. Actively utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation, eliminate operational friction and compress overall project delivery timelines.
* Performance Evaluation & ROI: "Collaborate with customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance for their specific use cases."
* Enterprise Delivery & P&L Governance: Plan, direct, and oversee the complete enterprise Salesforce delivery lifecycle. Own financial performance at the program level—managing macro-scope, multi-track timelines, systemic risks, and cross-project dependencies while driving high-quality business outcomes and aggressively protecting Sold vs. Delivered margins.
* Scale Agile & Delivery Leadership: Champion and institutionalize Agile delivery architectures using Scrum, Lean, and SAFe frameworks. Drive multi-track sprint execution, rigorous backlog prioritization, predictive flow metrics, and foster high-performing, self-organizing, cross-functional global delivery squads.
* Strategic Planning & Portfolio Roadmap Management: Architect and govern integrated portfolio plans and long-term delivery roadmaps. Ensure transparent, data-driven progress reporting, proactive macro-risk visibility, and complex technical dependency management across the global engagement lifecycle.
* C-Suite & Executive Stakeholder Management: Serve as trusted advisor to senior leaders. Drive alignment across global organizations through executive communication, steering committees, and proactive escalation management.
* Quality Governance & Institutional Excellence: Design and enforce delivery governance, engineering standards, and quality benchmarks. Implement quality checkpoints to ensure compliance and continuous improvement.
* Strategic Resource & Capital Optimization: Orchestrate and optimize multi-shore resource demand planning, manage complex program budgets, accurate forecasts, and financial reconciliation while engineering mitigation strategies for structural delivery risks.

:

title: Project Manager / Project Director – Regulatory Reporting
description:
**Highlight of the engagement opportunity**

* Nature of role: Full time
* Number of years of experience expected: o Project Manager: 8–12 years, including at least 5 years in regulatory reporting / RegTech delivery. o Project Director: 12–18+ years, including at least 7 years in regulatory reporting / RegTech delivery, with proven ownership of delivery, revenue, and client relationships. o Candidates without direct regulatory reporting delivery experience will not be shortlisted, regardless of general project management pedigree.

* Language requirements: Ability to write and speak fluently in English. Arabic is an added advantage for Middle East projects.
* Application experience preferable: MS Excel, MS Project, JIRA / Confluence, Visio

**Key responsibility areas:**

**A. Delivery and project leadership**

* • Play a key role in delivering complex change projects in the financial and regulatory reporting space, and/or demonstrate a track record of delivering continuous process improvements through technology and non-technology solutions.
* Independently lead and manage implementation engagements with leading banks, financial institutions, NBFCs, and insurance companies, covering automation of regulatory and risk reporting.
* Own project planning for system implementation, including detailed plans, risk identification, mitigation strategies, and stakeholder coordination.
* Explain and lead client conversations on product features, and articulate how business requirements are met.
* Lead and design the development of the solution covering data management, computations, and end-state reporting outputs.
* Take a proactive approach to process improvement and query resolution.
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of financial products and how they impact reporting requirements, and more generally the financial services business, balance sheet, and P&L.
* Focus on the total client relationship and servicing a broad range of client needs; manage end to-end delivery of solutions to existing and new clients.
* Communicate project updates to stakeholders and generate regular status reports for management highlighting progress, challenges, and key milestones.
* Drive the day-to-day execution of assigned client projects.
* Understand the client's business, key strategic essentials, industry, and market dynamics, and make/implement recommendations appropriate to the client's business needs to drive continuous improvement and generate value.
* Manage stakeholders across the project alongside day-to-day project management.

**B. Product leadership**

* Lead product and project delivery in parallel across Acies regulatory reporting products and client implementations.
* Translate regulatory requirements and client needs into product configuration, functional specifications, and delivery roadmaps.
* Ensure reporting outputs are audit-ready, with clear data lineage, controls, reconciliation, and traceability.
* Work with product, engineering, and domain teams to prioritize enhancements and reduce time-to-implementation.

**C. Practice, people, and business (Project Director emphasis)**

* Lead and be responsible for team mentoring, project management, and client delivery.
* Own project revenue, margin, and resource utilization for assigned engagements.
* Generate business from existing clients and support pre-sales, proposals, and solutioning for new clients.
* Build and scale the regulatory reporting delivery practice, including hiring, capability building, and reusable accelerators.
* Represent Acies in client leadership forums and industry discussions on regulatory reporting.

**Other important information:**

* **Work permit requirements:**
  Either Indian Citizen or having valid works in India
* **Period of engagement:**
  Full time
* **Probation period:**
  6 months
* **Compensation:**
  Compensation varies depending on the skill, fitment and role played by the person. Compensation discussions will take place post the selection process.
* **Performance incentives:**
  Typically, all roles at Acies have a performance incentive. Specific aspects will be discussed during the compensation discussion
* **Leave:**
  22 working days a year. Additional leaves for national holidays, sick leaves, maternity and paternity, bereavement and studies vary based on the city and country of engagement.
* **Other benefits:**
  Other employment benefits including medical insurance will be informed during the compensation discussion.
* **Career growth for full-time roles:**
  Acies believes in a transparent and data-based performance evaluation system. You are encouraged to clarify any questions you have with respect to career growth with Acies personnel you interact with during the selection process.
* **Career opportunities for part-time roles:**
  Conversion of part-time roles to full-time roles depends on both performance of the individual and business needs. You are encouraged to ask about the prospects as you interact with Acies personnel during the selection process.
* **Global mobility:**
  Acies encourages mobility across our offices. Such mobility is, however, subject to business needs and regulations governing immigration and employment in various countries.

**Selection process:**

We seek to be transparent during the selection process. While the actual process may vary from the process indicated below, the key steps involved are as follows:

1. Domain and delivery interview: Assessment of regulatory reporting delivery experience, regulators covered, platforms implemented, and scale of projects led.
2. Case study / problem-solving round: Regulatory reporting implementation scenario covering planning, data management, computation, reporting outputs, risks, and stakeholder management.
3. Client and leadership fit interview: Ownership, client relationship skills, team leadership, and commercial acumen.
4. Final discussion on career and compensation: Post final selection, a separate discussion will be set up to discuss compensation and career growth. The number of interview rounds may increase depending on the criticality and seniority of the role involved.

**Preparation required:**

It is recommended that you prepare on the following aspects before the selection process:

* Understanding of products and exposures in the financial services industry (Banks / NBFC / Insurance).
* Understanding of the product development and implementation lifecycle.
* Understanding of RBI, IRDAI, and SEBI reporting requirements.
* Understanding of Middle East regulatory reporting requirements (CBUAE, SAMA, CBB, QCB, CBO, CBK / CMA Kuwait).
* Familiarity with regulatory reporting platforms such as AxiomSL, OneSumX, Vermeg, SAS, OFSAA, or Moody's.
* Regulatory frameworks including Basel III/IV, IFRS 9, LCR, NSFR, ALM, capital adequacy, NPA / asset classification, and insurance reporting.

For any additional queries you may have, you can send a LinkedIn InMail to us, connect with us at https://www.acies.consulting/careers-apply.html or e-mail us at careers@acies.holdings.

**How to reach us:**

Should you wish to apply for this job, please reach out to us directly through LinkedIn or apply on our website career page - https://www.acies.consulting/careers-apply.html

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

Experience: 5+ years

Work mode- Work from office (Hybrid)

We are looking for a Technical Project Manager to run day-to-day delivery across one or more engineering pods. This is an execution-first role: you own sprint health, team coordination, stakeholder communication, and issue resolution — keeping pods moving without needing to be pulled by a Delivery Head on routine matters. You have enough of a technical background to read a sprint board intelligently, ask the right questions in a stand-up, and catch when an estimate doesn't add up. What sets you apart is the ability to communicate with clarity upward to clients and account leads, and inward to engineers and BAs, translating between both worlds without distortion.

Sprint management: Own sprint planning, daily stand-ups,sprint reviews, and retrospectives for one or more agile pods;track commitments, surface blockers early, and maintain a clean backlog with the BA and tech lead.

Delivery coordination: Coordinate work across engineers, QA,BAs, and external dependencies; manage task assignment and priority shifts within the sprint without waiting for escalation.

Stakeholder communication: Prepare and deliver clear, concise,sprint status updates for internal delivery heads and client-facing reports; translate technical progress into business-readable language and flag risks before they become issues.

Risk and issue tracking: Maintain an active risk and issue log;own the resolution path for blockers within your pod and escalate cross-pod or client-level issues with context and a proposed course of action.

Technical liaison: Work closely with tech leads to understand development dependencies, estimate accuracy, and release readiness; challenge assumptions grounded in delivery data, not just instinct.

Metrics and reporting: Track sprint velocity, bug open/close rates, release frequency, and scope change; produce concise delivery dashboards for internal and client review on a regular cadence.

Scope and change management: Identify and document scope changes as they arise; assess impact on timeline and budget before committing the pod to additional work.

Onboarding and team continuity: Support onboarding of new pod members; maintain runbooks, sprint artefacts, and process documentation so delivery continuity is not person-dependent.

Client coordination: Manage day-to-day client touchpoints clarifying requirements, confirming acceptance criteria,scheduling demos, following up on open decisions — with minimal supervision.

title: Lead Error Manager
description:
**What's the role?**
As a Lead Error Manager will own and continuously improve our end-to-end software error and defect management framework. This role combines operational leadership across multiple projects with process governance, Jira-based workflow and template ownership, reporting, and integration with external service and defect management systems. You will define the business and process requirements for workflows, fields, templates, dashboards and integrations. Platform-level configuration and changes will be assessed, approved and implemented in collaboration with the responsible IT, Jira administration, security and product teams. This is not a Jira system administrator position.
  
  

* Own and continuously improve the complete defect lifecycle, from intake, classification and prioritisation through assignment, resolution, verification and closure.
* Own the functional definition and governance of common Jira-based error management templates, including workflows, issue types, fields, screens, statuses, transition rules and reporting requirements.
* Own the business process and functional mapping between Jira and connected third-party defect, customer support and enterprise service management systems, including ServiceNow where applicable.
* Define operational KPIs, SLA requirements, dashboards and management reporting for defect flows and process health.
* Act as the central point of contact and escalation for error management process and tooling topics.
* Be accountable for the functional design, governance and continuous improvement of the common error management process and associated Jira templates used company-wide.

**Who are you?**
**Qualifications**
You are a fast learner, with an eye for detail, strong problem-solving and debugging skills. In addition you have the following qualifications:
  
  

* BS or MS in Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field
* 7 to 10 years of overall industry expereicne including 5+ year experience in software & content error management, defect management, quality management or a comparable process leadership role in a complex software & content environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing defect lifecycles across multiple products, projects or organizational teams.
* Strong practical knowledge of Jira Cloud workflows, issue types, fields, screens, permissions, dashboards and reporting from a process-owner or advanced business-administration perspective.
* Experience defining and governing common workflows and templates in collaboration with Jira administrators and IT teams.
* Experience with integrations between Jira and external defect, support or enterprise service management systems, such as ServiceNow.
* Experience defining field, status, workflow and data synchronisation mappings between systems.
* Strong understanding of defect triage, severity and priority classification, backlog management, escalation, verification and closure practices.
* Experience defining KPIs, SLAs, dashboards and management reporting for defect or operational processes.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional alignment and influence stakeholders without relying on direct line authority.
* Strong analytical, facilitation, communication and stakeholder-management skills.

**What We Offer**
HERE offers an opportunity to work in a cutting-edge technology environment with challenging problems to solve! You can make a direct impact on delivery of company´s strategic goals and the freedom to decide how to perform your work. We will support you in delivering your day-to-day tasks and achieving your personal goals and developing your skills. Personal development is highly encouraged at HERE. You can take different courses and training at our online Learning Campus and join cross-functional team projects within our Talent Platform.
  
  
HERE is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, parental status, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
**Who are we?**
HERE Technologies is a location data and technology platform company. We empower our customers to achieve better outcomes – from helping a city manage its infrastructure or a business optimize its assets to guiding drivers to their destination safely.
  
  
At HERE we take it upon ourselves to be the change we wish to see. We create solutions that fuel innovation, provide opportunity and foster inclusion to improve people’s lives. If you are inspired by an open world and driven to create positive change, join us. Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel.
