title: Supply Chain Specialist - Intellectual Property
description:
As a Supply Chain Solutions Specialist for IP Services, you will build and manage customized supply chain solutions of varying complexities, enabling client delivery across a range of IP services including filing, renewals, recordals and translation. This includes, but is not limited to onboarding and qualification, financials, risk, compliance, contracting, reporting and supplier performance management.
  
  
You will be expected to take ownership and lead assigned business areas, regions or initiative(s), ensuring their performance and/or progress meet expectations.
  
  
**About Delivery**
Did you know that more than 7,000 languages are spoken around the world? Language defines the art of communication. It is how we connect with friends and family, and how we ultimately unlock understanding. The Delivery team offers clients access to the world’s largest linguistic network, including more than 1,600 in-house translators and in excess of 29,000 freelance specialists, whose cultural and technical expertise underpin 24/7 service provision in over 80 countries.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Job Overview**

* Act as an IP supply chain specialist providing solutions to our internal teams responsible for client delivery.
* Analyze current and future needs on the assigned service or group of IP services and build and/or manage customized supply chain solutions with our existing database of IP global partners.
* Onboard new vendors, including rate negotiation, collection of local law and process information, compliance processes, and vetting
* Support agent benchmarking through market analysis, strategies and tactics in order to optimize resource cost, utilization, quality, and capacity, enabling a talent pipeline to meet current and future IP business needs.
* Work closely with other internal teams as applicable and keep all information accurate and up-to-date at all times.
* Ensure we keep good relationships with both internal stakeholders and suppliers, including regular business review meetings
* Provide support to suppliers with client-specific issues and/or processes.
* Proactively flag any risks or potential improvements to our existing workflows and processes
* Supplier performance management

**Skills & Experience**

* 3+ years of experience related to supply chain management / vendor management / project management or similar role, ideally with exposure to Intellectual Property industry.
* Ability to take ownership of complex projects and/or initiatives, manage these independently, asking for guidance/support when required.
* Great communication skills, both spoken and written, along with a positive personality.
* Process and results-oriented.
* Fluency in English, both spoken and written.
* Advanced proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint) - e.g. VLOOKUPs.
* Ability to stay organized and prioritize while engaged on multiple projects at once.
* Ability to work with data, analyse it and draw relevant conclusions / provide recommendations and reports.

If you like the idea of working with smart people who are passionate about growing the value of ideas, data and content by making sure organizations are understood , then you’ll love life at RWS.

title: Senior Engineering Manager – Technical & Projects
description:
**ETAP empowers customers to make informed decisions throughout the life cycle of their projects with innovative software solutions for electrical systems. By applying ETAP solutions, customers experience continuous intelligence during design and engineering and into operations and maintenance using a unified electrical digital twin platform. ETAP supports customers in their digital transformation and sustainable energy transitions for a green and smart future, helping them to prioritize safety, maximize reliability, and stay resilient.**
**Our employees' passion for excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction is our most-prized resource. If you share that passion — and want to be part of a company that leads the energy transition towards a cleaner and more resilient world for future generations — we invite you to join us!**
**ETAP is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
Senior Manager – Technical & Projects
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai, India
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full Time
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced electrical engineering professional to lead complex power system consulting and engineering projects for clients across the globe.
  
  
As
**Senior Manager – Technical & Projects**
, you will provide technical leadership across power system studies, electromagnetic transient analysis, and EMI/EMC studies. You will be responsible for leading project execution, reviewing technical deliverables, providing engineering recommendations, managing client relationships, and ensuring projects are delivered to a high standard, on time and within budgeted effort.
  
  
The role requires strong expertise in power system analysis, hands-on experience with engineering simulation software such as
**ETAP, PSCAD, CDEGS, or equivalent tools**
, and the ability to translate complex technical analysis into practical recommendations for clients.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Technical Leadership & Engineering
  
  

* Lead and execute complex engineering studies across one or more of the following areas:

+ Power System Studies: Load flow, short circuit, motor starting, transient stability, relay coordination, arc flash, harmonic analysis, and renewable energy systems including solar, wind, and battery energy storage.
+ Electromagnetic Transient Studies: Insulation coordination, lightning surge analysis, GIS switching studies, and related switching transient analysis.
+ EMI/EMC Studies: Electromagnetic interference and compatibility assessments for complex electrical environments, including oil & gas facilities, railways, and other industrial applications.

* Utilize engineering simulation tools such as ETAP, PSCAD, CDEGS, or equivalent software to perform detailed analysis and develop technically sound solutions.
* Review electrical power systems, distribution networks, industrial control systems, and renewable energy installations for technical integrity and compliance with applicable IEC, IEEE, and client standards.
* Develop engineering recommendations for system design, operation, protection, optimization, and troubleshooting based on study results.
* Provide technical leadership in the investigation and resolution of electrical system issues, including system trips, equipment failures, and site incidents.
* Review technical reports, calculations, models, and other engineering deliverables to ensure quality, accuracy, and consistency.

Project & Client Management
  
  

* Own project execution from scope definition through completion, ensuring deliverables meet agreed scope, schedule, quality, and budget/man-hour requirements.
* Plan and manage project resources, priorities, risks, and technical deliverables.
* Monitor project progress and proactively address technical, schedule, or resource-related issues.
* Serve as a senior technical point of contact for clients and respond to technical queries with clear, accurate, and timely guidance.
* Present technical findings and recommendations to clients through reports, presentations, workshops, and technical meetings.
* Support business development activities, including technical discussions, proposals, estimates, and client presentations as required.

Team Leadership & Development
  
  

* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers and project team members.
* Review and support the development of engineering methodologies, tools, templates, and best practices.
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, knowledge sharing, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Support capability development and knowledge transfer across the engineering team.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Significant professional experience in power system studies and electrical engineering consulting, preferably within industrial, utility, oil & gas, renewable energy, rail, or similar environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with ETAP and/or PSCAD; experience with CDEGS or equivalent engineering software is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of electrical power systems, protection, system studies, and applicable IEC/IEEE standards.
* Demonstrated experience leading technically complex projects and managing project scope, schedules, and deliverables.
* Experience interacting directly with international clients and presenting technical findings and recommendations.
* Prior experience providing technical leadership or mentoring engineers.

**Desired Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate complex electrical system issues.
* Excellent technical report writing and presentation skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Effective project planning and organizational skills.
* Proactive approach to project and client management.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining quality and deadlines.
* Strong proficiency in MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively within a global, multidisciplinary team.
* Willingness to travel internationally, as required for client meetings, workshops, and site assignments.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* High-quality engineering studies and deliverables delivered on time and within planned project effort.
* Strong technical credibility with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Effective resolution of complex power system and electrical engineering challenges.
* Successful development and mentoring of engineering talent.
* Consistent application of engineering standards, methodologies, and best practices.
* Strong contribution to client satisfaction, repeat business, and growth of the technical consulting practice.

**ETAP requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.**
**ETAP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business.**
**Come and join ETAP to create the transformative technology that enables our customers to engineer a better world.**

title: Associate-Carbon & Net Zero
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking an ambitious and collaborative Associate to lead the Carbon and Net Zero discipline within the Decarbonisation and Resilience team in Sustainability Advisory GCC. The role will combine technical leadership, project delivery, people leadership and business growth. It will support UK-led work while building stronger connections with other WSP business units and geographies.
  
  
The successful candidate will be accountable for developing a high-performing and sustainable Carbon and Net Zero team. This includes maintaining their own project utilisation, planning team workload and utilisation, supporting recruitment, building skills and capacity, assuring technical quality, and creating a healthy pipeline of work.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Discipline and Team Leadership**

* Lead the Carbon and Net Zero discipline within the Sustainability Advisory GCC, setting clear priorities for delivery, capability and growth.
* Maintain strong personal contribution to chargeable project delivery, while actively managing team workload, resource planning and forward pipeline to improve and sustain team utilisation.
* Identify recruitment needs, support hiring and onboarding, and build a balanced team structure aligned with the forward pipeline.
* Mentor and upskill existing team members and new joiners by providing structured guidance, knowledge sharing and exposure to relevant project work.
* Assess capability and training needs, provide coaching and technical guidance, and create opportunities for team members to broaden their experience.
* Foster an inclusive, collaborative and accountable team culture with a strong focus on quality, wellbeing and continuous improvement.

**Technical Leadership and Quality Delivery**

* Act as the technical champion for Carbon and Net Zero within Sustainability Advisory GCC, providing technical direction, quality assurance and best-practice guidance across projects, proposals and client deliverables, with deep expertise in several of the following areas: organisational and project GHG accounting; net zero and decarbonisation strategy; whole-life carbon assessment; carbon management; carbon assurance; climate policy; and carbon inputs to environmental assessments.
* Lead multidisciplinary project delivery, ensuring robust methodologies, clear governance, effective resource planning and high-quality outputs.
* Prepare, review and quality-assure technical reports, carbon models, strategies, proposals and other client deliverables.
* Apply relevant standards, guidance and protocols, including the GHG Protocol, ISO 14064, PAS 2080 and appropriate UK and international carbon-assessment requirements.
* Promote consistent tools, templates, quality controls and lessons learnt across the discipline.

Project, Client and Commercial Management
  
  

* Lead projects and workstreams from scoping through delivery, managing programme, budget, risks, dependencies and stakeholder expectations.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with project directors, clients, technical specialists and delivery teams through clear communication, sound judgement and a solutions-focused approach.
* Manage commercial allocation for the GCC-based team, support fee development and monitor project performance.
* Apply commercial awareness and, where relevant, cost-benefit analysis to develop practical recommendations and support client decision-making.
* Support resolution of delivery challenges and provide timely escalation where project quality, programme or commercial outcomes may be at risk.

**Growth and Collaboration**

* Develop the pipeline for Carbon and Net Zero services within Sustainability Advisory UK and across other WSP business units and geographies.
* Build relationships with UK and global discipline leads to understand demand, position GCC capability and secure sustainable work for the team.
* Identify opportunities and lead or support bids, proposals, capability presentations and client discussions.
* Help shape and broaden the team's service offering in response to market needs, changing standards and client priorities.
* Collaborate across disciplines to create integrated propositions with climate resilience, sustainability certification, environmental assessment, infrastructure, buildings, energy and other relevant teams.

**Qualifications**

* Typically 10+ years of relevant experience in carbon management, net zero, climate change, decarbonisation, sustainability or a related field.
* A relevant bachelor's or master's degree in sustainability, environmental science, engineering, energy, climate change or a related discipline.
* Demonstrable experience of leading carbon and net zero projects, technical workstreams and multidisciplinary teams in a consultancy or comparable professional environment.
* Strong technical knowledge in GHG accounting and carbon management, with experience in areas such as net zero strategy, whole-life carbon, PAS 2080, ISO 14064, carbon assurance, decarbonisation pathways or GHG assessment for environmental studies.
* Experience of technical review and quality assurance, including the ability to challenge assumptions, review complex calculations and communicate findings clearly.
* Demonstrable project and commercial management capability, including scoping, budgeting, resource planning, risk management and stakeholder engagement.
* Experience of people leadership, capability development, recruitment or workload and utilisation management.
* Demonstrable contribution to business development, successful bids, proposals or the growth of client accounts and service offerings.
* Good knowledge of relevant UK and international legislation, standards, assessment methodologies and market developments.
* Strong analytical, research, technical writing, presentation and communication skills.
* Proven ability to work collaboratively across disciplines, cultures and geographies, with international project experience highly desirable.
* Professional membership and chartered status, or active progress towards chartership, are desirable.

description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
This senior role is a strategic engineering leader within the BTFE team, responsible for architecting, building, and overseeing scalable, secure, and maintainable digital products and services. The individual will lead delivery across the predominantly .NET-based BTFE technology ecosystem, while governing mobile application delivery through vendor partners and strengthening the team’s future cross-platform engineering capabilities.
  
  
With advanced expertise across multiple technologies, they will guide full lifecycle development—from technical planning and design to implementation, deployment, and ongoing optimization. They will mentor developers, lead design discussions, manage technical risks and debt, and collaborate cross-functionally to align solutions with business objectives. The role also includes ownership of production stability, vendor engineering quality, troubleshooting, performance tuning, security, and sustained technical excellence across web, API, backend, and mobile-integrated platforms.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Delivery Leadership & Execution**

* Leading delivery of complex BTFE products, platforms, and modules across internal teams and vendor partners with end-to-end accountability for scope, quality, release readiness, and delivery outcomes
* Owning production support strategy across BTFE platforms, including incident management, root cause analysis, problem management, service reliability, and continuous improvement for critical issues
* Driving stakeholder alignment through active participation in product discovery, requirement gathering, scope definition, technical planning, dependency management, and release planning
* Providing high-confidence estimates for large-scale efforts, advising on resourcing and partner capacity, and establishing delivery plans that balance near-term outcomes with long-term technical health

**Learning, Development & Mentoring**

* Championing a culture of continuous learning, introducing relevant emerging technologies, cross-platform frameworks, engineering practices, and AI-enabled ways of working
* Providing deep mentorship and technical guidance to mid- and junior-level engineers, while building capability across .NET, web/API, cloud, integration, and mobile engineering fundamentals
* Leading internal initiatives such as architecture reviews, engineering talks, vendor knowledge exchanges, and capability development programs
* Demonstrating strong leadership presence, strengthening team culture and practices, and creating an environment where people can do their best work and grow

**Technical Consulting & Strategy**

* Creating and validating high-level estimations, technology roadmaps, modernization plans, and investment cases for large, cross-functional BTFE efforts
* Designing and owning complex, scalable, secure, and resilient end-to-end solutions across .NET, APIs, cloud services, data stores, third-party integrations, and mobile experiences
* Serving as an advisor across BTFE product, business, operations, security, architecture, and vendor communities, aligning solutions with strategic goals and user needs.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Independently defines and manages work plans for complex projects, driving alignment across teams and contributing to strategic project planning
* Has led multiple medium-to-large projects or delivered key enterprise-level components with full accountability for scope, quality, delivery outcomes, and production readiness
* Shapes and enforces IT technical standards, driving adoption of best practices and fostering engineering excellence across teams, vendors, and initiatives
* Possesses expert-level knowledge of enterprise architecture, system design patterns, distributed systems, and technical toolsets, applying them to architect resilient, scalable solutions
* Advanced experience with .NET Core, C#, ASP.NET Core/Web API, API integration, relational and NoSQL databases, cloud platforms, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and production support
* Credible cross-platform development experience with exposure to mobile application engineering, including mobile architecture, API integration, security, performance, telemetry, release lifecycle, and app-store delivery; hands-on experience with React Native, Flutter, Xamarin, .NET MAUI, or equivalent is expected.

**Preferred Qualifications**
Demonstrates the General Mills leadership behaviors required for success: energizes and inspires others; grows by deepening and sharing expertise; challenges with strategic courage; delivers impactful results across teams; and connects and aligns cross-functional efforts
  
  

* Experience with .NET MAUI, React Native, Flutter, Xamarin, or comparable cross-platform frameworks, with working knowledge of native iOS and/or Android engineering ecosystems
* Energizes and inspires others
* Grows by deepening and sharing expertise
* Challenges with strategic courage
* Delivers impactful results across teams
* Connects and aligns cross-functional efforts

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

* Excellent project management, organisation, and problem-solving abilities.

* A relationship-driven professional who understands client expectations and business priorities.
* Someone who can take ownership of accounts from briefing to final execution.

* A proactive problem-solver who can coordinate across teams and ensure timely, high-quality delivery.

* Enhance Data Quality & Efficiency: Drive automation initiatives that improve data quality diagnostics, reducing manual intervention and increasing operational efficiency
* Collaborate for Impact: Work closely with internal stakeholders and downstream teams to understand data needs, define quality control frameworks, and ensure seamless data delivery.
* Engage with Companies & Clients: Review and process company feedback, address client queries, and contribute to a transparent, data-driven ecosystem that powers critical decision-making.

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Environmental Science, Data Science, or related interdisciplinary fields.

* Experience of leading the projects to completion and working with stakeholders and team members
* Experience applying GenAI/LLMs for data extraction, summarization, classification, or workflow automation; ability to build prompt‑based workflows and evaluate model output.
* Familiarity with AI agents, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), or ML‑assisted quality is required.
* Hands‑on experience with Python for automation, web scraping, API integration, data cleaning, and high‑volume processing.
* Working knowledge of SQL and comfort handling large datasets.
* Strong analytical mindset with ability to interpret complex corporate disclosures and extract meaningful supply‑chain insights.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to work effectively with global teams across multiple time zones and collaborate with cross‑functional partners

title: Strategy Leader
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
As a Strategy Leader within Grid Technologies and a key member of the Strategy & Sustainability team, you will shape the direction of one of the world’s most critical energy businesses. You will drive high-impact strategic projects across our global GT portfolio, working closely with business leaders and operational units to translate business needs into actionable initiatives.
  
  
Your day is a mix of solving complex problems, working with cross-functional teams, engaging senior stakeholders, and challenging how we operate today to build what the grid needs tomorrow. You will bring analytical rigor, energy-sector insight, and strategic creativity to define solutions and push our business forward. This role offers an exceptional springboard for a global career within Siemens Energy after +2 years in the Strategy team.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Lead high-value strategic initiatives that directly shape the future of Siemens Energy and the global Energy Transition.
* Identify growth opportunities, portfolio moves, and business-critical themes, translating them into executable plans with business leaders.
* Drive preparation for Executive Board decisions through management reviews, strategy updates, and external presentations.
* Support special strategic initiatives and one-off projects requiring fast problem solving and senior stakeholder engagement.
* Engage with cross-functional teams and lead workstreams within complex projects, building a strong internal network across Grid Technologies and the wider Siemens Energy organization.
* Analyze complex problems and develop creative, actionable solutions together with highly skilled colleagues.
* Leverage deep energy industry knowledge to challenge the status quo and spark new ideas, business models, and innovations.
* Develop continuously through on-the-job learning, coaching from senior colleagues, and dedicated trainings and job-shadowing programs.

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in Strategy, with a strong track record in strategic initiatives, market analysis, and end-to-end project management.
* At least 2 years experience in the Energy sector, ideally within Grid Technologies or adjacent segments, with strong understanding of industry dynamics and current trends.
* Ability to work effectively across functions and organizational layers, mobilizing resources and driving alignment in complex environments.
* Strong analytical and structured thinking skills, with the ability to break down complex problems and build compelling, data-driven recommendations.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* High-performance orientation—you consistently meet or exceed objectives and thrive under tight deadlines.
* Solution-driven mindset with a willingness to “go the extra mile” and deliver results with ownership and autonomy.
* A collaborative team spirit, enjoying the opportunity to work with highly motivated colleagues and possessing strong interpersonal and leadership skills.

**About The Team**
Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.
  
  
**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
  
  
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
  
  
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity**
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
  
  
**Rewards/Benefits**

* Opportunity to work on challenging projects in an exciting environment
* Opportunity for remote/flexible work
* Professional support and strong collaboration with colleagues around the world
* Professional development opportunities within the company

title: Design Manager - Water/Wastewater Treatment
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
As a Design Manager – Treatment, you will lead the multidisciplinary design delivery of complex water treatment, wastewater treatment, and desalination projects. You will be responsible for driving design integration, technical excellence, programme certainty, and quality compliance across all stages of project delivery. This includes overseeing process, civil, mechanical, chemical, electrical, and I&C interfaces, ensuring alignment across all design disciplines.
  
  
You will work closely with Project Managers, Discipline Leads, and Sector/Regional leadership to plan, coordinate, and assure the technical execution of treatment projects while also mentoring and strengthening the capability of the broader design team.
  
  
Key duties include
  
  

* Development and implementation of multidisciplinary design strategies for water/wastewater treatment and desalination projects, ensuring design integration and coherent execution.
* Lead and manage the preparation, coordination, and delivery of design packages for water treatment plants, wastewater treatment plants, desalination facilities, and associated process systems.
* Evaluate, compare, and select appropriate treatment technologies and processes for project-specific needs.
* Provide leadership in Design for Design‑Build (D for DB) models—ensuring constructability, staging, risk mitigation, and alignment with contractor expectations.
* Lead or support HAZOP/HAZID studies, interpret findings, and implement appropriate mitigation measures across treatment process designs.
* Own and manage core design management documents Project Responsibility Matrix, Project Organisation Chart, Design Programme, Basis of Design, and Schedule of Deliverables.
* Identify and manage inputs from external specialists, JV partners, and sub‑consultants, ensuring their deliverables are fully integrated.
* Lead client engagement activities, including workshops, presentations, design reviews, and technical discussions.
* Facilitate multidisciplinary coordination meetings and proactively manage resolution of design issues to maintain schedule and quality commitments.
* Ensure all design outputs comply with quality standards, codes, legislation, and HSE principles, promoting safe design practices.

**We welcome applications from qualified professionals currently based overseas who are open to relocating to India. Relocation support may be provided for exceptional candidates having extensive experience in
**delivering Design Build water infrastructure projects**
.**
Here's what you'll need
  
  
**Key software tools**

* Planning & Coordination Primavera P6 / MS Project
* Collaboration ACC, ProjectWise, SharePoint, MS Teams
* GIS ArcGIS Pro / QGIS
* Treatment Modelling (exposure advantageous) RO/ion balance tools, process simulators
* BIM (exposure advantageous) Revit, Civil 3D, Navisworks, Revizto

**Key Behaviours**

* Builds positive, collaborative relationships across diverse teams.
* Strong client‑facing presence; personable, approachable, and confident.
* Leads through coordination, communication, and engagement.
* Drives integrated, high‑quality design solutions across disciplines.
* Organised, proactive, and able to resolve complex issues promptly.
* Creative, flexible, dependable; champions safety and quality culture.

**Work Experience**

* 20+ years of experience in design management within an engineering consultancy or EPC/Design‑Build environment.
* Proven experience managing multidisciplinary design teams delivering complex treatment facilities.
* Demonstrated capability in delivering Water Treatment/ Wastewater Treatment/ Desalination across preliminary, detailed, and construction design stages.
* Strong understanding of PFDs, mass balance development, hydraulic profiles, P&IDs, and preparation of process input documents.
* Strong experience in Design for Design‑Build (D for DB), including early contractor engagement, constructability review, and technical risk mitigation.
* Experience leading design delivery in BIM‑enabled environments.
* Demonstrated interest in digital delivery and innovation, including automation, data‑driven workflows, and continuous improvement.
* Strong communication, coordination, leadership, and organisational skills.
* Experience in client presentations, tender submissions, and stakeholder management.
* Experience in change management, including assessment of design changes, impact analysis, and stakeholder communication.
* Working understanding of MTO/BoQ development and coordination with discipline teams for quantity validation.
* Ability to develop Level‑of‑Effort (LOE) estimates and support bids, proposals, and design execution plans.
* Understanding of project financials, including forecasting, progress tracking, milestone monitoring, and invoicing.
* Experience with alternate delivery methods such as Design–Build, EPC, CMAR, or PPP/P3 is an asset.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Civil, Chemical, Environmental Engineering (or related discipline)
* Master’s degree in relevant field
* Professional Engineer (PE) / Chartered Engineer (CEng) is highly desirable

**Preferred Attributes**

* Experience delivering large multidisciplinary treatment programmes (water, wastewater, or desalination).
* Exposure to complex staging, commissioning planning, or brownfield facility expansions.
* Experience or understanding of PFAS treatment technologies (e.g., GAC, IX, RO) is an added advantage.
* Awareness of sustainability, circularity, and low‑carbon treatment solutions.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast‑paced, contractor‑integrated environments.

**Hybrid Work Expectation**
Average office presence of 3 days per week or as per Company Policy, with travel for client/site meetings and occasional team meetings.
  
  
At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Project Manager
description:
**About Paramverse Bio**

Paramverse Bio Pvt. Ltd. is building India's next great bio company, with a focus on biological agriculture. Founded in 2024 and part of Paramverse Group, it develops and sells indigenous microbial formulations under the DHARITRI SUTRA™ brand. The portfolio spans 21 registered products across three lines: RAKSHAK (bio-protection), POSHAK (bio-nutrition), and AMRITAM (export-grade compliance).

Every product is delivered through the "Doctor of Soil" model: a certified agronomist, a personalised prescription, and data to show whether it worked. Paramverse Bio is live across nine Indian states in Phase 1 (FY27), with 48 territories, institutional-grade manufacturing, and field-to-export traceability.

**What You Will Own**

**Business programme management.**
Translate Paramverse Bio’s business priorities into structured programmes, workplans, milestones, owners, and measurable outcomes. Help ensure that strategic initiatives move from planning to disciplined execution.

**On-ground programme execution.**
Work closely with sales, agronomy, operations, marketing, and territory teams to drive programme implementation across markets. Track field activities, adoption, dependencies, and delivery against agreed plans.

**MIS and performance analytics.**
Build and maintain clear management information systems, dashboards, trackers, and review reports. Turn operational data into actionable insights on progress, gaps, delays, productivity, and business performance.

**Accountability and review cadence.**
Set up regular programme reviews with clear action points, owners, due dates, and escalation mechanisms. Follow through with stakeholders and help ensure that commitments are completed on time.

**Planning and coordination.**
Develop integrated programme calendars, coordinate cross-functional tasks, monitor interdependencies, and keep teams aligned on priorities, deliverables, and deadlines.

**Problem solving and escalation.**
Identify execution bottlenecks early, investigate root causes, and work with relevant teams to resolve issues. Escalate material risks with facts, options, and recommended actions.

**Strategic and commercial support.**
Support leadership initiatives across strategy, finance, marketing, and programme management through structured analysis, business reviews, research, presentations, and decision-support materials.

**Process discipline and documentation.**
Maintain programme documentation, standard templates, review notes, action logs, and operating dashboards. Help build repeatable ways of working as Paramverse Bio expands across territories.

**Leadership support.**
Provide concise and reliable updates to business leadership, highlighting what is on track, what requires intervention, and where decisions or cross-functional support are needed.

**What We Are Looking For**

**Experience.**
0–2 years of experience. High-potential fresh graduates and early-career professionals with strong analytical and execution skills are encouraged to apply.

**Academic background.**
MBA/PGDM or equivalent management education, ideally from an IIM or another leading management institute, with a focus on strategy, finance, marketing, operations, or programme management.

**Structured problem solving.**
Able to break ambiguous business objectives into workstreams, milestones, measurable outputs, and clear next steps.

**Analytical and MIS skills.**
Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with the ability to build structured trackers, analyse data, and communicate findings clearly. Familiarity with dashboards or BI tools is an advantage.

**Ownership and follow-through.**
Highly organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable following up with multiple stakeholders to drive closure rather than only reporting status.

**Communication and stakeholder management.**
Able to communicate confidently with leadership and field teams, prepare crisp updates, and coordinate across functions without losing sight of business priorities.

**Execution mindset.**
Comfortable with a hands-on role that combines analysis, coordination, field exposure, and operational problem solving in a growing business.

**Nice to Have**

Internship or project experience in management consulting, a PMO, business operations, strategy, or a founder-led/growth-stage organisation.

Exposure to agriculture, agri-inputs, biologicals, agritech, FMCG, or other businesses with distributed field teams.

Experience creating management dashboards, project trackers, operating reviews, or performance scorecards.

Comfort with data visualisation or BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau.

title: Artwork PMO
description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
  
  
Your Role
  
  
The Artwork Planning Lead is a leadership role responsible for overseeing and coordinating multiple packaging artwork projects, from design through to print production, for a leading Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) client. With over 10 years of experience and a strong background in project management, this individual will lead cross-functional meetings to align priorities, allocate resources effectively, and enhance artwork management efficiency.
  
  
This role requires the ability to build strong relationships with cross-functional teams, including R&D, Sourcing, Supply, Design, and Operations, to ensure the successful delivery of new products to market. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in managing artwork development and the production process within a CPG company or a related industry.
  
  
In this role you will play a key role in:
  
  

* Lead and oversee the multiple packaging artwork projects from design through to print package.
* Act as the primary liaison between internal teams (marketing, design, R&D, regulatory, supply chain) and external stakeholders (agencies, printers, suppliers).
* Sets agenda, and clearly defines cross-functional responsibilities from project start to completion.
* Facilitate regular communication to ensure alignment on project objectives and deliverables.
* Maintain up-to-date records of project progress using project management tools and spreadsheets. This includes tracking milestones, deliverables, and any deviations from the original plan.
* Identify risks, bottlenecks, or delays in the artwork development process and implement solutions to mitigate them.
* Compile regular artwork project reports that highlight progress, challenges, and solutions. Communicate these findings to seniors and cross-functional teams to keep everyone informed and engaged.
* Manage feedback loops, consolidating inputs to minimize iterations and maintain efficiency.
* Act as a mentor/coach for associate artwork planning leads and planning coordinators.

YOUR PROFILE
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, , project management, or a related field.
* Proven experience in managing end-to-end process of artwork, printing and digital assets creation in a Consumer-Packaged Goods (CPG) environment
* 10+ years of experience in artwork management, packaging, or project management within a CPG or FMCG environment.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment across multiple functions (marketing, R&D, sourcing, design external agencies and operations)
* Proficiency with project management tools such as Asana, Trello, Monday.com, or Jira is crucial for tracking tasks, deadlines, and progress.
* Familiarity in artwork and design software is beneficial; while direct design involvement is not required, a basic understanding of platforms like Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) can enhance communication with creative teams.
* Possess strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
* Highly collaborative, with strong experience working with Global & Local stakeholders
* Possess functional knowledge of marketing, branding and new product development
* Excellent interpersonal, written & verbal communication skills

**What You'll Love About Working Here**
Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.
  
  
Make it real | www.capgemini.com

title: Team Lead – Implementation
description:
**About Clari5**
Clari5, a product of CustomerXPs (now part of the Perfios group), is a category-leading real-time Enterprise Financial Crime Management platform trusted by banks across 15+ countries. The platform processes 12 billion+ transactions and secures over 200 million accounts, helping financial institutions combat fraud, manage AML compliance, and drive revenue — all in real time. Clari5 is consistently recognised in Chartis RiskTech Quadrants and has won multiple global awards for fraud detection innovation.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Team Lead – Implementation is a high-impact delivery role within Clari5’s Global Professional Services team. You will lead end-to-end implementation engagements of the Clari5 platform at banking and financial institution clients, owning project delivery from kick-off to go-live. You will manage a small squad of functional and technical consultants, serve as the primary client interface during implementation, and ensure every deployment meets Clari5’s quality, timeline, and customer-satisfaction benchmarks.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of banking domain expertise, product knowledge, and project leadership — ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, client-facing environment and wants to shape how one of the world’s most advanced fraud management platforms goes live at marquee banks.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Implementation Delivery

+ Own end-to-end delivery of Clari5 implementations from project initiation to go-live and hypercare, ensuring adherence to scope, timelines, and quality benchmarks.
+ Create and maintain detailed project plans, milestone trackers, risk logs, and status dashboards for each engagement.
+ Drive sub-90-day go-live timelines by leveraging Clari5’s pre-built integration adapters and accelerators.
+ Manage parallel implementation streams (EFM, AML, Case Management) across banking channels and core banking integrations.
+ Coordinate UAT cycles, defect triage, and sign-off activities with client teams.
+ Client Engagement & Stakeholder Management

+ Act as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders (CTO, CIO, Risk Heads, IT teams) throughout the implementation lifecycle.
+ Conduct requirement-gathering workshops, present solution design documents, and validate functional configurations against client needs.
+ Manage client expectations proactively; communicate changes in scope, risk, and mitigation plans transparently.
+ Build lasting relationships that support successful post-go-live adoption and open doors for further engagement.
+ Team Leadership

+ Lead, mentor, and guide a team of 3–5 functional/technical consultants across implementation engagements.
+ Assign work, track deliverables, and conduct performance reviews for team members.
+ Foster a collaborative culture of continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and delivery excellence.
+ Onboard and ramp new team members on Clari5 product, banking domain, and delivery methodology.
+ Technical & Functional Oversight

+ Review and sign off on Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Solution Design Documents (SDDs), Interface Requirement Documents (IRDs), and test plans.
+ Oversee and validate configurations of fraud rules, AML scenarios, case workflows, and reporting dashboards.
+ Liaise with the Clari5 product engineering and DevOps teams on environment setups, deployments, patches, and escalations.
+ Ensure integrations with core banking systems (Finacle, Flexcube, Temenos, etc.), payment switches, and ancillary systems are correctly designed and executed.
+ Process & Quality

+ Enforce Clari5’s implementation methodology, quality gates, and project governance standards across all engagements.
+ Contribute to the development and improvement of delivery playbooks, templates, and best-practice documentation.
+ Conduct post-go-live reviews and capture lessons learned to continuously improve delivery quality.
+ Identify and escalate risks and issues in a timely manner with clear mitigation plans.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Must Have


+ 7–10 years of experience in banking technology delivery, with at least 3 years in a team lead or project lead capacity.
+ Hands-on experience implementing banking software products (fraud management, core banking, AML, payments, or similar enterprise banking solutions).
+ Strong working knowledge of banking channels and operations: Core Banking, Payments (RTGS/NEFT/UPI/SWIFT), Cards, Mobile/Internet Banking.
+ Experience preparing and reviewing BRDs, SDDs, IRDs, test plans, and go-live checklists.
+ Proficiency in project management methodologies (Agile/Scrum or Waterfall) and tools (Jira, MS Project, Confluence, or equivalent).
+ Unix Shell script/ Python/ Database(RDBMS, Oracle/MYSQL/MSSQL)/ Java Debugging etc
+ Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
+ Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and engagements.
+ Willingness to travel to client sites domestically and internationally.

* Good to Have


+ Prior experience implementing Fraud / AML platforms.
+ Exposure to integration middleware and API-based integrations (REST/SOAP) in a banking context.
+ Understanding of regulatory frameworks: RBI guidelines, FATF AML, PMLA, IRDAI, or regional equivalents.
+ PMP, Prince2, or equivalent project management certification.
+ Experience with BI/reporting tools and SQL for data validation during implementations.
+ Knowledge of real-time decisioning architectures, rule engines, and in-memory computing concepts.

Core Competencies
  
  
**Leadership & Delivery**

* Project & program management
* Team supervision & mentoring
* Risk & issue management
* Stakeholder communication

**Domain & Technical**

* Banking products & channels
* Fraud / AML platform configuration
* Core banking integrations
* SQL, APIs, test management tools

What We Offer
  
  

* Work on world-class fraud management technology deployed at Tier 1 banks across Asia, Middle East, and Africa.
* Exposure to complex, large-scale enterprise implementations — including the world’s largest real-time fraud management deployment.
* A dynamic, high-ownership environment where your impact is visible and your contributions are recognised.
* Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.
* Opportunities for global travel and cross-geography client engagement.
* A collaborative team of banking technology veterans committed to delivery excellence.
* Access to Clari5’s continuous learning resources, product certifications, and industry events.

* Project Leadership: Lead and manage the full lifecycle of rack-level system deployment projects, ensuring timely and successful delivery.
* Project Planning & SOW: Define project scopes, draft Statements of Work (SOW), and calculate necessary resources and timelines based on specific customer requirements.

* Field Site Execution: Demonstrated expert-level capability in performing comprehensive on-site deployment tasks, including:
* Rack movement observation and management: Ensuring safe and precise physical relocation of server racks within the data center floor.
* Hardware remediation support: Proactive identification and resolution of hardware-level failures during deployment.
* Unpacking systems and rack stacking: Executing physical installation, rack-mount operations, and server integration.

title: Assurance Operations Project Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Project Manager PMP**
At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. You can design a career you’ll love from top to bottom — we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals.
  
  
The Project Manager (PMP) will lead high-impact strategic initiatives across the Assurance practice and broader firm, partnering with executive leadership to drive transformation, operational excellence, technology adoption, and business growth. This role is responsible for developing and executing program roadmaps, aligning cross-functional stakeholders, managing risks and dependencies, facilitating executive decision-making, and ensuring projects deliver intended business value. The successful candidate will possess strong project and program management capabilities, executive presence, exceptional communication skills, and a proven ability to lead through influence in complex, fast-paced environments. They will demonstrate a proactive leadership mindset, the ability to anticipate risks and opportunities, influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization, and independently drive complex initiatives from concept through execution while ensuring alignment with firm priorities and business objectives.
  
  
PMP certification and experience managing enterprise-wide transformation initiatives are highly desirable.
  
  
**Preferred Competencies**

* Experience leading enterprise transformation, technology implementation, or operating model change initiatives.
* Strong business acumen and ability to understand organizational priorities beyond project deliverables.
* Experience preparing executive-level reporting, steering committee materials, and leadership presentations.
* Ability to balance tactical execution with strategic planning.
* Proven track record of influencing without authority across multiple functions and leadership levels.

**What It Means To Work For EisnerAmper**

* You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry.
* You will join a culture that has received multiple top “Places to Work” awards.
* We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas, and experiences come together to create new solutions.
* We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation.
* Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and as a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work.
* Numerous Employee Resource Groups support our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion efforts.

**What Work You Will Be Responsible For**

* Plan, coordinate, and monitor multiple projects from initiation to completion.
* Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, trackers, and status reports.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure timely completion of project deliverables.
* Identify project risks, issues, and dependencies, and proactively recommend mitigation plans.
* Prepare and deliver executive-level communications, steering committee materials, and decision-support analyses.
* Facilitate discussions with executive stakeholders to resolve issues, align priorities, and drive organizational decisions.
* Support process improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities for greater efficiency.
* Analyze project data and generate meaningful insights to support decision-making.
* Ensure adherence to organizational project management standards and governance.
* Drive stakeholder engagement and change management activities to ensure successful adoption of strategic initiatives.
* Manage interdependencies across multiple projects and workstreams to ensure achievement of program objectives.
* Assess financial, operational, and organizational impacts of proposed initiatives.
* Develop business cases and ROI analyses to support executive decision-making.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Management, or a related field.
* 7-10 years of experience in Project Management, PMO, Data Analytics, or a similar role.
* Experience leading enterprise transformation initiatives
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, especially: Microsoft Excel (advanced functions, Pivot Tables, dashboards)
* Working knowledge of Data Analytics and reporting tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical, leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and documentation skills.
* PMP (Project Management Professional) Certification or equivalent project management certification.

**About Our Assurance Team**
In the EisnerAmper Assurance Group, we’re transforming the traditional reputation of auditing. By operating on the core tenets of profound trust, professional integrity, and consistent results, we strive to create lasting partnerships with our clients based on solutions rather than simply identifying issues in their financial statements.
  
  
To stay up to date with evolving industry processes and regulations, we place a heavy emphasis on continued education and the consistent adoption of new technologies. This enables us to effectively innovate, grow as individuals, and provide faster, more accurate solutions and due diligence for our partners.
  
  
Acting as a trusted third party to our clients, we provide solutions that create assurance and peace of mind. Because we understand trust comes with time, we define success by the relationships we create and foster. We act as a trusted business advisor every step of the way, from a client’s first financial report to their close of business.
  
  
**About EisnerAmper**
EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax, and business advisory firms, with approximately 450 partners and 5000 employees across the world. We combine responsiveness with a long-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today and position them for success tomorrow.
  
  
Our clients represent enterprises of every form, ranging from sophisticated financial institutions to startups, global public firms to middle-market companies, governmental entities as well as high-net-worth individuals, family offices, nonprofit organizations and entrepreneurial ventures across a variety of industries. We are also engaged by the attorneys, financial professionals, bankers, investors, and key stakeholders who serve these clients.
  
  
**About EisnerAmper India**
EisnerAmper (India) Consultants Pvt. Ltd. (“EA India”) is a subsidiary of Eisner Advisory Group LLC (“EA Group”), which practices in an alternative practice structure with EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees provide advisory services to clients of EA Group and audit services to clients of Eisner Amper LLP and comply with the professional standards applicable to each of EA India, EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees also provide operational services to EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. The policies and procedures of EA India, including obligations of confidentiality and non-disclosure, apply to all services provided by EA India employees. All applicants are applying to positions for employment with EA India, and not EA Group or EisnerAmper LLP.
  
  
EA India opened its first office in Mumbai in 2007. Over the years, our India footprint has expanded to include offices in Bangalore, Hyderabad, and Ahmedabad. We are a culturally diverse pool of over 1000 professionals supporting our global clientele from a range of startups to Fortune 500 entities.
  
  
Should you need any accommodations to complete this application please email: indiata@eisneramper.com
  
  
Preferred Location:
  
  
Mumbai

title: AVP - RISK ORM – PMO Central
description:
Job Title: Assistant Vice President (AVP) - Operational Risk Officer – RISK ORM Anti-Fraud AVP – PMO Central
  
  
Department: RISK ORM
  
  
About Business line/Function: RISK Operational Risk Management (RISK ORM) belongs to the second line of defence control function at BNP Paribas. It belongs to the Risk Function (RISK) of BNP Paribas and is placed under the responsibility of the Chief Operational Risk Officer (CORO), who reports to the CRO of BNP Paribas.
  
  
Position Purpose: The department has responsibility for independently challenging and supervising the Operational Risk management of the whole Group including for the main business domains (also called Poles or Operating divisions) of CIB, CPBS and IPS. Additionally, there is responsibility to cover the Assets Liability Management and Treasury (ALM-T) operations too. This is achieved through: framing operational risk methodology and disseminating of risk management culture across the Group; assessing the adequacy of the operational risk management set-up; controlling effectiveness of Group’s control environment; contributing to the detection, anticipation and response to risks; alerting business and RISK stakeholders on any significant risk issue; providing a consolidated view on Group’s operational risks profile.
  
  
As the second line of defence for Fraud risk management (interchangeably called Anti-Fraud), RISK ORM has the responsibility for oversight and supervision on Fraud risks, ensuring and opining that appropriate Fraud risk management efforts are underway and raise any alerts in case of issues to the stability of the Bank and influencing business, functions and technology partners to take sound risk management decisions.
  
  
Scope: All of Group’s business activities that are exposed to fraud risks with specific focus on activities that are exposed to Rogue Trading risks globally.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  
Within Group RISK ORM, the PMO Central role supports the Fraud & Rogue Trading Risk framework under ORM CTFR (Cyber, Tech Risk, Fraud and Resilience). It contributes to the definition, implementation, and oversight of the Group’s control environment, with a strong focus on governance, consistency, and cross-entity alignment.
  
  
The position operates at the interface between central ORM teams, LoD2 stakeholders, and business lines.
  
  
Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Strong experience in Operational Risk / Internal Control / Audit within banking or financial services.
* Solid understanding of risk frameworks (RCSA, LoD1 and LoD2 controls, KRIs, Incidents).
* Interest or exposure to fraud / rogue trading topics is a strong advantage.
* Proven ability to coordinate complex topics across multiple stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, communication, and synthesis skills.
* Proactive mindset with a risk anticipation and problem-solving approach.

Technical & Behavioral Competencies
  
  
FRAUD PREVENTION & PROTECTION FRAMEWORK DESIGN & IMPLEMENTATION
  
  

* Support Risk ORM CTFR on the Operational Risk Management Framework on fraud related topics (HI, EWIB, Controls, RCSA, etc.), including the redaction of Group standards, procedures and policies, as well as the definition of a generic control plan within this domain of expertise.
* Verify the proper implementation of the Operational Risk Management Framework on Rogue Trading risks liaising with RISK ORM correspondents at the relevant level and assist them when needed.
* Within DMA (Designated Market Activities) context, monitor events of Rogue Trading, analyze controls performed by 2LoD, perform/coordinate with Poles read across analysis.

WATCH, RISK ANTICIPATION & MITIGATION ACTIONS
  
  

* Perform global watch on Rogue Trading topics, main regulatory evolutions and internal / external incidents.
* Coordinate on an annual basis the update and/or assignation of the Rogue Trading E learnings.

FRAUD GOVERNANCE, ALERTS AND PERIODIC REPORTING
  
  

* Coordinate preparation of Rogue Trading Committee materials (incl. data extraction from 360RiskOp).
* Consolidate inputs across stakeholders and ensure consistency of deliverables.
* Support periodic reporting on fraud risks impacting the Group and clients.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of governance and reporting processes.

**Skills And Experience Required**
Successful candidate will have exposure to operating in risk management programs in global organizations, with robust knowledge of technology, risks, architecture and related tools. Prior fraud risk management, compliance or fraud prevention experience and exposure to the Financial Services industry is a must. Experience with Rogue Trading risk management and systems is preferred.
  
  
**Specific Requirements**

* Suitable experience (12+ preferred) in any of the disciplines – Fraud risk management, fraud examinations, IT risk management or IT continuity. Assistant manager or Associate VP.
* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Information Security, Business or Risk Management (or equivalent professional qualification).
* Ability to independently investigate complex cases including cyber security incidents, intellectual property theft, fraud and abuse, asset misuse, and violations of corporate policy.
* Team player – focus on the success of the whole team. Working well both with others, as well as individually.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills.
* Experience in a 2LoD, Risk function, operations or an Internal Audit role.
* Good listening and analytical skills – being able to come to a thoughtful and business focused conclusion quickly.
* Ability to see the customer perspective, i.e. from a business point of view, the most secure solution is not always workable or realistic considering costs and benefits.
* Demonstrating a calm professional approach, with a good understanding of delivery within time constraints and the need to escalate/inform departmental management as appropriate.
* Adapting personal approach to suit situations, individuals, groups and cultures.
* Taking accountability for their actions and be open and honest when things have gone wrong and celebrating successes when things have gone well.
* Being rigorous and thorough – especially when logging and tracking issues through to conclusion.
* Ability to manage their workload as to meet the realistic targets and priorities set in conjunction with management.
* Demonstrating a high-level of commitment and self-motivation, combined with enthusiasm and a genuine interest in the role of Risk Assessment in business.
* Ability to express views clearly and fluently, both orally and in writing. Considers the audience, avoiding technical jargon wherever necessary and appropriate.

**Specific Qualifications**

* Good knowledge of Internal and external fraud risk management, cyber security, IT concepts.
* Understanding of the banking industry's regulatory requirements on Fraud and ICT (e.g. Article 325 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, EBA Guidelines on ICT and security risk management etc.)
* Ability to articulate risk management concepts in business language
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite
* Prior experience documenting tool requirements to support risk management
* Ability to travel to vendor sites and perform assessments as necessary
* Proven ability to manage issues through to resolution; skilled at making judgment calls.
* Ability to successfully multitask and complete difficult assignments within deadlines which may have short lead times
* Industry certifications (e.g. ACFE, CISA, CRISC) or willingness to obtain the same
* Works iteratively, delivering quickly and frequently to produce high quality documents and outputs which require little to no rework.
* Multilingual capability with English proficiency (+ French or Spanish) is preferred.

**Conduct**

* Be a role model, supporting and fostering a culture of good conduct.
* Demonstrate proactivity, transparency and accountability for identifying and managing conduct risks.

Consider the implications of your actions on colleagues, partners and clients before making decisions, and escalate issues to your manager when unsure.
  
  
Education Level: Any Graduate/Postgraduate
  
  
Location: Mumbai /Chennai
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
  
  
**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.
  
  
Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
  
  
At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. **Job Title:** 
 Manager, Packaging Development

**Travel Approximately:**

 Work
   

  

 Environment: Fast\-paced, Flexible, Startup Culture
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Manager, Packaging Development will be the key technical leader driving all
   

  

 packaging initiatives for new product launches across Personal Care and Color
   

  

 Cosmetics.
   

  

 This role requires an innovator with deep technical knowledge in rigid,
   

  

 semi\-rigid, paperboard and laminate packaging.
   

  

 The candidate must possess exceptional project management and stakeholder management skills, a hands\-on approach to mould development, and a proven ability to perform value
   

  

 engineering while maintaining strong quality standards.
   

  

 Crucially, the manager must have an in\-depth understanding of the cost breakdown for key formats, including glass bottles, PET bottles, Cap/Closures, Labels, Paperboard, and corrugated
   

  

 shippers, to drive maximum profitability and efficiency.
   

  

 This position requires flexibility, strong conflict resolution skills, and the ability to thrive in a high\-growth, startup culture.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
**I. New Product Launch \& Innovation Leadership**
**Drive NPD Process:** 
 Lead the full packaging lifecycle from concept definition to commercialization for a high volume of new product launches in the personal care and color cosmetics segments.
   

  

**Innovation \& Ideation:** 
 Act as a packaging innovator, continuously scouting
   

  

 new materials, formats, and design technologies to enhance consumer experience, improve sustainability, and reduce costs.
   

  

**Mould Development Expertise:** 
 Directly manage and execute the technical development and validation of new tooling and moulds for custom primary packaging components (e.g., bottles, jars, closures).
   

  

**II. Project Management \& Stakeholder Management**
**End\-to\-End Project Ownership:** 
 Utilize exceptional project management skills to define scopes, manage timelines, control budgets, and ensure on\- time delivery of all packaging projects.
   

  

**Stakeholder Alignment:** 
 Serve as the primary liaison, demonstrating strong stakeholder management and communication skills to align cross\- functional teams (Marketing, Operations, R\&D, Procurement).
   

  

**Conflict Resolution:** 
 Exhibit proficiency in critical thinking and managing conflict situations effectively to resolve technical and project\-related roadblocks quickly and maintain positive team dynamics.
   

  

**III. Technical Expertise \& Quality Assurance Costing \& Value Engineering:** 
 Possess deep expertise in the costing of packaging material, including bottles, caps, pumps, labels, paperboard cartons, and glass bottles. Conduct robust cost analysis and value
   

  

 engineering activities.
   

  

**IV. Material Specialization:** 
 Provide in\-depth technical knowledge and troubleshoot issues related to the functional performance of laminates (e.g., tubes) and rigid packaging components.
   

  

**Decoration Mastery:** 
 Maintain a good understanding of decoration techniques (e.g., screen printing, hot stamping, labeling, offset printing) and ensure technical feasibility and quality execution on all packaging.
   

  

**Quality Resolution:** 
 Lead and execute projects focused on resolving complex quality issues related to packaging components or filling line performance, driving effective and lasting resolution.
   

  

**V. Sustainability and Regulatory Leadership**
**Plastic \& Rigid Packaging:** 
 Drive the adoption of Post\-Consumer Recycled (PCR) content in bottles, jars, and closures, setting targets and validating
   

  

 material performance, color, and compatibility.
   

  

**Paperboard Packaging:** 
 Lead initiatives to optimize carton design for material reduction, ensuring all paperboard is sourced from certified sustainable forests (e.g., FSC\-certified) and maximizing the use of recycled fiber.
   

  

**Flexible Packaging (Laminates):** 
 Focus on transitioning complex multi\- material flexible packaging (e.g., sachets, tubes) to mono\-material structures that are designed for recyclability without compromising product preservation.
   

  

**Regulatory Compliance:** 
 Ensure all packaging materials and claims comply with local and international environmental regulations, recycling mandates, and labeling standards.
   

  

**Reporting:** 
 Track and report key packaging sustainability metrics, such as plastic usage and recyclability rates, in line with company goals.
   

  

**Qualifications And Required Skills**
**Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering , PG in Packaging from IIP/SIES.
   

  

**Experience:** 
 7\+ years of dedicated packaging development experience, specifically within the Personal Care and/or Color Cosmetics industry.
   

  

**Technical:** 
 Proven expertise in mould development, strong understanding of injection moulding processes, and comprehensive knowledge of material properties for both plastic and glass packaging.
   

  

**Soft Skills:** 
 Demonstrated excellence in communication, problem\-solving, critical thinking, and conflict management.
   

  

**Travel:** 
 Willingness to travel up to 20% internationally and domestically for supplier visits, trials, and trade shows.
   

  

**About Company**
 Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000\+ brands, 60,000\+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.
   

  

 Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000\+ offline touchpoints and launched 8 exclusive stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third\-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend\-driven, high\-quality beauty essentials.
   

  

 What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper\-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer\-first approach.
   

  

 In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.
   

  

 With a 3,000\+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.
