**Position Summary**
**Manager, Tax Services** 
**– Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) \- SAP FICO/MM/SD integration with Direct or Indirect Tax experience**
 You will lead and support SAP\-enabled tax transformation efforts for US\-based clients, helping organizations improve the way tax integrates with enterprise processes and technology. You will work with client stakeholders, lead teams, and help deliver implementation\-driven solutions in a complex global tax environment.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Manager, Tax Services on the Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Business Development: Develop and maintain contact with top decision makers at key clients; organize and lead pursuit teams; participate and lead aspects of the proposal development process; contribute to the development of proposal pricing strategies.
* Client Management: Manage the day\-to\-day interactions with executive clients and sponsors.
* Engagement Management: Lead engagement planning and budgeting; mobilize and manage engagement teams; define deliverable structure and content; facilitate buy\-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client; direct on\-time, quality delivery of work products; manage engagement economics; and manage engagement risk.
* Practice Development \& Eminence: Develop practical solutions and methodologies; develop "thought\-ware" and "point\-of\-view" documents; participate in public speaking events; get published in industry periodicals.
* People Development: Perform role of counselor and coach; provide input and guidance into the staffing process; actively participate in staff recruitment and retention activities; provide leadership and support for delivery teams and staff in local offices.


**The team**
 Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) group helps our clients’ tax departments improve their operations by developing new technology\-enabled, cutting\-edge methods and processes. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients’ objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co\-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients’ global strategies and the options that exist to turn theory into an executable plan.
   

  

 TTC’s Enterprise Tax Integration (ETI) professionals provide an integrated approach to process improvement that can help the tax department maximize its strategic value to the organization. Companies that have already implemented or are considering implementing an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.
   

  

 Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) \- Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading\-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
   

  

 Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients’ tax department move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte Tax LLP professionals are aligned worldwide to serve our clients’ needs through the TTC group. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co\-sourcing specialists who can help make the necessary connections between our clients’ global strategies and the many options for carrying them out in the tax function.
   

  

**Location: Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune**
**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* 8 to 15\+ years of total experience.
* 5\+ years of Implementation experience in SAP ECC 6\.0 \& S4 HANA with focus on Tax integration with SAP FICO/MM/SD integration with direct or indirect tax experience.
* Experience with tax technology applications i.e., ONESOURCE /Global NEXT Integration, Vertex/Accelerator \& Chain flow Accelerator Integration, Avalara, Sovos.
* Expert in Direct and Indirect Tax configuration, Withholding Taxes, local country indirect tax localizations, VAT customizations and Reporting.
* Experience with User Exits, preparing functional specifications, executing test cycles, cutovers, go\-live and Hypercare, providing user training and documentation.
* Expert in cross functional integration of modules \- SD\-FI \& MM\-FI
* Strong analytical skills in business process design and requirements preparation


 Preferred:
   

  

* SAP MM or SD (ECC or S4 HANA) Certified
* SAP DRC, Central Finance with Tax integration, Transfer Pricing, BRIM
* Experience with New GL, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Intercompany, Materials Management, Logistics Invoice Verification, Asset Accounting implementation.
* Experience with Ariba, Coupa, Hybris, Open Text, Read soft Integration with ERP.


 \#SAPFICO\-TTC
   

  

**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**

title: MEP Project Engineer
description:
**Location:** 
 Mumbai, Maharashtra
 



**Experience** 
 : 5–10 Years
 



**Industry** 
 : Interior Fit\-Out / Commercial Interiors / Construction
 



**Employment Type** 
 : Full\-Time
 



**Department** 
 : Projects / Execution
 



**Notice Period:** 
 Immediate / 15–30 Days preferred
 



**Job Summary** 




 We are looking for an experienced MEP Engineer with 5–10 years of relevant experience in the interior fit\-out and construction industry to manage and execute MEP works at project sites. The candidate will be responsible for coordinating and supervising electrical, HVAC, plumbing, fire\-fighting, and other MEP services while ensuring quality, timelines, safety, and compliance with approved drawings and specifications.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Plan, coordinate, and supervise MEP works for interior fit\-out projects from execution through handover.
* Review and interpret MEP drawings, shop drawings, layouts, specifications, and BOQs.
* Coordinate with architects, interior designers, consultants, contractors, vendors, and project teams.
* Supervise installation of:



 o Electrical systems, lighting, power, DBs, panels, and cable management.
 



 o HVAC systems, ducting, piping, FCUs/AHUs, and ventilation.
 



 o Plumbing and drainage systems.
 



 o Fire\-fighting and fire\-alarm systems.
 



 o ELV systems such as CCTV, access control, data/networking, and other low\-voltage services, as applicable.
 


* Ensure MEP installations are executed as per approved drawings, specifications, statutory requirements, and project standards.
* Coordinate MEP services with interior finishes, ceilings, partitions, furniture, and other architectural works to avoid clashes and rework.
* Conduct regular site inspections and monitor workmanship and installation quality.
* Coordinate with subcontractors and vendors for manpower, materials, work schedules, and site requirements.
* Track project progress against planned schedules and highlight delays or site constraints.
* Prepare and maintain daily/weekly progress reports, inspection reports, checklists, and site records.
* Coordinate testing, commissioning, snagging, rectification, and final handover of MEP systems.
* Support quantity verification, material approvals, BOQ reconciliation, and measurement of contractor works.
* Ensure compliance with HSE requirements and site safety procedures.
* Attend site meetings and provide technical inputs and updates to the Project Manager.
* Resolve site\-level technical issues in coordination with consultants and design teams.
* Ensure proper documentation, as\-built drawings, O\&M manuals, test reports, and handover documentation.



**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* Diploma/B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical / Electrical Engineering or relevant MEP discipline.
* 5–10 years of experience, preferably in interior fit\-out, commercial interiors, corporate offices, retail, hospitality, or high\-end residential projects.
* Strong knowledge of MEP services and their coordination with interior works.
* Good understanding of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire\-fighting, and ELV systems.
* Ability to read and interpret MEP/shop drawings and coordinate drawings.
* Experience in site execution, subcontractor management, quality control, and project coordination.
* Knowledge of relevant Indian standards, codes, and statutory requirements.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD; knowledge of MS Excel/MS Office is required.
* Knowledge of Revit/BIM/Navisworks will be an advantage.
* Strong communication, coordination, problem\-solving, and site\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple activities and work effectively under project Deadlines.



**Preferred Experience** 




 Candidates who have worked on commercial office fit\-outs, retail outlets, hotels,
 



 restaurants, corporate interiors, or premium residential projects will be Preferred.
 



**Key Performance Areas** 



* Timely completion of MEP works
* Installation quality and adherence to approved drawings
* Coordination and clash\-free execution
* Effective subcontractor/vendor management
* Testing, commissioning, and snag closure
* Compliance with safety and statutory requirements
* Accurate project documentation and handover

title: Technical Lead, Software Development
description:
The Software Development Manager is a vital position in our organization as we grow our software development environment and expand our IT department in Mumbai. Our Software Development department delivers solutions that enable and empower both internal and external customers to manage their business processes most effectively and efficiently. This individual will be tasked with accelerating the modernization of Medpace clinical and administrative software.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage software engineers and software development projects to implement effective and high\-quality software solutions;
* Collect, analyze, and document user requirements;
* Perform project management, ensure system quality and oversee content management;
* Coordinate with company\-wide leadership regarding software development projects;
* Design, modify, develop, support, install, and document software applications;

* Train software engineers and end users; and

* Excellent analytical, written and oral communication skills in English;

**Medpace Overview**
 Medpace is a full\-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l\-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in\-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti\-viral and anti\-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40\+ countries.
   

  

**Why Medpace?**
 When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting\-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross\-functional collaboration.
   

  

***Purpose\-Driven Work***
* 
+ Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry\-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence


***Collaborative Culture***
* 
+ Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
+ Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable


***Continuous Growth \& Development***
* 
+ Office based environment with on\-site mentors
+ Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
+ Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
+ Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
+ An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly


**Other Employee Benefits**
* 
+ Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
+ Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
+ Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
+ Company\-sponsored social events


*Please note benefits may vary based on country.*
**What To Expect Next**
 A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

description:

 The vision is clear. The intent is clear. Now comes the harder part: making it real.
 



 Because organisations do not change because a presentation says they should. They change when intent translates into clear behaviours, operating disciplines, systems and SOPs that people can actually follow — and managers can actually manage.

 Not just define what should happen. Design it. Implement it. Make it stick.

description:
Whether you’re at the start of your career or looking to discover your next adventure, your story begins here. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills and make a difference at one of the world’s most global banks. We’re fully committed to supporting your growth and development from the start with extensive on\-the\-job training and exposure to senior leaders, as well as more traditional learning. You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact where we live and work through volunteerism.
   

  

 The
 **Citi Advantage Cobrand Acquisitions Risk \& Controls Lead** 
 is responsible for building, maintaining, and executing a robust control framework across Cobrand Partner channels and Partner\-Generated Campaigns. This pivotal role drives the "Operating in Control" (OIC) agenda for the Cobrand portfolio, providing comprehensive oversight of issues and escalations, coordinating internal and external exams, and managing the end\-to\-end lifecycle of the Process, Risk, Control, and Monitoring (PRCM) framework—from initial design to annual assessments and ongoing monitoring. Additionally, the Lead owns the end\-to\-end authorship and maintenance of the Cobrand Desktop Manual, a critical cornerstone of OIC documentation.
   

  

 Ultimately, this individual ensures that Cobrand operates in a highly controlled environment across both existing and emerging channels and products. Proactive oversight is critical; without it, channels risk falling short of management expectations across the Cobrand partner portfolios. With aggressive partner commitments and channel growth plans slated for 2026 and beyond, this role serves as the epicenter of our control framework. Success requires cultivating deep, collaborative partnerships with key internal stakeholders and subject matter experts, including In\-Business Control, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Product/Marketing owners. A rapid onboarding and deep understanding of the Marketing Organization’s operational dynamics are essential for immediate impact.
   

  

**In this role, you’re expected to:**
* Serve as Operating in Control (OIC) Co\-Champion for Cobrand Acquisitions, establishing clear accountability and streamlined processes across key pillars: Issues Management, Exam Support/Coordination, PRCM/Control Maintenance, and Desktop Manual ownership.
* Rapidly master the marketing and acquisition business model to effectively understand, articulate, and influence critical points of intersection with the OIC agenda.
* Champion and elevate risk and control standards, ensuring their consistent, equitable application while exercising sound, long\-term risk judgment.
* Implement and execute robust risk and control practices across the Marketing \& Franchise Development organization, embedding proactive foresight, risk anticipation, and preventative control solutions.
* Deliver on Citi’s regulatory transformation commitments, driving process and control excellence to achieve frictionless execution and radical simplification.
* Cultivate proactive risk management practices across the broader team, championing a best\-in\-class risk and controls culture.
* Maintain a perpetual state of audit and exam readiness; deliver high\-quality walkthroughs and artifacts to reviewers, while prioritizing and executing against regulatory commitments, including Consent Order requirements.
* Escalate and permanently resolve identified issues in a timely manner, ensuring full compliance with organizational expectations and enterprise procedures.
* Deliver compliant, safe, and customer\-centric operational excellence through the rigorous design of business processes and the flawless execution of day\-to\-day controls.
* Proactively identify control gaps, process deficiencies, approval discrepancies, and compliance risks, driving swift escalation, remediation, and resolution with key stakeholders.
* Lead process improvement, automation, and workflow optimization initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, strengthen controls, improve review accuracy, and minimize manual effort.
* Serve as the primary Records Retention Point of Contact (POC) for the Cobrand team, partnering with the Business Records Management Officer to maintain the Cobrand Record Inventory and execute compliance activities.
* Partner with technology teams to implement system enhancements, testing protocols, and process innovations that drive user adoption, operational effectiveness, and control consistency.
* Foster a culture of deep accountability, continuous improvement, and rigorous governance, compliance, and operational excellence within the Cobrand team.
* Perform other job\-related duties as assigned, supporting the evolving needs of the business.


**As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:**
* 8–13 years of experience in Financial Services, with a strong preference for experience in Marketing, Risk, or Control management.
* Proven track record of advanced project management, with exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder\-influencing skills.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize and manage multiple complex projects simultaneously in a high\-stakes environment.
* Ability to seamlessly step into the role, pick up ongoing programs mid\-stream, and drive them to successful completion.
* Strong analytical capabilities, creative problem\-solving skills, and a deep sense of personal ownership.
* Ability to thrive under tight deadlines within a fast\-paced, highly collaborative, and matrixed environment.
* High proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint, with a proven aptitude for quickly mastering new systems, platforms, and software.
* Strong personal accountability, decisiveness, and alignment with a high\-performance work ethic culture.
* Experience managing complex partner relationships and/or external vendor engagements.

description:

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Role Name And Description**
 Manager, AXIS Modeling, Life Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting
   

  

* Lead a diverse, highly motivated and collaborative team
* Be part of a high\-performing, supportive culture
* Work with a team of collaborators, innovators and the brightest minds in the industry


 Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high\-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
   

  

**The opportunity**
* We are looking for a Manager to join our Life Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering AXIS modeling solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
* You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high\-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long\-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
* Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.


**Your Key Responsibilities**
 As a Manager within the Actuarial AXIS modelling team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
   

  

**On engagements, you will:**
* Responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Senior Consultants, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project
* Demonstrate the ability to apply their problem\-solving skills to new and complex situations and problems with minimal supervision and maintain quality and accuracy
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff/Senior members
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagement are delivered within time
* Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality, consistently driving projects to completion and ensuring that work is of high standards
* Establish/manage priorities, create/manage work plans, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Maintain a strong stakeholder focus and maintain/develop productive working relationships with stakeholders and other team members


**Within the actuarial practice you will:**
* Communicate the results of analysis to actuaries in other geographical regions such as Australia, North America, Latin America, Asia Pacific, Middle East, Africa, UK and European Countries
* Overall 8\+ to 15 years of actuarial experience with 6\+ years of AXIS modeling experience or in AXIS valuation / reporting / pricing experience in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
* Good understanding of US/ Canada product lines and regulations; hands\-on IFRS17 or LDTI implementation experience (optional)
* Project management experience and ability to handle teams and multiple stakeholders
* Advance modelling experience in AXIS software
* Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
* Strong presentation and documentation skills
* We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging, and supporting our global network.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
 Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
   

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Qualified or Part/ nearly Qualified Actuary with at least 8\+ years to 15 years of experience in Life Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, IFRS17 or LDTI)
* Ability to multi\-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Experience of handling a moderate sized team will be an advantage
* Proficiency in MS\-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially US/Canada/Europe/UK/Australia market experience)


**What We Look For**
* Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent big 4 experience in leading actuarial engagement with recognised insurers will be an advantage. This ideally should be complemented by employment experience within the Insurance sector either at an insurer, intermediary or regulator
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organisations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Director of Software Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
 If you are a software engineering leader ready to take the reins and drive impact, we've got an opportunity just for you.
   

  

 As a Director of Software Engineering at JPMorganChase within the within the Commercial and Investment Bank, you will own a dual mandate across platform/build (Snowflake enablement, reusable capabilities, reliability, security/controls) and business\-facing value delivery (merchant and sales insights, risk and loss reduction, operational efficiency). You will role partner closely with Product, Sales, Operations, Architecture, and Risk/Controls to deliver scalable capabilities and outcomes the field can use immediately. This is a hands\-on technology leadership role with a high bar for engineering excellence, including code quality, secure\-by\-design development, automated testing, CI/CD discipline, and operational readiness.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Drives Snowflake\-based analytics/AI enablement with governed data products, secure access, scalable patterns, and performance and cost guardrails.
* Defines reference architectures and reusable components with engineering and platform teams (e.g., payments\-scale aggregation, merchant entity resolution). Drives delivery excellence through agile practices, milestone execution, and rigorous dependency management.
* Operates a production\-grade SDLC for data/AI products: CI/CD, automated testing, observability, runbooks, incident response, and rollback.
* Owns the Merchant Payments analytics and AI roadmap aligned to measurable outcomes (e.g., TPV growth, authorization uplift, fraud and chargeback loss reduction, onboarding cycle time reduction, merchant experience).
* Delivers analytics products end\-to\-end (dashboards and KPIs, self\-serve analytics, predictive and decision support) with adoption and lifecycle ownership.
* Sets and enforces code quality and quality gates (reviews, static analysis, secure coding, unit and integration testing). Drive timely delivery through strong execution mechanics (milestones, dependency management, CI/CD automation, release discipline).
* Sponsors governance across ownership and stewardship, metadata and lineage, data quality SLAs, retention and access controls, and dataset certification. Standardize critical metric definitions to reduce drift and reconciliation (e.g., TPV, authorization rate, losses, disputes and chargebacks).
* Run governance forums and issue and remediation processes aligned to delivery priorities. Enables sales and business teams with timely, trusted insights that drive targeting, retention, and portfolio actions.
* Leads multi\-disciplinary teams (analytics, data science, product, engineering, governance) including hiring, coaching, and performance management. Manages budget and capacity planning, partner engagement as needed, and ROI and value tracking tied to outcomes.
* Sets direction and governance for agentic AI\-enabled engineering and SDLC/TLM automation within a technical area to drive measurable improvements in speed, quality, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI\-orchestrated delivery workflows, release readiness controls, automated test modernization, and incident triage acceleration), while establishing guardrails for validation, security, resiliency, traceability, and reuse across teams.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation and support capacity unlock initiatives at scale


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 10\+ years applied experience. In addition, 5\+ years of experience leading technologists to manage, anticipate and solve complex technical items within your domain of expertise

title: Content & Social Lead
description:
**Content \& Social Lead** 




 Location: Mumbai (on site)
 



 Type: Full\-time
 



 Experience: 4–6 years in content and social
 



  





 About NapChief:
 




 NapChief is a fast\-growing D2C kidswear brand. We sell through our own website (napchief.com) and all major marketplaces including Myntra, FirstCry, and Amazon. At Nap Chief, we're redefining kids' wear for a new generation of parents. We craft premium, super\-soft clothing that kids love to wear and parents trust.Our mission is to empower the young generation and we are looking for you to join forces with us to conquer this mission.
 




  





 About the role
 



 You will own NapChief’s entire content and social function everything the brand publishes, the calendar it runs on, the team that produces it, and the audience response it earns.This is a management seat first and a craft seat second. Five people report to you, and you will be measured by what your team produces, not by what you produce personally. If your ambition is to be the best maker in the room, this is the wrong role. If your ambition is to build a content engine that runs on a calendar and hits its dates without you in the middle of every task, this is the right one.
 



  





 Responsibilities:
 



**Content calendar and planning** 



* Own the rolling content calendar across Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and any platform we operate on — planned monthly, locked weekly, visible to the company in Asana with fixed start and end dates.
* Build the calendar around kidswear seasonality: the winter peak, festive and gifting windows, back\-to\-school, new collection drops, and end\-of\-season sale periods.
* Own the format mix — reels, statics, carousels, long\-form, UGC and rebalance it monthly against performance data rather than team preference.
* Plan against the two audiences that matter and be explicit about which one each piece addresses: parents, who buy, and children, who wear.



  





**Production and shoot management** 



* Own the shoot calendar end to end: concept, script, model casting and confirmation, location, props, styling, call sheets, and post\-production timelines.
* Hold the production schedule. A shoot that loses its models on the morning of is a planning failure build the confirmations, buffers, and fallbacks that prevent it.
* Manage external partners: photographers, videographers, editors, and studios, including rate negotiation and delivery timelines.
* Ensure every new collection has shoot\-ready assets before it goes live on the website and marketplaces.



  





**Organic social and community** 



* Own organic performance as a number: reach, engagement, saves, shares, follower growth, and non\-follower reach reported weekly against target, not anecdotally.
* Run publishing discipline. No reposting old content as filler. Retire formats once they stop performing and test new ones on a defined cadence.
* Own community management comments, DMs, and the response SLA routing anything that becomes a service issue to customer service.



  





**Influencer and UGC** 



* Own the influencer program through the influencer marketing owner on your team: partner selection, brief quality, deliverable tracking, usage rights, and cost per asset.
* Build a repeatable UGC pipeline from customers and parent creators, and route the best\-performing assets into the paid creative pool.
* Measure influencer spend the way we measure everything else — cost per usable asset, engagement earned, and contribution to sales where trackable.



  





**Brand storytelling** 



* Own the brand narrative in content: what NapChief stands for, how it sounds, and how that holds together across every post, campaign, and collection launch.
* Write and approve scripts and copy, or direct the team that does.
* Maintain the Master Creative Document as a living reference that survives any individual leaving.
* Run seasonal campaign concepts end to end: brief, narrative, asset list, timeline, and post\-campaign review against results.



  





**Team leadership** 



* Manage five people directly. Run weekly 1:1s and a documented weekly team review.
* Set priorities explicitly. Every person on your team should be able to state their top three priorities for the week without asking you.
* Hold people to dates. Where work slips you handle it directly — the conversation, the written expectation, the follow\-up, and the escalation if it repeats. Repeated following\-up is not management.
* Develop the team. Two of the five are in their first or second year. Your job is to make them independent, not to absorb their work when they struggle.
* Own hiring input, interview scorecards, and probation recommendations for your team.



  





**Coordination** 



* Work alongside the Brand Strategist, who owns creative for paid media. Your organic and production engine feeds that pipeline.
* One team member is coached by the Brand Strategist on creative craft while reporting to you — you own their priorities, performance, and review.
* Work with the Shopify and marketplace owners so launches, sale events, and campaigns have assets on time.



  





**KPIs you own** 



* Organic reach and engagement growth vs monthly target, including non\-follower reach
* Content calendar adherence — planned vs published, on date
* Shoot\-to\-live turnaround — days from shoot to assets available for use
* Asset throughput per month at the agreed quality bar
* Influencer cost per usable asset
* Team scorecard completion every person on your team on a live weekly scorecard



  





**Requirements:** 



* 4–6 years in content and social for consumer brands, including 2\+ years managing a team of four or more. Agency backgrounds are welcome, particularly if you ran a pod across brands and now want to go deep on one.
* Demonstrated people management with a mechanism behind it. You will be asked in the interview to walk through, week by week, how you handled someone who repeatedly missed deadlines. We are looking for a specific method, not persistence.
* Experience running a production calendar with real deadlines and real consequences — shoots, launches, and campaign dates that could not move.
* Strong planning and timeline management. This is the core competency for this seat, ahead of design or editing skill.
* Storytelling ability. You can articulate why a piece of content exists and what it should make a parent feel or do.
* Comfort with numbers: platform analytics, weekly reporting, and making format decisions from data.
* Hands\-on enough to be credible. You can brief, review, and give sharp feedback on a reel or a script even if you are not the one editing it.
* Working proficiency with Asana or an equivalent, plus social scheduling and analytics tooling.
* Not a fit if: your strongest asset is your personal portfolio and you would rather be making content than running a team; your management experience is limited to freelancers; or you have led social at a large brand where an agency and a producer handled production.

title: Principal Engineer - Secondary Design
description:
**Job Description**
 The position will lead and guide the P\&C design team in delivering project and proposal activities across a diverse portfolio of international T\&D, Renewable (Onshore \& Offshore wind/ Solar), BESS substation projects, with a strong focus on UK‑based engagements and in addition to providing leadership, the role will also contribute individually to key project deliverables, applying deep technical expertise and established engineering methodologies.
   

  

 As a lead, the individual will plan, allocate, and oversee daily tasks within the team, ensuring that all engineering outputs consistently meet required On‑Time Delivery (OTD) targets and comply with internal and external quality standards. The role includes reviewing designs, mentoring junior engineers, resolving technical issues, and ensuring disciplined execution of engineering activities.
   

  

 This position is responsible for delivering high‑quality engineering design across multiple concurrent projects ranging from moderate‑scale assignments to major project work packages while ensuring cost‑effective execution aligned with contract specifications, safety requirements, and agreed project timelines.

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**
 Responsible for ensuring all new product launches and modifications, adhering to the internal policy and Reserve Bank of India regulations.
   

  

 To ensure effective governance, coordination, and execution of the Product Approval Committee (PAC) for the Bank.
   

  

 This role acts as an executioner in managing committee operations, ensuring compliance with regulatory and internal guidelines, risk management and facilitating strategic decision\-making, related to product approvals and lifecycle governance.
   

  

 Assist to organize and convene regular PAC meetings to review, approve or reject new product launches / material modification to existing products in alignment with the scheduled timelines.
   

  

 Ensure approvals from all the relevant stakeholders are obtained for product offerings placed in the Committee, includes both new and existing modifications

 Liaise with the relevant stakeholders as applicable, viz., product owners, risk, compliance, legal, finance, IT and operations teams to collate inputs for PAC deliberations.
   

  

 Ensure timely submission of proposals and product notes for review.
   

  

 Ensure approvals of all the relevant stakeholders are obtained in the system workflow well in advance, prior to placing the new product or modifications in the Committee
   

  

 Ensure periodic follow up and escalation mechanism to ensure approvals or rejections are obtained on time
   

  

 Ensure PAC decisions adhere to RBI guidelines, internal product governance frameworks, and risk management policies.
   

  

 Ensure coordination with Risk, Compliance / Legal for the potential Risk – Mitigant matrix for all the new products and modifications to the existing products
   

  

 Track and report compliance status for all approved products.
   

  

 Maintain a repository of all product approvals, modifications, and discontinuations.
   

  

 Maintain a summary of the Annual / Periodic Review as per the defined frequency
   

  

 Prepare and maintain Compliance Review summary dashboard post market launch of the product
   

  

 Preparation of Minutes of the Meeting and circulation to all concerned and the same is maintained for future reference / audits.
   

  

 Identify opportunities to streamline PAC processes and enhance governance efficiency.
   

  

 Implement best practices for documentation, decision\-making, and follow\-up.
   

  

 Strong understanding of banking products, banking practices and regulatory environment.
   

  

 Excellent organizational and project management skills.
   

  

 Excellent leadership, communication and cross functional collaboration skills
   

  

 Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and drive consensus.
   

  

 Proficiency in MS Office and governance tools.
   

  

 Strong communication and documentation skills.

 Graduation: Bachelor of Commerce (B.com) / Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) / Bachelor of Arts (BA) / Bachelor of Business \& Insurance (BBI) / Bachelor of Management Studies (BMS)

**Experience:** 
 5 \- 10 years of relevant experience

title: Project Manager - Manufacturing and supply chain
description:
**Project Manager – Manufacturing \& Supply Chain (India)** 




**Position Summary** 




 We are seeking a Project Manager with strong manufacturing and supply‑chain experience to support India‑based operations.
 



 This role manages projects from concept through production, coordinates with suppliers and engineering teams, and ensures all deliverables meet quality, cost, and timeline requirements.
 



 The ideal candidate has hands‑on experience with India’s manufacturing ecosystem, supplier networks, and GST‑related compliance.
 



 Preferred location: Mumbai, India.
 








**Key Responsibilities** 




**Project Management \& Execution** 



* Lead planning, scheduling, and execution of manufacturing and supply‑chain projects from initiation through completion.
* Develop project charters, timelines, resource plans, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Track progress and provide structured reporting to leadership.
* Ensure cross‑functional alignment across engineering, production, quality, and logistics teams.



**Supplier Sourcing \& Management** 



* Identify, evaluate, and qualify suppliers across India for manufacturing, tooling, components, and packaging.
* Conduct supplier audits, capability assessments, and cost evaluations.
* Negotiate pricing, lead times, and service agreements to support project requirements.
* Build strong supplier relationships to ensure reliability, compliance, and continuous improvement.



**Manufacturing \& Engineering Coordination** 



* Collaborate with engineering teams to translate technical requirements into manufacturable solutions.
* Support process development, tooling readiness, pilot runs, and production ramp‑up.
* Resolve technical issues related to materials, processes, equipment, and product performance.

description:

**Position Overview** 




 Seeking an experienced, hands\-on Project Manager to assist in managing the Source to Pay (S2P) workstream. This workstream includes the migration of Strategic Sourcing to Oracle, the replacement of the Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) system from Coupa to Aravo, and the implementation of a new Zip orchestration layer designed to unify and simplify the end\-to\-end sourcing, procurement, and payment experience for business users.
 



 This is a highly visible role requiring a proactive self\-starter who can manage complex, interdependent workstreams while communicating clearly and confidently with senior stakeholders, including steering committee members and executive sponsors. The ideal candidate combines strong technical understanding of source\-to\-pay processes with the polish and presence needed to lead discussions with senior audiences.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the project plan, milestones, RAID log, and deliverables for the S2P workstream, spanning Strategic Sourcing (PeopleSoft), TPRM (Aravo), and the Zip orchestration layer.
* Partner with Strategic Sourcing, Accounts Payable, Purchasing, and TPRM teams to define future\-state processes, requirements, and system configurations.
* Coordinate configuration, testing, and validation activities across PeopleSoft Sourcing, Aravo TPRM, and Zip orchestration, ensuring seamless integration and a cohesive end\-to\-end user experience.
* Manage vendor master data cleanup, mapping, and migration activities in close coordination with the Data workstream.
* Proactively identify gaps, dependencies, and risks across the three underlying platforms before they impact timelines, and drive resolution through appropriate program channels.
* Schedule and facilitate S2P status meetings, domain working sessions, workshops, and steering committee updates.
* Prepare clear, executive\-ready status reports and presentation materials, and confidently present progress, risks, and decisions to senior TIAA leadership and steering committee members.
* Track, escalate, and drive resolution of risks and issues per program governance standards.
* Coordinate UAT planning and execution with business process owners across sourcing, AP, and TPRM functions.
* Support organizational change management, stakeholder communications, and training for S2P end users, ensuring adoption of new processes and the Zip orchestration experience.
* Demonstrate meticulous attention to detail in tracking deliverables, documenting decisions, and validating configuration and testing outcomes.



**Program\-Level Responsibilities (applicable to all six workstream PM roles)** 



* Adhere to AmpliFi program governance, PMO standards, and reporting templates/cadence.
* Participate in cross\-workstream coordination meetings to proactively identify and manage interdependencies with other AmpliFi workstreams.
* Escalate risks and issues through defined program governance channels in a timely manner.
* Support overall cutover planning, go\-live readiness, and post\-go\-live stabilization for the S2P domain.



**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or a related field.
* 6–10 years of project management experience, including at least 3 years leading procurement, sourcing, accounts payable, or TPRM transformation initiatives.
* Direct, hands\-on familiarity with at least two of the following: PeopleSoft (Sourcing/Procurement), Coupa, Aravo, Zip, or comparable sourcing, TPRM, or orchestration platforms.
* Strong working knowledge of end\-to\-end source\-to\-pay processes, including strategic sourcing, purchase order creation, three\-way matching, invoice\-to\-pay, and third\-party/vendor risk management, ideally within a large international financial services organization.

**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Prior experience with ERP transformation programs, particularly upgrades or replacements involving sourcing, procurement, or TPRM systems.

 Experience working within regulated financial services environments, with an understanding of associated compliance and audit requirements

It leads the Dharavi Redevelopment Project, aiming to transform one of Asia’s largest informal settlements into a modern urban hub with sustainable housing, infrastructure, and economic opportunities.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 The role is responsible for overseeing and managing all civil construction activities, ensuring compliance with project specifications, safety regulations, and quality standards. This role involves leading a team of engineers and contractors, conducting site inspections, and coordinating with various stakeholders to achieve project objectives efficiently and effectively.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Lead Project Construction**
**Technical Management**
 Provide technical guidance and advice to design staff, supervisors, inspectors, and contractors regarding civil construction practices.
   

  

 Analyze civil engineering issues and formulate effective solutions to ensure compliance with project requirements.
   

  

 Conduct structural analysis and design for buildings across various sectors, ensuring technical quality and compliance with project objectives, safety, and quality standards.
   

  

 Prepare and check detailed structural calculations and review drawings in line with project quality procedures.
   

  

 Develop and review detailed plans, specifications, and cost estimates for civil construction projects.
   

  

**Project Documentation**
 Review project documents, including tenders, specifications, bills of quantities (BOQs), material submittals, and shop drawings for compliance with design intent.
   

  

 Draft and issue site/engineer’s instructions related to civil construction works as required.
   

  

 Review and provide feedback on contractors’ Operation and Maintenance manuals to ensure comprehensive project documentation.
   

  

**Inspection And Compliance**
 Conduct site inspections to ensure adherence to approved plans, specifications, and best practices for civil construction.
   

  

 Undertake periodic site visits to ensure civil/structural works are executed per design intent.
   

  

 Review general specifications and site\-specific particular specifications to ensure alignment with project requirements.
   

  

 Undertake final project snagging and prepare a list of defects for contractor rectification.
   

  

 Review contractor installation method statements and ensure compliance with project requirements.
   

  

**Clearance And Approval**
 Review contractor shop drawings against design documents and provide comments or approvals within specified timelines.
   

  

 Assess contractor material proposals for compliance with specified performance requirements and advise the Project Manager accordingly.
   

  

 Evaluate the technical qualifications of proposed subcontractors associated with civil works.

description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone.  Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi\-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.
   

  

 Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The CFOC (CFO Change) team, which is part of the COO \& Governance organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The CFO Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.

title: Engineering Group Manager
description:
**Overview**
 SSOE is seeking an accomplished engineering leader to lead and scale our India Engineering organization as a strategic Global Capability Center (GCC) supporting our U.S. business operations.
   

  

 This role presents a unique opportunity to build and lead one of SSOE's key global engineering organizations. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing a high\-performing multidisciplinary engineering team, managing complex projects, strengthening technical excellence, fostering leadership capability, and establishing India as a trusted extension of SSOE's global delivery model.
   

  

**AI and Innovation**
 At SSOE, we don’t just talk about the future, we build it. As a leader in industry AI adoption, we empower our team to work smarter by providing responsible access to the industry leading AI Large Language Models, vibe\-coding platforms, and securely integrating advanced tools into every role. From day one, you’ll receive the training and support needed to leverage AI as a core tool for enhancing productivity, sparking creativity, and streamlining complex workflows.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership \& Quality**
* Provide strategic and operational leadership for all engineering disciplines within the India office
* Ensure consistent application of engineering standards, design procedures, quality processes, and best practices across all disciplines
* Oversee implementation and maintenance of discipline\-specific standards, workflows, templates, and quality management systems
* Facilitate technical reviews, peer reviews, and quality assurance processes for major projects and deliverables
* Promote innovation, digital engineering, BIM, and emerging technologies


**Stakeholder Management \& Global Collaboration**
* Build trusted relationships with Engineering Leaders, Project and Operations Leaders, and Business Unit Leaders across SSOE's U.S. offices.
* Participate in strategic planning and resource alignment discussions with U.S. stakeholders.
* Act as the primary engineering leadership interface between India and U.S. operations.
* Facilitate seamless communication and collaboration across global teams.
* Resolve organizational and project delivery challenges (pertaining to India deliverables) across multiple geographies.
* Promote knowledge sharing, lessons learned, and best practice adoption across the enterprise.


**Global Capability Center Leadership**
* Lead the development and growth of SSOE's India Engineering Capability Center.
* Partner with U.S.\-based engineering, operations, and business leaders to align India capabilities with business needs.
* Establish India as a trusted, high\-performing extension of SSOE's global engineering organization.
* Drive standardization and consistency in engineering delivery across global teams.
* Build organizational capabilities that enable increased project execution from India.
* Promote collaboration, transparency, and accountability across geographically distributed teams.
* Strengthen cross\-border relationships that improve project outcomes and client satisfaction.


**People Management \& Talent Development**
* Manage, mentor, and coach engineers, designers, section managers and department managers within the group, providing regular feedback, guidance, and support.
* Identify strengths and development areas of team members; create and execute individual development plans and career paths in partnership with HR and corporate Training \& Development.
* Partner with Department Managers, Section Managers, Operations, and HR on hiring, onboarding, performance management, and staffing decisions for your engineering team.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning, safety, quality, and accountability, where team members are engaged and empowered to contribute ideas.
* Lead, coordinate, and participate during talent review process for the DMs, SMs and engineering / designers’ group.
* Build a strong leadership pipeline capable of supporting organizational growth


**Resource Planning, Scheduling, and Workload Management**
* Work closely with Operation Managers, Project Managers, Section Managers and Department Managers to solve scheduling and resource allocation challenges.
* Facilitate development with inputs from relevant stakeholders. Monitor project work schedules and departmental workload forecasts, ensuring alignment between staffing, skill sets, and project priorities.
* Use your technical expertise to ensure the proper staff are allocated effectively across multiple projects, disciplines, and business units, balancing workload to maximize efficiency.
* Explore ways to prioritize workstreams and resolve resource bottlenecks to maintain high operational standards and exceed client expectations.
* Monitor delivery performance and implement corrective actions as necessary.
* Support operational excellence initiatives that improve productivity, efficiency, and project outcomes.


**Cross\-Office Collaboration \& Best Practices**
* Coordinate with other SSOE international offices to ensure that project teams can share resources, tools, and best practices.
* Help standardize workflows and improve inter\-office communication, ensuring that all teams are aligned toward common objectives.
* Champion knowledge\-sharing practices, including post\-project reviews, lessons learned, and reusable content/templates.


**Business Performance, Budgeting, and Proposals**
* Support senior leadership in achieving key business goals, including financial performance and profitability.
* Monitor profitability at the client, project, and (where applicable) department level; work with teams to identify operational inefficiencies and implement improvements without sacrificing quality.
* Play an integral role in the annual business planning and budgeting process for your area, including forecasting resource needs, anticipating challenges, and proposing realistic budgetary solutions.
* Support proposal development through technical guidance, staffing strategies, risk assessments, and execution planning.


**Technology, Tools, and Innovation**
* Partner with Corporate \& Information Systems (C\&IS) and other stakeholders to drive decisions regarding hardware, software, and emerging technology needs for your team.
* Ensure teams are equipped with modern tools that enhance productivity, coordination, and engineering precision.
* Promote thoughtful adoption of AI\-assisted tools (e.g., Copilot, Abacus) and other automation to continuously improve efficiency and quality.


**Project Sponsorship \& Client Relationships**
* Serve as the project sponsor for designated high\-priority projects, providing senior\-level support to project managers and technical leads.
* Ensure project teams remain focused on client objectives while meeting scope, schedule, budget, and quality targets.\\


**Continuous Improvement \& Lessons Learned**
* After completion of each major project or milestone, participate in or facilitate post\-evaluation reviews to capture lessons learned.
* Ensure insights are shared across teams and translated into updated standards, processes, and training content.


**Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering from a recognized university is required.
* Master's Degree in Engineering, Engineering Management, Business Administration, or related field is preferred.
* Professional Engineer (PE), Chartered Engineer (CEng), or equivalent professional registration is desirable


**Experience**
* 25\+ years of progressive engineering consulting, design, and project delivery experience.
* Minimum 10 years of leadership experience managing multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Demonstrated experience in technical leadership roles, leading multidisciplinary engineering teams and/or project managers including developing leadership teams
* Experience supporting global engineering delivery models, shared services organizations, or engineering capability centers is highly desirable
* Experience in industrial facilities, advanced manufacturing, semiconductor, data center, pharmaceutical, life sciences, energy, or similar sectors preferred.


**Leadership Competencies**
* Strategic thinking and organizational leadership.
* Strong business acumen and operational management skills.
* Ability to influence without direct authority across global organizations
* Strong stakeholder management and relationship\-building skills
* Proven change management and organizational transformation experience.
* Cultural awareness and effectiveness in global working environments
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills, with the ability to navigate complex engineering and operational challenges.
* Comfortable handling multiple projects simultaneously, rapidly adapting to changing priorities, and delivering results in a deadline\-driven environment.
* Proven experience:
+ Managing or contributing to budgets and financial performance for projects or departments.
+ Implementing or improving engineering standards, processes, and quality control
+ Hiring, coaching, and developing engineering talent; conducting performance discussions and creating development plans.

* Proactive and self\-motivated, with the ability to work independently and in a team\-oriented environment.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to foster collaboration across departments, offices, and cultures.
* Experience with complex, multi\-discipline, model\-based design (e.g., BIM/Revit or similar platforms) and advanced facilities projects is preferred, especially in high\-tech or advanced manufacturing sectors.


**Travel**
* A valid U.S. (B1/B2\) visa is an added advantage, supporting flexibility for potential short\-term travel and stakeholder engagement.


**What Success Looks Like (18–24 Months)**
* Positioned the India Engineering organization as a trusted and strategic global engineering center supporting SSOE's long\-term growth vision
* A high\-performing, engaged engineering team with clear standards, defined roles, and consistent delivery quality within the Facilities SBU.
* Built strong partnerships with U.S. engineering and operational leaders
* Significantly strengthened India's role in global project execution.
* Successfully expanded engineering capabilities to support business growth objectives
* Established and functioning discipline/department standards, QC processes, and reusable templates that improve speed and quality.
* Improved alignment of resources to workload, resulting in better utilization, fewer bottlenecks, and more predictable delivery.
* A visible pipeline of emerging leaders and successors, with at least one or two team members demonstrably “promotion\-ready.”
* Strong partnerships with other SSOE offices and business units, leading to efficient sharing of talent and best practices.
* Measurable improvements in project profitability and client satisfaction metrics within your area of responsibility.


**Benefits**
**Compensation \& Benefits\-** 
 Compensation – as per market standards
   

  

* Eligibility for performance\-based bonuses, incentives, and recognition programs.
* As an employee\-owned firm, we offer ownership opportunities to all employees at the associate level and above. This senior associate\-level role will allow you to become a shareholder of SSOE.
* Comprehensive health insurance (Employee, spouse, two children and one set of parents and accident coverage, Employee Assistance Program, Parental leave, Paid time off, retirals \- Provident Fund and gratuity)


**Additional Perks**
* Flexible and hybrid work options (role\-dependent).
* Opportunities for international exposure and travel.
* Structured mentorship and leadership access.
* Learning and development support, including certification reimbursement.
* Employee engagement initiatives, clubs, and collaborative culture.


**SSOE– The Best of Both Worlds**
 At SSOE, Our Growth Trajectory Allows Us To Offer The Opportunities Normally Associated With a Large Firm While Embracing The Collaborative And Supportive Culture Often Found In Smaller Firms. As a Member Of The SSOE Team, You Will Work On Exciting And Diverse Projects For Fortune 100 Clients Around The Globe, Supported By The Best Technology For The Task At Hand. You Will Experience Our Employee\-centric Culture That Strives To Offer a Healthy Balance, Flexible Working Arrangements, Direct Access To Leadership At All Levels, And a Mindset Of Continuous Learning. Once You Experience The SSOE Difference, You’ll Understand The Why Behind Our Metrics
   

  

* 28% \- of our employees have been with SSOE for 10 years or more.
* 15% \- percentage of employees with tenure exceeding 15 years.
* 99% \- our CEO’s approval rating on Glassdoor.
* 98% \- portion of our clients who say they would recommend us to a colleague.

title: Software Engineering - Executive Director - Parametric
description:
**About Morgan Stanley**
 Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, wealth management and investment management services. With offices in more than 41 countries, the Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, institutions, and individuals. For further information about Morgan Stanley, please visit www.morganstanley.com.
   

  

**About Parametric**
 Parametric is part of Morgan Stanley Investment Management, the asset management division of Morgan Stanley. We partner with advisors, institutions, and consultants to build portfolios focused on what's important to them and their clients. A leader in custom solutions for more than 30 years, we help investors access efficient market exposures, solve implementation challenges, and design multi\-asset portfolios that respond to their evolving needs. We also offer systematic alpha and alternative strategies to complement clients' core holdings.
   

  

 This role is part of Parametric's hybrid working model, which includes working in the office 3 days a week and choosing to work remotely or in the office the remaining days of the week.
   

  

**About Team**
 The Core Operations Platform is designed to build, integrate, and support a unified technology ecosystem that enables efficient, scalable, and controlled execution of Client and Market Operations processes.
   

  

 It serves as the central backbone for operational workflows, consolidating fragmented systems into a single, orchestrated platform that improves data integrity, reduces manual effort, and enhances operational transparency. This aligns with the broader vision of moving from multi\-system, manual processes to a unified, workflow\-driven model
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Director, Software Engineering is responsible for providing technical leadership, project management, process development, training, support, and a technology vision for the Core Operation Platform. This team is responsible for multiple business processes namely Account Onboarding, Activities, Reconciliation and Reporting. The role will work with Data Services and Portfolio Management technology teams across the Direct Indexing business priorities, to design and develop technology solutions, and to improve business processes. This spans across core services to enable onboarding through our partners as well as business facing websites to allow the efficient onboarding and management of Accounts. These services will help streamline the rule\-based portfolio analytics, order generation and straight through processing allow for exception driven portfolio management.
   

  

 The Director will work closely with the Client Relationship Group and Market Operations for designing efficient applications to onboard accounts while minimizing risk. They will also work with the Digital Team developing services to that will be used by our Financial Advisor portal. In this role, the candidate will develop the appropriate software strategy, striking a balance between: (1\) alignment with the growth objectives of the Business; (2\) higher performance and consistently high quality; and (3\) cost effective application structure and use of new technologies.
   

  

 This leader will shape the long term product vision, drive engineering excellence, partner closely with business stakeholders, and ensure scalable, intuitive user experiences across operational teams.
   

  

 This is a senior leadership role accountable for setting direction, executing delivery, and building a high performing team that modernizes how users interact with operations platform and supporting data systems.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
**Strategy \& Vision**
* Define and execute the technology roadmap for the Core Operations Platform, aligning investments and capabilities with business priorities and long\-term growth objectives.
* Drive architecture and technology decisions that promote scalability, resiliency, security, and operational efficiency.
* Contribute to and help advance the AI and automation strategy for the Core Operations Platform, focusing on practical use cases that improve efficiency and decision\-making.


**Product \& Delivery Execution**
* Lead the design, development, and delivery of technology solutions supporting account onboarding, operational workflows, reconciliation, reporting, and client servicing.
* Champion engineering best practices, including software quality, automation, performance optimization, and continuous improvement.


**Business Engagement \& Stakeholder Partnership**
* Partner closely with Operations, Client Relationship Group, Digital, Data Services, and Portfolio Management Technology teams to identify and deliver high\-impact solutions.
* Translate business needs into technology strategies that improve user experience, operational efficiency, and risk management.


**People Leadership \& Organizational Development**
* Build, lead, and develop a high\-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and innovation.
* Recruit, mentor, and retain top talent while supporting career development and succession planning.


**Governance, Risk \& Operational Excellence**
* Ensure technology solutions adhere to regulatory, security, and operational risk standards while maintaining platform stability and reliability.
* Establish strong governance, support, and change management practices that enable effective delivery and continuous operational improvement.


**Job Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science
* Asset management industry experience preferred.
* 15\+ years of hands\-on development experience managing all aspects of technical projects with a proven track record of delivering well architected and well written software solutions.
* 7\+ years of Experience supervising and guiding software development teams and fostering an engaging, collaborative environment.
* 10\+ Years of Experience developing scalable solutions with advanced programming languages including .Net and Java framework.
* Proven track record of becoming a subject matter expert in areas related to current assignments.
* Strong leadership skills including:
+ Vision and strategy
+ Influencing and consensus building
+ Communication
+ Total quality commitment
+ Ownership and accountability
+ Project management

* Successful track record of development and implementation of an innovative strategic vision and plans, and competence in building strategies to deliver technology to meet business goals and objectives. Ability to transform strategy into tactical plans and delivery.
* A creative, self\-confident self\-motivator with a "can do" orientation, along with the ability to function both independently and as a member of a team. Can work well in a fast paced entrepreneurial environment.
* Passionate, forward thinking and creative individual with high ethical standards and integrity.
* Ability to collaborate and partner as a business professional. The ability to facilitate, gain compromise and/or consensus within diverse teams.
* Assertiveness balanced with a sensitivity toward and concern for people. The ability to create strong work ethics and committed teams, foster open dialogue, and promote individual and team success.
* Superior written and verbal communication skills in customer and internal environment.
* Experience identifying and implementing AI and automation use cases to improve operational efficiency and decision\-making.


 Parametric believes each member of our organization makes a significant contribution to our success. That contribution should not be limited by the assigned responsibilities. Therefore, this job description is designed to outline primary duties and qualifications. It is our expectation that every member of our team will offer his/her/their services wherever and whenever necessary to ensure the success of our client services.

 At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years.
